kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngashing / de gnyis la kho phu lo ts+tsha pas zhus/ de man 'dra/ gnyis pa 'jigs byed kyi skor ni/ kho bo khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi rgyud las/ gdul dka' rnams ni 'dul ba'i phyir/ /'jam dpal nyid ni khro bor gyur/ /khro bo'i ming ni gshin rje gshed/ /de mthong nas ni kho bo gzhan/ /lag cha thams cad thang la lhung / /brgyal zhing sa la rab tu 'gyel/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sbyor khro bo thams cad kyi nang nas gshin rje stobs che la/ gzhin rje'i nang nas 'jigs byed mthu stobs che ste/ dpal stobs po che'i rgyud las/ khro bo'i nang nas gshin rje gtso/ /gshin rje'i nang nas 'jigs byed mchog /'jig rten gsum na stobs che yang / /'jigs byed kyis ni mi shul med/ /ces gsungs pa dang / byin rlabs gter gyur ma he'i zhal can gyi/ /bcu gsum lha yi khor lhaX hrī r+shak+ṣiṃ ༈ rje/ shā/ snapa spriji sa gh+nā ༷r+sha/ra ba/ ye shes mkha' 'phro ma'am yum rdo rje ro langs ma/ san su ḍā ka 〉r+sā badz+ra ta le/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ ma hā sid+dha lā ti badz+ra/rdo rje gdan pa don yod rdo rje che ba/ ma hā sirnyi mo lta badz+ra/ paṇa grub ye shes 'byung gnas smras pa/ san ka ra kup+ta/ grub chen pad+ma rdo rje/ mahā sid+dha bad+ma badz+ra/ bla ma bal bo bha ro phyag rdum mam snang mdzad/ dī baṃ ka ra dmi ta/srung pa'am mar me mdzad bsrung pa/ dha ro dang thugs rje chen bo mi gcig par bzhed pa legs par sems/ rwa lo chen/ ma hā pho chabadz+ra nyi/ rdo rje grags/ rab gang / rwa lo ts+tsha pa chos rab lo mabra phyu rwa ye shes seṅge / man sin+ta / sngags pa gos dkar lcang lo rwa 'bum seng / rong pa rga lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ lo ts+tsha ji dza ya badz+ra sngags dkar co zeg/'di khams pa rga lo'i skye bar grags pas de ltar thogs gsungs/ de sras rong ba shes rab seṅge / spru dzā sa / sman dge ba yi shes dpal/ khu ru dzā na shrī/ chos rje don grub rin chen/ :tsho swa mya tra tra: ༄/ chos kyi rgyal po 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i rnam 'phrul rgyal ba gnyis pa/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang /32

gsan yig mar bu gang rnyed phyogs bsgrigs/shis/ 'jam dbyangs me+e dbang kun mkhyen/ 'jam dbyangs dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ nyi ma gling ba tshul khrims bkra shis/ rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen bka' 'gyur ba sbyin pa rgya mtsho/rdo rje 'chang blo bzang dpal 'gyor/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /pa ni/spyazlo sna ( pa/sprisna spra 39tsho ṇā bab pasga spradahā hūm̐ k+taspyang mikha m+p+raṃ /pa ga/nga ṭ+wāṃ sbyishā badz+ra ha ra la gnang / des 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur rig 'dzin chen po/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi bdag po rin po che badz+ra dha ra/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /yang na/ rgyal dbang mchog /de la sgyi phyosnad zhabs drung rin po che dang / khyab bdag 'jam dbyangs grags pa gnyis gas gsan/ de gnyis ka la bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i 'o/ /yang na/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma khri rin po che ngag dbang blo gros rgyal mtsho dang / paṇa chen bka' 'gyur ba gnyis/ de la bdag gi'o/ /ba ri lugs kyi 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang ni/ rgyal dbang mchog /des bdag la/ yang na/ 'jam dbyangs/ dze tā ri/rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri lo tsā/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ grags rgyan/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ bla chen rong pa/ kra a mar sirnyi/ brag kha ba grags seng / bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ chos sgo ba shes rab dpal/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ nyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i dpal ldan/ mkhyen rtse tshe dbang kun mkhyen/ 'jam dbyangs dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ nyi ma gling pa tshul khrims bkra shes/ rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen bka' 'gyur ba sbyin pa rgya mtsho/rdo rje 'chang blo bzang dpal 'phyor/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /rta mgrin shwa na bzhi skor gyi byin rlabs/ rgyal dbang mchog gi yi ge'i steng nas thob 61
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngapa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa chen po/ khyab bdag 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ skyor lung mkhan po grags pa don grub/ des bdag langam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /bde mchog dkar po'i rjes gnang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gsung gi steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa 'jam dbyangs chos skor bzhin/ de bzhin gshegs pa klu dbang rgyal po'i rjes gnang lung gsum gyi steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba'i dbang bo rin po che/ khyab bdag 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /gzhan yang / 'dir mi ze ba'i rigs gsum mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag rdor badz+ra bā ni gsum gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khri rin po che gur smon pa blo bzang don yod/ des bdag la'o/ /yang snga ma ltar gyi steng phyag rdor gos sngon can gyi rjes gnang yi dam sbyi 'gro'i rjes gnang ltar gtor ma la brten nas thob pa'i brgyud pa/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa/ paṇa chen bsam sgang pa/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma khri rin po che ngag dbang blo gros rgya mtsho/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /pa so/shā rnyi kli drishā gh+nā (spra smi n+d+ra ñtsā rdzu ldu hūm̐ sdu ñdzadī kau ngaX // dī (bangam /nga( dī/shā myang sogs nas brgyud de/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgyal mtsho/ chos rje yon mchog pa/ gye re lha btsun/ ta la'i bla ma/ 'khon ston/ zur rig 'dzin/ rgyal dbang mchog /khyab bdag 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ brgyud ba de ltar yin zhes rjes gnang dus khyab bdag 'jam dbyangs grags pa nyid gsungs/des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /yang na chos rje sher bzang / sgom sde nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa/ dge 'phel grub chen dge legs dar rgyas/ 'jam mgon bla ma khri rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /yang chos rje bde legs nyi ma/ rje 62
gsan yig thor bu gang rnyed phyogs bsgrigag༷༷ k+ṣiṃ smaṃ ༷kyi la ༵ raṃ/ two hūm̐ ༷ ts+tsha ༷/spraX sh+lau ñdzaṃ sde nāṃ/ shāX ༷zlo ༷ spyaX ni/ rje btsun gong ma lnga/ yang na/ a nan+ta pa/ gtsang byams pa/ mkhas grub shes rab 'od zer/rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen byams pa bzang po/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gzungs kyi dpal/ grub chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ yab rdo rje 'chang kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ se ra rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ khri rin po che rdo rje 'chang lha sa ba dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ gung ru sangs rgyas bkra shis/ paṇa chen bsam sgang pa dang / dge 'phel dom ra ba gnyis ka la/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma khri rin po che ngag dbang blo gros rgya mtshos gsan/ de la bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes so/ /mi g.yo ba dkar por sgyi bka' zur bka' gnyis las/ zur bka' las tshogs dang bcas pa zur du gsal/ spyi bka' snar thang brgya ②ltar byas pa'i brgyud pa rgyal dbang l+lī rtsi dhī snye k+ham̐ ༷༷༷/ khye shaṃ / sha / nyo two ༷༷༷ shaṃ ñdza khro khro 'khor lo'i rjes gnang 'di'i nang bzhin thob pa'i nye brgyud ni/ rje btsun ma yid bzhin gshor spya /༵༵ ༵ gh+nā m+p+raṃ tsho pa /rmo khan pa)sna spriswā shā /dring r+yaṃ papa/ garmo staX :spya n+d+ra m+p+raṃ pa 63
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngami 'dug bas dgrad/ e pa shes rab rgyal po/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/ 'di yan chad skyid shod zhabs drung gi gsan yig ltar/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa/ rgyal ba'i dbang po rdo rje 'chang / de la smin grol chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma khri rin po che ngag dbang blo gros rgya mtsho/ de gnyis ka la bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes so/ /yang rje bsam sgang pa sogs nas kyang brgyud/ bde mchog dkar po 'jam dbyangs chos skor ltar/ me+e dbang lha gcig bum gcig ma cig grub rgyal lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ mgon po me+e dpag med/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ti phu gsang sngags kyi sdong po/ skye med ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ dbang phyug mi la ras chen/ bka' rgyud dgas po lha rje/ bde gshegs khams pa rdor rgyal/ 'bri khung skyo ra rin bo che/ chos rje spyan mnga' ba/ rgyal ba yangs dgon pa/ zugs sras spyan snga rin po che/ kun mkhyen zur phug pa/ 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / skyes mchog ā nan chos rje/ chos rje dpal 'byor rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen bzugad nams grags pa/ rgyal ba ba〈snad nams rgya mtsho/ brag dgon spyan snga gzhon nu chos dpal bzang po/ zur chos dbyings rang krol/ pangon ston dpal 'gror lhun 'grub/ rgyal ba'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen pa/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ yang rgyal ba'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen pa/ de la 'jam dbyangs bla ma khri rin po che ngag dbang blo gros rgya mtsho/ skyid shod zhabs drung rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje 'chang blo bzang dpal 'byor/ paṇa chen bka' 'gyur pa sbyin pa rgya mtsho bzhi nas gsan/ de bzhi ka la bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes so/ /yang na/ 'ba' ra ba nas/ kun mkhyen shes rab dpal bzang /byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims dpal bzang / 'khul zhig rin chen bshes gnyen/ rab 'byams smra ba sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ rje skyabs mchog dpal bzang / rgyal ba slo bzang don 64
gsan yig thor bu gang rnyed phyogs bsgrigs/grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa slo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'grin las/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dkon mtshog rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las/ des bdag la'o/ /yang rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal nas brgyud de/ kun mkhyen shes rab seng ge /'dul 'dzin dpal ldan bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun 'phel/rdo rje 'chang bkra shis 'phags/ paṇa chen bsam 'grub rgya mtsho/rdo rje 'chang brtson 'grus 'phags/ mkhas grub rdo rje bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ rgyud chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ rigs kun bdag po rdo rje 'chang chen po dgon mtshog yar 'phel/nālha pa/sna ༵༵ /sna sa zlo/ ṭ+wāṃ paX spya spra 39 〉spyashā ṭ+wāṃ shā ṭ+wāṃ r+sha sprir+shadī pashā k+ti sprispri/ /lha po lcags ral can gyi rjes gnang yig rnying gi steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ byang sems / shul rgyapa snadzño ༵༵ shārnyi pazhi/ 599 g+ne// /( hādīhā r+sha ༷na hūm̐ shā/la 91 yan/ patādī rnyipa chos kyi rje rin po che/ ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan don grub/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab dar rgyas/ rje chos grags bzang po/ brag dgon spyan snga ba/rdo rje 'chang dpal 'byor lhun 'grub/ zur chos dbyings rang rol/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa chen po/rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las/ pha bong kha ba 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ khyab bdag 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /kho bo sme rtsegs kyi rjes gnang brgyud pa ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong can/ gru spang rtsab rdo rje seṅge / brag nag byang sems chen po/ bla ma dngos grub 65
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngargyal mtshan/ slob dpon bsod nams dar/ pe phug pa bde legs rgyal mtshan/ rig 'dzin chos rgyal bsod nams/ sngags 'chang chos skyong bsod nams/ mkhyen rtse/ dbang rab/ bka' 'gyur ba rin chen rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang bka' 'gyur ba sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa la'o/ /yang rdo rje 'chang sgyin pa rgya mtsho/rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang dpal 'gyor/des bdag la'o/ /khro bo sme rtsegs zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs/ me+e tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri ba/ sa chen/ grags pa/ sa paṇa/ bla ma grwa thang pa/ bla ma kun bsod/ bla ma blo zos dpal/ dge bshes seṅge / mkhan po shes rab dpal/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ rje bsod nams seṅge / sgo rum pa kun legs/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse/ dbang rab/ bka' 'gyur ba rin chen rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen bka' 'gyur ba sgyin pa rgya mtsho/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi khro bo dpal phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po lha bco brgyad kyi dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ mkha' 'phro ma seṅge'i gdong pa can/ grub chen sha ba ri pa/ paṇa chen dza ba ri pa/ bal po paṇ+ḍi ta de ba pur na ma ti/ 'gar lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang po/ gshen ston rin chen dngos grub/ dmar sgang bu ba chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ dmar shes rab rdo rje/ dmar thub pa shes rab/ dang ra brtson 'grus rdo rje/ dmar chos kyi rgyal po/ dmar shākya grub pa/ bla ma grags pa dpal/ bla ma tshul rgyal pa/kun mkhyen shes rab dpal bzang / mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang / grub chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ rje ngag dbang blo phros/ dmar ston tshul khrims rin chen/ rje drung dge 'dun bkra shis/ drung pa lha btsun bsod nams dpal bzang / shar chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ byang ma 66

kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngachung ba'i brgyud pa ni/ rje bdag nyid chen po/ rje btsun shes rab seṅge / 'dul 'dzin blo gros sbas pa/ paṇa chen ye shes rtse mo/ rje skyabs mchog dpal/ rgyal ba blo bzang don grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa/ grub pa'i dbang phyug brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ mtshungs med ngag dbang blo gros zhal snga nas/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad spru 'i rdo rje la'o/ /lam khrid gser gyi yang zhun brgyud pa ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/brag dgon spyan snga ba gzhon nu chos dpal bzang po/ rje dpal 'byor lhun grub/ rje 'phrin las rab rgyas/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ mtshungs med ngag dbang slo gros/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /lam rim gyi rtsab byang chub lam gyi slon ma'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal dbang rin po che/ mtshungs med ngag dbang blo gros zhal snga nas/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /lam khrid 'jam dpal zhal lung gi brgyud pa ni/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ mtshungs med ngag dbang blo gros/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad ba'i rdo rje la'o/ /yang na/ rgyal ba gnyis pa/ mtshungs med ngag dbang blo gros/ sku skye rin po che blo bzang chos ldan/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /paṇa chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i lam khrid tshigs bcad tshigs lhug gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ paṇa chen rin po che la/drung pa rta phug pa/ sngags chen dgon mchog rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis lngar bsam blo sku skye rin po ches gsan/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /sngags chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i lam rim tshigs bcad ma/ de'i zur 'debs zhi lhag bsgom tshul gnyis kyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sngags chen dkon rgyan/76
gsan yig thor bu gang rnyed phyogs bsgrigs/sku skye rin po che/ de la bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes zhus so/ /hor no mon han gyi gsung / 'jam dbyangs sku skye rin po ches zin bris mdzad pa'i khrid gsol 'debs kyi tshul du mdzad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs sku skye rin po che/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /ze'u bum sngon po'i 'grel ba lha 'bri sgang pa'i mdzad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ lha 'bri sgang pa/ de nas mkhas grub sangs rgyas kyi bar 'tshol dgos/ sangs ye/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa/ bla ma drung ba rin po che brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ mtshungs med ngag dbang blo phros/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /gsum pa zur 'debs slo sbyong skor la/ rgya che ba'i zur 'debs dang / zab pa'i zur 'debs gnyis/ dang po ni/ sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog gis mdzad pa'i blo sbyong legs bshad kun 'dus kyi brgyud pa ni/ dam pa de nyid/ de nas lde pa mdar pa'i a khu bla ma'i bar 'tshol dgos/ des drung pa sku gzhon pa slo bzang rgyal mtshan/ mtshungs med ngag dbang blo gros/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /blo sbyong snyan brgyud chen po'i rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer zhes bya ba hor ston nam mkha' dpal gyis mdzad pa'i blo sbyong gi brgyud pa ni/ dam pa de nyid/ de nas bar gyi 'ga' zhig 'tshol dgos/ de nas gser sding pa bkra shis rin chen/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bla ma drung pa brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ mtshungs med ngag dbang blo zos/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /blo sbyong snyan brgyud chen mo'i gdam pa byang sems kyi chu rgyun zhes bya ba byang sems rwa sgrengs pa shākya bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i blo sbyong gi brgyud pa ni/ dam pa de nyid nas rim par brgyud tshul ni/ ye bzang pa/ las chen kun rgyal ba/ paṇa chen gsum mam/ phyi ma gnyis 77
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngayin snyam nye dbyad/thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/dwags po grwa tshang gi bla ma byams pa bstan pa/ bla ma drung pa rin po che brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ lha pa zhabs drung blo bzang dar rgyas/ mtshungs med ngag dbang blo phros/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /lam ñtsha gtso bo rnam gsum gyi ṭīk+ka lung rigs gter mdzod kyi brgyud pa ni/ rgyal dbang mtshog/dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ rta tshag rje drung / pha bong kha ba 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ mtshungs med ngag dbang blo gros/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi mchan 'grel gyi brgyud pa ni/ rgyal dbang mchog /drung yig 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin/mkhan chen ngag dbang 'phrin las/des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /blo sbyong gcig dang lnga pa'i don 'grel/ glang ri thang pa'i tshig brgyad ma rnams skya brgyud pa ni/pa/ r+nghi spya tha(dī //shā mista sdu/ (shā ༷pa /shā ṭ+wāṃ dzño /( rgya~X sna sna /nga/ ༵ ༵ sta ༵ parmo k+ham̐ snro rgyal mtshan yan 'tshol rgyu/de nas rdo rje 'chang no yon han/des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad rdor snardo/ /ṇa/ spru ༵ ༷ paspyad twi snadzo hūm̐ ṭ+wāṃ rnyi /dzo spya shā /pang ༷pa 35 sna/spya ( sna hūm̐ sbya spru ༵ dbyangs bla ma/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad ba'i rdo rje la'o/ /gnyis pa zab pa'i zur 'debs kyi skor la/ lta khrid 'jam dpal snying po'i zhal lung gi brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba'i dbang bo rin po che/ mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin/ mkhan chen ngag dbang 'phrin las/des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /bla ma sku skye rin po che rang nyid kyis brtsam pa'i lta khrid che chung gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma sku skye rin 78
gsan yig thor bu gang rnyed phyogs bsgrigs/po che/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen pos mdzad pa'i phyag chen yang gsal sgron me rtsa'agrel gyi khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / rje btsun 'jam dbyangs/ rje bdag nyid chen po/rtog ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa/ ba 47 chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ grub chen tshos 1r+sha rje/ rgyal ba dben sa pa/ rje sangs ye/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa/ dpon slob sngags chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ gsum ldan khyab bdag gshor lo'i mgon po blo bzang chos ldan/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i lta khrid gsum dang /paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i lta khrid bdun la sogs pa rnams rang rang ge bka' 'bum thob yig nang bzhin du gyis/bzhi pa rgyab rten sde snod gsum gyi skor la gsum las/ 'dul ba'i lde snod la/ lung sde bzhi'i dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par 'grel ba mdo rtsab dang / 'dul 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i gzhi gsum tsho ga /'dul ba'i las tshog gsum gyi lung rgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang khri rin po che/des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /'dul ṭīka rin chen 'phreng pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje dge 'dun grub pa/ rje stobs ldan 'od zer/ paṇa chen na bza' ba/ rje don yod pa/ paṇa chen rig pa seṅge / rje bkra shis rin chen/ paṇa chen rin po che/ sngags 'chang dge 'dun grub/ grub pa'i dbang phyug ngag dbang slo gros/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad rdor la'o/ /rje 'dul 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i 'dul ba'i bslab bya chen mo'i lung rgyun ni/ 'dul ledz+ren/ rje sher 'byung blo zos/ 'dul langon blo gros sbas pa/ lha btsun pa/ paṇa chen bzang po bkra shis/ stobs 'bar 'od zer/ rje skyabs mchog /dben sa zhabs drung / rma khas grub sangs ye/ de nas paṇa chen rin po che/ drung pa rin po che brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ mer rgan/79
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngades bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad rdor la'o/ /rgyal dbang mchog gis mdzad pa'i 'dul ba'i las chog gi ṭīk+ka 'khrul spong rnam rgyal gser mdog gi lung rgyun ni/ rgyal dbang rin po che/dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs/ skyor lung mkhan po legs don pa/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad nga/'i rdo rje la'o/ /bu ston rin po che'i 'dul ba'i las chog dri ma med pa'i 'phreng pa'i lung rgyun ni/ khri rin po che/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad rdor la'o/ /gnyis pa mdo lde skor la/ 'bum sogs thob yig bka' 'gyur ltar la/ 'dir nyer lubo 'ga' zhig bkod na/ brgyad stong pa'i rgyun ni/ rgyal dbang rin po che yan chad gsan yig chen mo ltar la/ de nas 'jam mgon bla mi khra rin po che/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ mngon rtogs rgyan (khri)ltag dang mdo sde rgyan (khri te rgyan gnyis/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed (khri)ltag dang / chos dbyings rnam 'byed ka)(khri de 'byed gnyis/rgyud bla ma da rnams kyi khri rtags can gyi lung rgyun ni/ rgyal dbang rin po che yan chad gsan yig ltar la/ rgyal ba'i dbang po rin po che/ blo bzang 'jam dbyangs/ khyab bdag pha bong kha pa 'jam grags/ dka' chen tshul rgyam/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma khri rin po che/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad rdor la'o/ /yang ka rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khri rin po che yan sngar ltar/ sku skye rin po che/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa la'o/ /yang ka rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ pha bong kha pa yan sngar ltar la/ dka' chen tshul rgyam/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad rdor la'o/ /'jug 'grel dang / 'grel ba don gsal gyi lung rgyun ni/ rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po/ mkhas grub smra ba'i seṅge / shar ba rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen ngag gi dbang po/ rje dge 'dun lhun grub/ e pa shes rab rgyal po/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos rgyan/ rje btsun bstan pa dar rgyas/ slob dpon blo 80
gsan yig zor bu gang rnyed phyogs bsgrigs/bzang 'phrin las/ rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab mi pham mgon po'i mgur drung las byung ba'i byams chos sde lnga'i lung brgyud lhan cig ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ rgyal tshab byams pa/ 'phags pa thogs med/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen/ 'phags pa krol sde/ btsun pa grol sde/ mtshog gi sde/mkhan po rnam snang mdzad/ slob dbon seṅge bzang po/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ gu na mi tra/rin chen bzang po/ zla ba bzang po/ ti ra snga ma/ lo chen blo ldan shes rab/ ar byang chub ye shes/ gzhon nu tshul khrims/ shes rab 'bum/ byang chub 'bum/ 'jam dpal rdo rje/ chos kyi tshul khrims/ brtson 'grus rdo rje/ bsod nams seṅge / dngos grub seṅge / bsod nams mgon po/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa chen po/ mkhan chen dharma shrī/ bla ma mgon po dpal ba/ mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs dpal 'byor bzang po/ bka' bzhi pa sangs rgyas bzang po/ mkhan chen shes rab rnam rgyal/ bla ma tshul khrims mgon po/ rje chos grags rgya mtsho/ bla ma rdo rje seṅge / mkhas grub ngag gi dbang po/ gong ra lo chen/ so so'i brgyud lugs mngon rtogs rgyan ni/ rngog blo ldan shes rab yan thun mong gi brgyud pa ltar la/ de nas 'bre shes rab 'bar/ ar byang ye/ 'dul 'dzin dkar mo/ dkar chung ring mo/ zhang ye pa/ gnyal zhig 'jam dpal rdo rje/ bzang ring dar ma tshul khrims/ bo dong brtson 'grus rdo rje/ stag sde ba seṅge rgyal mtshan/ spang lo blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros/ chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen bo/ rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen/gnyal rgod rin chen bsam 'grub/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan/ pus srad pa blo gros rin chen seṅge / gnyal ston dpal 'byor lhun 'grub/ chos rje don yod dpal ldan/dwags nyag rigs pa'i ral sgra blo gros 'phel/ gtsang ston dge legs bshes gnyen/ te'u ras pa dge 'dun bsam 'grub/ phrom mda' ba slo bzang chos 'phel/ dkon mtshog chos 81
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum nga 'phel/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ yang na bo dong ba brtson 'grus rdo rje nas/ khro phu pa bsod nams seṅge / lha ston grub pa seṅge / tshad ma'i skyes bu bsod nams mgon po/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ rje red mda' ba/ rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po/ dar ma rin chen/ gung ru rin chen byang chub/ chos rje dpal 'byor lhun grub/ slob dpon smru tso ba chos dpal rgyal mtshan/ drung chen nyi ma grags/ drung chen chos kyi bshes gnyen/ ra tshag pa slo bzang e waṃ/ rgyal khang rtse pa dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur chen ngag gi dbang phyug /thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen/ yang na rgyal khang rtsepa nas/ rje 'phrin las lhun 'grub/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa/ 'phrin las bsam 'grub/ mdo sde rgyan dang dbus mtha' rnam par 'byed pa gnyis ni/ thub dbang / byams mgon/thogs med sku mched/ kha che paṇa chen blo gros brtan pa/paṇa chen rigs pa'i dbang phyug /slob dpon mche ba'i sde/ bha dra pa da/ mar me mdzad/ gaṅgā dhā ra/ bu n+ya shrīḥkha che dgon pa ba/ bram ze saṅge pa/ kha che dzā na tswaḥ'og lo chen po/ ba reg lo tsā ba rgyal mtshan/ ba reg ston skyab/ skyes bu yon tan dga'/ bla ma bkra shis rdo rje/ bla ma 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ nyang rong kun dga' rdo rje/ 'jam dbyangs dar ma tshul khrims rin chen/ khro phu tshad ma'i skyes bu/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa man mngon rtogs rgyan ltar las/ rgyal dbang mchog nas khyab bdag sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ yang dbus mtha' rnam 'byod ni/ rgyal dbang mchog nas/ zhabs drung slo bzang 'phrin las/ mdo lde rgyan brgyud lugs gcig ni/ blo zos brtan pa nas/ slob dpon gang ba spel/ gaṅgā lha ra/ gaṅgā dzi na rat+na/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ kha che sa dza na/pa ra he ta/ slo gros grags/ mar pa jo phan/ mchims don grub/ mchims brtson seng /mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyi ston shāka 'bum/ skyi ston grags rgyal/ kun mkhyen shes rab 82
gsan yig thor bu gang rnyed phyogs bsgrigs/rgyal mtshan/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang gzhon nu slo phros/ ngor chen dpal ldan rdo rje/ rat+na shī la/ rin chen 'byung gnas/ ngag dbang grags pa dpal bzang / ngag dbang chos grags/ bod mkhar ba don grub rgyal mtshan/ sgom lde nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ drung chen byang ma ba/ rdo rje 'chang dpal 'gror lhun 'grub/ zur chen chos kyi rgyal po/ tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje man 'dra/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par 'byed pa dang / rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos gnyis ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ ma pham mgon po/ mnga' bdag n+ma tri pa chen po/ paṇ+ḍi ta dga' ba'i grags pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta sa dzā na/ rngog lo chen po/ khyung rin chen grags/ rgya ma ba byang chub grags pa/ gro lung pa su ma twā ka ra/ cha pa chos kyi seṅge / 'dul dkar ba/ gtsang pa 'bre rgur/ sdong khrod 'dul 'dzin/slob dpon dar ma 'od zer/ lho pa grub pa seṅge / slob dpon rig rigs pa/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa man mngon rtogs rgyan ltar las/ rgyal dbang mchog nas/ zhabs drung blo bzang 'phrin las/ be+e bum 'grel pa lha 'bri sgang pas mdzad pa/ jo bo'i lam yig mchims kyis mdzad pa chos kyi 'byung gnas bod la phebs pa man rnams kyi brgyud pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes/paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa/ slo bzang bstan pa dar rgyas/ slob dpon blo bzang 'phrin las/dpe chos rin chen snangs pa'i lung brgyud ni/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa/ sman bla sangs rgyas dpal bzang / drung pa slo bzang rnam rgyal/ drung pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las/ slob dpon blo bzang 'phrin las/ byang sa'i lung brgyud ni/ ston pa chub pa'i dbang po/ rgyal tshab byams pa/ 'phags pa thogs med/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen/ mkhas pa blo zos brtan pa/ pun+ya shrī lha/ gang ba srel/gaṅgā dha ra/ gaṅgā dzi na rat+na/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ kha che sa sadz+dza na/ paṇ+ḍita pa ra he ta/ bla ma blo gros grags pa/ mar pa jo phan/ mchims ston don grub/ mchims brtson 'grus seṅge /83
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngamchims nam mkha' grags/ skye ston shākya 'bum/ skyi ston grags rgyal/ kun mkhyen jo nang pa/sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang gzhon nu blo gros/ rje kun dga' bzang po/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ mkhan chen dkon mchog tshul khrims/ mkhan chen rat+na ā kā ra/ rje btsun ngag dbang grags pa/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ me tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ shar chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ drung chen dpal 'byor bsod nams lhun 'grub/rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha ba thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ drung pa rin po che brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ dka' chen slo bzang chos 'phel/ dka' chen bsod nams grags pa/ slob dpon blo bzang 'phrin las/ yang na rgyal dbang mchog nas/drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma khyab bdag sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ yang na gang ba spel man gong ltar la/ dzi na mi tra/ ka ba dpal brtsegs/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/ gru rgyal ba'i ye shes/ se btsun dbang phyug gzhon nu/ gar mi yon tan g.yung drung /khu ston/ ra khri bzang 'od/ rgya rgyal tshul/ li ston chos grags/ brang ti dharma snying po/ rogs chos brtson/ mchims brtson 'grus seṅge / mchims don rje/ mchims blo brtan/ zhang ston bsod nams rin chen/ bo dong rin chen rtse/ seṅge rgyal mtshan/ thugs rje shes rab/ rin chen ye shes/ rgyal sras thogs med/ rgya ma yon tan 'od/ chos rje bsod nams blo gros/ dka' bcu dar ma bzang / mkhan chen shes rab rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje man gong bzhin no/ /bslab pa kun las btus kyi lung brgyud ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ /shan+ta de wa/ e la ha ri/shu raṃ ga /dharma girti/ jo bo/ 'grom/ bo rto ba/ sha ra ba yon grags/ shes rab grags/ blo gros grags/ bdud rtsigrags/ zhang btsun pa/ zhang ston pa/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ nam mkha' grags/bcom ldan ral gri/ skyi ston shākya 'bum/ skye ston 'jam dbyangs/ kun mkhyen dol po ba/phyogs las rnam rgyal/ ye shes rgyal mtshan/ grags don pa/ shākya rgyal mtshan/ dkon mchog 84
gsan yig thor bu gang rnyed phyogs bsgrigagtshul khrims/ rat+na a ka ra man gong bzhin no/ /yang na zhi ba lha/ ta ri/ blo gros 'byung gnas/ lha na shrī/ su ma ti girti/ blo ldan shes rab/ rin chen grags pa/ zhang tshe slong pa/ nyang bran chos bzang / gtsang nag pa/ rma bya shāka seng / mkhan chen bde ldan grub pa/ mkhan chen rdo rje ye shes/ bla ma shes rab rgyal mtshan/ bla ma shes rab rdo rje/ chos dpal shes rab/ rje grags don pa man gong ltar ro/ /rgyal sras zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 'jug ba'i lung brgyud ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs/ zhi ba lha/ paṇ+ḍita mi rjed gzungs thob/ ta ri/ zla grags chung ba/ pun+ya shrīḥbal po ka na ka /paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti/ 'og lo/ zhang /chos seng / gtsang nag /gro ston/ mchims/ skye ston shaka 'bum/ sgyi ston 'jam dbyangs/dol po ba/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen/ mus chen/ go ram pa/ sangs rgyas rin chen/ gnyug la paṇa chen/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ rin po che bod mkhar ba/ zhal snga nas sgom sde/ rtsethang byang ma khang gsar ba/ khyab bdag pha bong kha pa/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa/ 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen/ drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma khyab bdag sgyin pa rgya mtsho/thogs med mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad ba/ rigs dang dkyil gabor kun ñtsha bdag bo khyab bdag ༈ rje 'chang chen bo dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ des bdag mi bskyod dgyes ba'i rdo rje la mnyes bzhin du gnang / yig chung 'di ni 'di'i ma dpe'i steng du skyabs mgon lajogs med dbang pos phyag bris gnang ba ltar bris/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i klag lung ṭ+wāṃ zlogānā gh+nā spri/sna ༵ sna tram̐ srabazla n+d+ra /dmi/ dī ༵ rnyi ltasapa/k+ṣiṃ (sna shā ༵ dī /ngapa/ spya lhag ༵ gra/ /shā/ rma bya byang seng / rma bya byang brtson/ tshur gzhon seng / rma bya shākya seṅge / zhang chos kyi bla ma/mchims nam mkha' grags/ bcom ldan ral sgra/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ spang 'o chen po/ slob dpon byang seng / rje red mda' pa/ rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po/ rgyal tshab rje/ slob dpon rin 85
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngachen bsam 'grub/ 'jam dbyangs bkra shis dpal ldan/ mus srad pa blo gros rin chen/gnyal ston dpal ldan lhun 'grub/ rje don yod dpal ldan/ dwags nyag rigs pa'i ral gri/rje dge legs bshes gnyen/ zhal snga nas dge 'dun bsam 'grub/ slom mda' blo bzang chos 'phel/ dkon mchog chos 'phel/ rje btsun blo bzang rgya mtsho/ yang na pa tshab lo chen nas/thang sag ye 'grang / 'brom dbang grags/ bla ma dzñā badz+ra/ slob dbon ston tshul/ bde ba'i lha/jo btsun/ khu ra ba/ bra dzñā shrī chos shes rab/ bag ston/ shes rab rin chen/ bsod nams seṅge /bag ston bsam bzang / bag ston gzhon bsam/ byang seng ba man 'dra/ yang na mchims nas sgyi ston smon lam tshul khrims/ slob dpon dge 'bar ba/ dbu tshad pa 'od zer don grub/ mi g.yo ba bzang po/ slob dpon kun rgyal ba/ rje btsun bla ma tsong kha pa chen po man 'dra/ yang na lo mtshog pa nas/ bla ma dpal seng / kun mkhyen bu/ thugs sras lo tsā ba/ g.yag pa sangs rgyas 'phel/ rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen rab dbang phyug grags bzang / grags chung pa yon tan rgya mtsho/ shangs ston pa/ 'jam dbyangs mchog la 'od zer/ drung chen legs pa bzang po/ zhal snga nas chos grags pa/ khri rin bo che dpal 'phyor rgya mtsho/ smra ba'i dbang smyug ltag lung brag pa/ dkon mchog chos 'phel man 'dra/ yang na bag ston gzhon bsam nas/dmar ston gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ rong ston shākya kun rig man 'dra/ 'dir ma dpe 'ga' zhig shog grangs mi tshang ba lta bu dang 'dri 'phror lus pa lta bu yang 'ga' zhig 'dug pas/ tshan pa so so'i mtshams su bzhi shad re'am sbrul shad re lta bu bzhag nas ma ltar zhus/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan rin bo che ngag dbang 'phrin las kyi zhabs drung nas/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'bum khrod nas/ dmigs brtsema'i ṭīk+ka tshig don gsal ba/ 'khrangs rabs tshig bcad ma/ thams cad mkhyen pa gong ma gnyis kyi rnam thar gnyis/ so thar gyi rnam bshad nyung ngu dang / bsnyen 86
gsan yig por bu gang rnyed phyogs bsgrigs/gnas yan lag brgyad pa'i tsho ga'i bshad pa/ zhal gdams skor gyi khal kha'i rgyal por gdams pa yan chad/ rtsis dkar nag gi dris lan/ gzungs 'bul rnam bzhag /lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi mchan 'grel/ bla ma mchod pa che chung gnyis/ bsangs mchod chen mo/ rgya hor gyi bsangs bsngo bshad dang bsngo ba tshan 'ga'/ lta khrid 'jam dpal zhal lung / sku phyogs nyid kyis phyag bris gnang ba dang drung yig pa ngag dbang dge legs kyi yi ge byas pa min pa'i gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs skor bya lo yan chad du par la bkod pa dag legs par nod do/ /brgyud pa ni drung yig 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin las mkhan pos zhus/ de las bdag gis thob/ de yan chad slar 'tshol rgyu'o/ /mgon po'i chos skor gyi khrid klag lung thob pa ni/ rta mgrin gyi gsungs pa'i mgon po'i ñtsā paX ྅r+shaX k+ṣiṃ sbri snas zi (sbyor/zlo spraX rmyo1 ji padzo rnyi ༈ shālha rnyiXspri lha spra wa |rlo/ ba'i thun yong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ rten bzhi gnad gsum thun mong dang kun mong min pa rnams kyis khrid dang lung / bris sku'i zhal gdams/ rab gnas zhal gdams/ sbyin sreg gi zhal gdams yig rnying rnams kyi lung / be+e bum nag po las lhastog dril dmar nag gi khrid dang lung / de'i don 'grel gyi khrid dang lung / srog 'khor chen mo 'bri tshul gyi khrid dang /slang lnga'i skor dpe ris rnams kyi steng nas khrid/ be+e bum mgo rgyan dang dngos gzhi gtor chen kyi rnam bzhag /khon zas za ba'i mtha' can gyi zhib khrid/ gtor ma rtsig tshul dmigs rim mtha' dag tshang ba dang / ha la'i lhagag dril drug /snying khrag 71ga dril drug /ser ba'i phyosnag dril ste phyosnag dril chung ngu bcu gsum dang / de'i zhal shes dang bcas pa'i khrid dang lung / 'khor bzhi'i 〈snas sgrub/ lha mo'i sgos sgrub/ 'khor bzhi'i sbrags sgrub/ mgon po'i las bzhi'i zhal 87
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngashes gdams pa zab khungs can/ dkar nag ci rigs 'dris pa/ bsrung bzlog bsad gsum shun mong dang shun mong min pa dang bsgral pa'i las drug gi gnad phyag len tshigs bcad du gnang ba sogs rje thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad pa/ mkha' 'phro 'bum bskul chos sku yangs pa ma/ shā sa na'i sngags don ltar se ra rje btsun pas bstod pa/ rten 'dzug pa/ sad ser bsrung pa/ lam bsrung ba/ ngag bsrung che chung gnyis sogs legs par mnos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sgo bo grub chen dge legs dar rgyas yan sku phyogs gsan yig ltar la/ de nas pha bong kha ba rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ dpal zhakhor chos sde'i mkhan rin po che ngag dbang 'phrin las/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la bka' drin du stsal to/ /88
da༅༅/ /kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i gsan yig las bka' 'gyur gyi mdo phyogs skor gsan tshul te tshan pa gnyis pa bzhugs sem/ /nyid/rjen baX/ ༵ ༵ /spya rdo pas/ ༷pa pa/sna smras shā r+sha dī dzin r+shardo pa/ rnyi gā pa/ rdzu (shā pa/pa bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo//deng nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du shugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung du gsol/gang gi mkhyen rab rab 'byams mkhyen pa'i gter las lhag /lhag pa'i zugs rje rje btsun pad dkar 'dzin pa'i zla//zla med nus mthu mthu stobs bdag po'i rjes su 'phro//'gro ba'i bla ma ma hā thams cad mkhyen par 'dud//mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor kun/ /byed po lhan skyes bde stong ro la rtag rol pa/ /nges pa lnga ldan rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dang po'i mgon/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang la gus pas gsol ba 89
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum nga'debs/ /grags can bskal bzang stobs bcu mnga' ba brgya phrag bcu'i/ /nang nas puṇ+ḍa ri ka lta bur rab bsngags pa'i/ /mnyam med bu ram shing pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo la/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal tshab byams pa 'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje dang / /rgyan drug mtshog gnyis grub chen brgyad cu gangs rdzongs 'dir/ /bstan pa rgyas mdzad chos rgyal lo paṇa khyad par du/ /phul byung zhabs dang 'brom ston sku mched gsum sogs rgyal/ /rnam dag bslab pa gsum sgya rtsab rab brtan zhing / /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i yal ga lo 'dab rnam par rgyas/ /spangs rtogs yon tan 'bras bus rab brjid dpag bsam ldon/ /rnam 'dren gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa phyag gi gnas/ /de yi ring lugs 'dzin pa'i skyes chen ji snyed dang / /mkhan chen blo bzang chos rgyan rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen/ /thub gsung 'gyur ro cog gi lung rnams 'bad pa yis/ /legs par dar mdzad lho pa kun mkhyen bag ston pa/ /rdo rje gdan pa slo mchog rdo rje chos kyi rje/ /bsod nams mchog ldan rin chen rgya mtsho dpal bzang po/ /'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal khyad par thub gsung 'gyur cog gi / sbyin pa rgya mtshor snying nas 'dud/( /dngos dang brgyud pa'i zab dang rgya che'i dam pa'i chos/ /stsol mdzad yongs 'dzin rnams la btud nas de dag gi /bka' drin dran pa'i slad dang rang gi brjed ro'i phyir/ /thob yig 'dir ni bri bar bya/ /zhes mchod par brjod pa'i tshig gis sdun bsus te bsnyad par bya ba ni/ rang cag rnams kyi 'dren pa dam pa grags can gyi bskal ba bzang po 'di nyid la sangs rgyas stong 'phyon pa rnams kyi nang nas/ rnam 'dren bzhi pa snyigs ma lnga ches cher bdo bas gdul dka' zhing / stobs bcu mnga' ba gzhan gyis zugs las chung ngur btang snyoms su bzhag pa'i gdul bya rnams 'dul bar zhal gyis bzhes pas/ thabs mkhas zugs rje snying stobs chen po'i dbyar gyi rgyal mo'i rnga bo che srid rtse'i bar du brdung ba'i mnyam med bu 90
gsan yig las bka' 'gyur gyi mdo phyogs skor/ram shing pa de nyid kyis legs par gsungs pa'i chos ni thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba yin la/ de lta bu'i gsung rab ni lha klu mi dang dri za la sogs pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi khams dang / bsam pa dang / bag la nyal pa la brten nas dbang bo dang 'tshams par drang nges kyi chos so so'i skad dang mthun par stsal ba'i tshad ni/ nam mkha'i pha mtha' bzhin rtogs par dka' bas nyan rang 'phags pa/ srid pa tha ma'i byang sems rnams kyis kyang 'di tsam mo zhes bzung bar mi nus na/ tshur mthong rnams kyi yul lta ga la zhig /'on te rgya mtsho chen po las chu rigs tsam zhig /yul dbus 'gyur 'chang semags su 'phags pa dgra bcom pa rnams kyis ṭ+wāṃ ༷ ༷ khri ༵ ༷ ༷snraX nāṃ / pa/phyi smo ༷ khri ༷ ༷ /gh+nā hrī k+ṣiṃ ༷ two ༷ ༷ /spya mdo rgyud chu klung nye bar babs shing / rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phrul chos rgyal rnam gsum sogs rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' dang / mkhas grub lo paṇa rnams ñtsha bka' drin la brten nas byang phyogs kha ba can gyi rdzongs 'dir dar rgyas su mdzad pa'i bka' 'gyur rin po che las lung ji snyed gcig thob pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs thor bkod pa la/ tshal pa bka' 'gyur dang / rgyal rtse them spangs ma sogs su chos tshan bzhugs tshul gyi go rim mi mthun na'ang / da lam rgyal rtse zem spangs ma'i steng nas lung thob pas/ de'i go rim ltar bri bar bya'o/ /de la rgyu pha rol tu pyin pa'i theg pa gtso bor ston pa'i mdo'i skor dang / 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud kyi skor gnyis/ dang po la/ bka' dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos gabor las byung ba 'dul ba lung / bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos gabor las byung ba sher phyogs/ mtha' ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor las byung ba dkon mchog brtsegs 91
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngapa dang phal chen/ 'khor lo gsum po ci rigs par gartogs pa sde tshan phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i mdo mang dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ 'dul ba lung sde bzhi la po ti bcu bzhi yod pa'i po ti da par lung rnam 'byed las gzhan gyi cha ma yin pa dang mthun pa'i dge 'dun lhag ma ste dgu pa ljags pa yan chad/ kha par rnam par 'byed las bslab pa khyad du gsod pa'i lhung byed de bcu pa ljags pa yan chad/ ga par lung rnam 'byed las bud med dang lhan cig nyal ba'i ltang byed de drug cu rtsalnga pa rogs pa yan chad/ nga par lung rnam 'byed las rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa'i chos bdun ljags pa yan chad kyis 'dul ba lung rnam par 'byed pa dge slong pha'i rnam 'byed sh+lau ka nyi khri lnga stong bam po brgyad cu rtsagasum so sor thar pa dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa kha che bye brag tu smra ba'i slob dpon dzi na mi tra dang / lo tsā ba brje klu'i rgyal pa(1 tshi pasdidī hādī lhas ② gh+nā lhan hūṃ lha pa~X// ba~X ༵ r+dha rī dī rnapa lhang k+ṣiṃ ༷༷ 1sna pa'i gsum pa rogs pa yan chad/ cha par dge slong ma'i rnam 'byed kyi 'phros rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa'i chos bdun rdzogs pa yan chad kyis 'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa dge slong ma'i rnam 'byed lha lo ka brgyad stong bzhi brgya dang / bam po nyer brgyad pa so sor thar pa dang bcas pa yongs su ldogs pa dpal gyi lhun po dang / dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ dge slong pha'i so sor thar pa'i mdo phyosna lo ka bdun brgya bam po gnyis pa kha che bye brag tu smra ba'i slob dpon dzi na mi tra dang / lo tsā ba cog gru klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ 'dul ba lung gzhi la gzhi bcu bdun yod pa las rab byung gi gzhi dang gso sbyong gi gzhi ljags pa yan chad/ ja par lung gzhi las/ dgag dbye'i gzhi/ dbyar gnas pa'i gzhi/ ko lpags kyi gzhi/ sman gyi gzhi las rgyal po me long gdong gi lo rgyus yan chad/ nya par lung gzhi las sman gzhi'i 'phros/ rgyal 92
gsan yig las bka' 'gyur gyi mdo phyogs skor/bu nor bzang gi lo rgyus nas sman gyi gzhi ljags pa dang / gso sbyong gi gzhi/ sra rkyang gi gzhi/ko'u sham dra'i gzhi/ las kyi gzhi las dge slong 'char das khu ba phyung pa las gyur pa'i dge 'dun lhag ma'i lhung ba bcabs pa spo ba rtsol bar gsol pa yan chad/ ta par lung gzhi las dge slong 'char ka slo ba byed bzhin pa las dge 'dun lhag ma'i lhung ba bar ma ltang ba snga ma dang 'dra ba bcabs pa'i skabs nas dmar ser can gyi gzhi ldogs pa dang / gang zag gi gzhi/ spo ba'i gzhi/ gso sbyong bzhag pa'i gzhi/ gnas mal gyi gzhi/ rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa'i gzhi/ dge 'dun dbyen gyi gzhi las tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcan zin lo drug tu ma'i mngal du mchis pa'i sngon byung ba yan chad/ tha par lung gzhi las/ dge slong bzang ldan gyi sngon byung ba nas/ dge 'dun dbyen gyi gzhi ljags pas 'dul ba lung gzhi phyosna lo ka sum khri nyis stong bdun brgya/ bam po brgya dang dgu yongs su ljags pa kha che'i mkhan po sarba dzñā de ba dang / rgya gar gyi mkhan po bid+ma ka ra blo bha la sogs pa las/ lo tsā ba dpal gyi lhun po dang / dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab pa dang / 'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi las bam po bcu pa yan chad/ da par lung phran tshegs bam po bcu gcig pa nas/ bam po sum cu rtsalnga pa yan chad/ na par lung phran tshegs bam po sum cu rtsadrug pa nas/ bam po drug cu pa yan gad kyis 'dul ba lung phran tshegs sgo brgyad yongs su ljags pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po bit+yā ka ra blo lha dang / nyam shrī bha dra dang / lo tsā ba brje dpal 'gror gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa dang / 'dul ba gzhung bla ma bam po bzhi pa yan chad/ pa par gzhung bla ma bam po lnga pa nas/bam po nyer lnga pa yan chad/ pha par gzhung bla ma bam po nyer drug pa nas/ bam po lnga bcu rtsagsum pa gzhung dam pa u pa lis bris pa yongs su ljags pa/ mkhas pa'i dbang phyug bu ston kha ches zhib tu gtan la phab pa rnams kyi lung legs par thob pa las/ dge slong ma'i so thar 93
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngagyi mdo ma gtogs pa'i lung lde bzhi'i brgyud pa ni/ samya kle bud+dhaḥ yang dag bar rogs ba'i sangs rgyas/ ma hā kā she/ 'od srung chen po 'a nan+da kun dga' bo/ sha na bas baṃ/ sha na'i gos can/ khu pa gup+ta/ nyer sras/ lha wanan+da/ srid dga'/ me tsa dzi nag po ba/ sdig/ gang bo/ 'di rnams ni dgra bcom pa bdun no/ /ā tsar+ya a shwa gho khu/ slob dpon rta stongs/ ku ma ra la r+sātaḥ gzhon nu rol pa/shrī ma ti/ blo zos dbal/ ha ri lha dra/ 'phyog byed bzang bo/ shu ra ba/ dba' bo/ pa su mi tra/ nor ba shes/ ba su i/ stog len/ 'di rnams ni rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta bdun no/ /saṃ gha bha draḥ dge run bzang 4/ i shwa raX dbang rgyug /skan+ta liḥ phung bo len/ saṃ gha ba suḥ dge ron nor/ pūr+ṇa mi traḥ gang ba'i bshes gnyen/ dharmā daltaḥ chos sbyin/ bud+dha de wa/ sangs rgyas lha/ dha ra daltaḥ r+sān srin/ 'di rnams ni kha che'i slob dpon brgyad do/ pun+ya se na bsod nams lde/ saṃ gha se naḥ dge ron sde/ pun+ya nan+ta/ brtsod nams dga' ba/ dzñā na tsan+d+raḥ ye shes zla ba/ dzñā na so maḥ zla ba ye shes/ a zug rak+ṣitaḥ bya phywa med 'tsho/ sarba rak+ṣi taḥ thams cad srungs/ dharma ko khu/ chos kyi mdzod/ 'di rnams khu phen gyi slob dpon brgyad do/ /dharma rak+ṣitaX mas lo/ ka l+ya ṇa dmi ta/ dge ba ca/ bradzñā rak+ṣi taḥ shes rab ༵/sa spyam/ ñtsā rnyi shā kāḥ bha pa/nye /༷ rdo/ byi ༷༷ 'o/snaX tso sta spribyor ba sdu me/ kli spri/ṇa tsho lha ra tsho // byi r+nghi k+ṣiṃ ga/sa ṭ+wāṃ /dā pas spya shā pa/'a/nga ༷'i/ r+nghi/ shā gh+ri dī spya sha/na grashāX ṭ+wāṃ /(3 na~X d+dha/ spra spras sangs rgyas 'bangs/ shik+ṣa bha draX bslab pa bzang 4/ gu ṇa the'o maḥ yon tan zla ba/ a zug ka mi traX pya sho med ba'i bshes gnyen/ shukla mi traX dkar bo'i bshes gnyen/ shākya mi traḥ shākya bshes gnyen/ 'di rnams yu gur gyi slob dpon nyi shu'o/ /de nas ka yol gyi slob dpon shī la mi traX de la bod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ de la 'phags pa rin po che dang / dga' ldan 94
gsan yig las bka' 'gyur gyi mdo phyogs skor/pa bkra shis dpal gnyis kyis gsan/ de las skyor mo lung gi slob dpon mngon pa tshul khrims bshes gnyen/ skyor mo lung gi slob dpon mkhan po thams cad mkhyen pa/ de gnyis ka la dbe+en gyi mkhan po thams cad mkhyen pa/ de las thang po che'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa dpal/mkhan po rin chen bzang pho/ khu ston bkra shis bzang po/ chos sgo pa shī la lha dra/ gu ru sidha'i mtshan can/ spyan snga grags pa don grub/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen kun dga' rnam rgyal/ chag chos rje/ te'u ra pa rin chen chos rgyal/ tshosas mkhan chen chos grub seṅge / chos rje rnam par rgyal ba/ mkhan chen rin chen kun ldan/ dge slong rdo rje grags/ bla ma dge 'dun legs grub/ byams pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ bsod nams mchog ldan/ de gnyis ka la rin chen rgya mtsho/ drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma 'dul 'dzin bka' 'gyur pa chen po sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/dge slong ma'i so thar gyi mdo'i brgyud pa ni/dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum yan bshad ma thag pa'i lung sde bzhi dang 'dra zhing /de nas so 'phags pa/ bla ma rin chen 'od zer/ mkhan chen bzod pa ba/ dpal dga' zung pa/ bsod nams tshul khrims/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ mkhan chen blo gsal ba/ dmar ston dpal ldan rin chen/ dmar ston rgya mtsho rin chen/ mkhan chen 'gro bzang snying po/ 'dul 'dzin dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/ 'bum ram pa rin chen chos dbang / rab 'byams pa tshul khrims dbang rgyug /gtsug lag 'phreng ba/ dkon mchog yan lag /grags pa don grub/gnas nang pa darma dpal grub/ mkhas grub blo mtshog rdo rje/ pad+ma 'phrin las/ bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ chos mdzad rgyal mtshan bzang po/ drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma bka' 'gyur ba chen bo sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/gnyis pa bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor las byung ba sher phyogs la/ yum 95
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum nga/rdzu ṭ+wāṃ (dī ༷sdu hūm̐ snas hūm̐ paspyad/ ༵ zloX palha /byi lha kā lha hūm̐ dh+ri lha hūm̐ (shārnyi pa~X gh+nā k+ṣiṃ/ pa 'bum zhes yongs su grags pa 'di la po ti bcu drug bzhugs pa'i glegs bam/ da par bam po dang po nas bcu bdun pa yan dang / gleng gzhi'i le'u dang po nas gsum pa'i stod yan/kha par bam po bco brgyad pa nas/ so bdun pa yan dang / le'u gsum pa'i mjug nas drug pa'i stod yan/ ga par bam po so brgyad pa nas nga drug pa yan dang / le'u drug pa'i mjug nas brgyad pa'i stod yan/ nga par bam po nga bdun pa nas don lnga pa yan dang / le'u brgyad pa'i smad nas bcu gsum pa'i stod yan/ ca par bam po don drug pa nas go bzhi pa yan dang / le'u bcu gsum pa'i mjug nas bcu bzhi pa'i stod yan/ ga par bam po dgu bcu rtsalnga pa nas brgya bcu bzhi pa yan dang / rab 'phyor gyi le'u bcu bzhi pa'i mjug nas bcu bdun pa'i stod yan/ ja par bam po brgya bco lnga pa nas/ brgya so lnga pa yan dang / le'u bcu bdun pa'i mjug nas brgya byin gyi le'u nyer bzhi pa'i stod yan/ nya par bam po brgya so drug pa nas brgya nga gsum pa yan dang / le'u nyer bzhi pa'i mjug nas nyer bdun pa'i stod yan/ ta par bam po brgya nga bzhi pa nas brgya re dgu pa yan dang le'u nyer bdun pa'i bar bzhugs/ tha par bam po brgya bdun cu pa nas brgya gya brgyad pa yan dang / le'u nyer bdun pa'i mjug dang nyer brgyad pa'i stod yan/ da par bam po brgya gya dgu pa nas nyis brgya bdun pa yan dang / le'u nyer brgyad pa'i smad nas so gsum pa'i stod yan/ na par bam po nyis brgya brgyad pa nas nyis brgya nyer bdun pa yan dang / le'u so gsum pa'i 'jug nas so dgu pa'i stod yan/ pa par bam po nyis brgya nyer brgyad pa nas/ nyis brgya zhe drug pa yan dang / le'u so dgu pa'i mjug nas zhe brgyad pa'i stod yan/ pha par bam po nyis brgya zhe 96
gsan yig las bka' 'gyur gyi mdo phyogs skor/bdun pa nas nyis brgya re bzhi pa yan dang / le'u zhe brgyad pa'i mjug nas/ nga lnga pa'i stod yan/ ba par bam po nyis brgya re lnga ba nas nyis brgya gya gnyis ba yan dang / le'u nga lnga pa'i mjug nas drug cu galnga pa'i stod yan/ ma par bam po nyis brgya gya gsum pa nas sum brgya yan dang / le'u re lnga pa'i mjug nas/ chos nyid mi 'gyur ba'i le'u bdun cu rtsagasum pa yan bzhugs pa yongs su ljags pa/ 'di'i 'gyur byang la/ chos rgyal khri srong sde'u btsan sgya sku pa pa k+ṣiṃ tsā r+yaṃ m+p+raṃ sna gra papas raṃ rmi 5snab m+p+raṃ pa( snye zhu/ na~X sdurnyi pa( ny+pha pazu( spra /sdishā blang nas bsgyur bas dbyad 'bum du grags/ yang slad kyi bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi tas rgya dpe dang bsnun nas zhus chen mdzad nas bsgyur bas par zhab mar grags/ pyis mnga' bdag khri ral ba can gyi sku ring la paṇ+ḍi ta su ren+ta bo nyi dang / shākya bha dra dang / ka cog zhang gsum gyis gtan la phab pa/ phyis jog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis 'gyur bcos mdzad pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par ljags pa'i sangs rgyas/ rje btsun byams pa/ 'phags pa thogs med/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen/ mkhas pa blo gros brtan pa/ paṇa chen rig pa'i khu byug /'grel mdzad mche ba'i lde/ kha che bzang po'i zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ kha che ge gā ha ra/ paṇ+ḍi ta ka na ka shrī/ paṇ+ḍi ta buca shrī mi tra/ kha che dgon pa ba spyan gcig /kha che dharma shri/ ba reg lo tsā ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ de sras ba reg ston skyabs/ dge bsnyen dga' ba rā dza/ bla ma bkra shis rdo rje/ bla ma 'od zer shes rab/ stag ston sgyil pu ba/ bla ma dar ma 'od zer/ zhang chos kyi bla ma/ slob dpon jo btsun/ slob dpon bsam gtan grub/ 'dul 'dzin se'u ba slo gros bzang po/ mañtsa snyo khu rat+na/ 'dul 'dzin stan gcig ba blo gros byang chub/ slob dpon shrī la bha dra/ slob dpon bsod nams seṅge / tshal rin po che grags don pa/ bla ma rin chen grags 97
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngapa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ zugs sras shu btsun kun dga' rgyal po/ 'bum ram pa rin chen chos dbang / rab 'byams chos rje tshul khrims dbang phyug /mang thos chos rgyal don 'grub/ spyan mnga' dkon mchog 'bangs/drung pa grags pa don 'grub/ bla ma tshogs gnyis dpal grub/ dhī tsha sprul sku 'jig rten dbang phyug /sman lung ba blo mchog rdo rje/ chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen bo sbyin pa rgya mtsho dpal bzang po/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ drin chen bla ma chos rgya mtsho/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /yum 'bring po skor gsum las 'bring gi rgyas pa 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa glegs bam bzhi yod pa'i/ da par bam bo dang po nas nyi shu pa yan chad dang / gling gzhi'i le'u dang po nas bcu gcig pa'i stod yan/ kha bar bam po nyer gcig nas so brgyad pa yan dang / le'u bcu gcig pa'i mjug nas nyer drug pa'i stod yan/ ga par bam po so dgu pa nas nga bdun pa yan dang / le'u nyer drug pa'i mjug nas nga gnyis pa'i stod yan/ nga par bam po nga brgyad pa nas don bdun pa yan dang / le'u nga gnyis pa'i mjug nas don drug pa yan gyis yongs su rdzogs shing 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/le'u bdun cu don lnga/ bam po brgyad cu rtsagasum dang sho lo ka brgya yongs su rdzogs pa thob ba'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par ljags pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'phags pa byams ba/ slob dpon thogs med/ mkhas pa dbyig gnyen/ 'phags pa grol sde/ btsun pa grol sde/ mtshog gi sde/dul ba'i sde/ mkhan po rnam snang mdzad/ slob dbon seṅge bzang po/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ gu ṇa mi tra/ rat+na brla tha/ slob dpon shalta pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa/ rjog lo blo ldan shes rab/ 'bre shes rab 'bar/ ar byang chub ye shes/ khu shes rab brtson 'grus/98
gsan yig las bka' 'gyur gyi mdo phyogs skor/slob dpon dkar chung ring mo/ zhang ye ba chen po/ gnyal zhig 'jam rdor/ rgya shes rab dbang phyug /chu mig pa seṅge dpal/ bshes gnyen lho brag pa/ mkhas pa dbe+en dge pa/ rgyud bla ba rdo rje rin chen/ mthar rtsa'i slob dpon/ chos sgo ba tshul khrims bzang po/ rje bsod nams seṅge /tshal rin po che grags don pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ rje rin chen zla ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa man stong phrag brgya pa dang 'dra/'bring gi 'bring shes rab kyi pha rol tu pyin pa khri brgyad stong pa bam po drug cu/ le'u brgyad cu gnyis pa la glegs bam gsum 'angad pa'i/ da par bam bo dang bo nas bcu dgu pa yan dang / le'u dang po nas nyer bzhi pa'i stod yan/ kha par bam po nyi shu pa nas bzhi bcu pa yan dang / le'u nyer bzhi ba'i smad nas nga lnga pa yan/ ga par bam po zhe gcig pa nas nga dgu pa yan dang / le'u nga drug pa nas gya bdun pas yongs su rdzogs pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+t+ra bo nyi dang / lo tsā ba brje ye shes sde la sogs bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ shān+ti pa yan nyi khri ltar la/ de nas tsā na ṅgārti/ rong zom chos bzang / mnga' ris pa tshul dbang shes rab/ la stod pa dbang rin/ bla ma bkra shis rdo rje/ spong khrod 'dul 'dzin pa chen po/ gungang ra snga ba shes rab mtsho/ bla ma dar ma 'od/ bla ma blo gros rgyal mtshan/ mkhas pa byang chub 'bum/ mtsho dkar ba khams byang rgyal/bla ma yar klungs pa bsod nams shes rab/ mthar rtsa'i bla ma gzhon nu dar/ rin po che grags don pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa nas drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa yan yum rgyas pa dang 'dra/brgya/ dzo( /shā 〉〉pa/rdzu hūm̐ dī ñtsā lta /sna shā spyan rdzu tram̐ ༵ snam ṭā sna ṭ+wāṃ shā r+shadī / r+sha hūm̐ krā 99

gsan yig las bka' 'gyur gyi mdo phyogs skor/'bum phrag gsum pa/ rjog lo/ 'bre shes rab 'bar/ byang chub ye shes/ shes rab brtson 'grus/ dkar chung ring mo/ zhang ye ba/ gnyal zhig /shes rab dbang phyug /chu mig pa/ lho brag pa/ dpen dge ba/ rdo rje rin chen/ mthar rtsa'i slob dpon/ chos sgo ba tshul khrims bzang po/ bsod nams seṅge / rin po che grags don pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ bla ma tshe dbang kun mkhyen/ kun bzang rtsepa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ dpal 'byor gling pa/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ bsod nams mchog ldan/ blo mchog rdo rje/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho dpal bzang po/ chos rje byams pa rin chen/ slob dpon blo bzang 'phrin las/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ yang na spang lhastod chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ de yan gyi brgyud pa ma byung / de nas dkon mchog chos 'phel/ rgyal dbang mchog man 'dra/sher phyin sna tshogs po ti/ da par shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rab kyi rnam par gnon pas zhus pa bam po bdun dang sho lo ka drug cu/ shī len+d+ra bo nyi dang / dzi na mi tra/ lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par bdun brgya pa bam po gnyis/ skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa 'gyur gong 'dra/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lnga brgya pa skad gsar bcad kyis bcos 'gyur gong 'dra/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu tshi ༵ (snyi snanā ༵༵ gā pa/nā rnyi rnyidhi spya paX/ lha r+shadīpa paXparnyi ṭ+wāṃ ༷༷dī /pashe/ rnyi )( m+bhi nyi dang ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sher phyin tshul brgya lnga bcu pa/ sher phyin mtshan brgya rtsabargyad pa/sher phyin lnga bcu pa/ sher phyin yi ge gcig ma/ sher phyin ko'u shi ka /sher phyin yi ge nyung ngu /sher phyin sgo nyi shu rtsalnga pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying bo rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa 101
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngani/ yang dag par rogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'phags pa byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/'phags pa rol sde/ btsun pa krol sde/ mtshog gi sde/ dul ba'i lde/ rnam snang mdzad bzang po/seṅge bzang po/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ gur+ṇa mi tra/ rat+na parba thā/ slob dpon shānyi pa/ dzñā na shrī/ su ma ti girti/ smi ti dzñā na girti/ ting 'dzin bzang bo/ lho ba thams cad mkhyen pa/ bla ma grags pa ye shes/ spyil bu ba 'od she /bla ma dar ma 'od zer/ bla zhig byang chub rdo rje/ bla ma ye shes mgon bo/ bla ma seṅge rgyal mtshan/ gar thig pa bsod rgyal/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ bla ma chos dpal shes rab/ slob dpon bsod nams seṅge / rin po che grags don pa/ bla ma rin chen grags pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje gdan pa chen po/ thugs sras kun dga' rgyal po/ mkhas dbang rin chen chos dbang / rab 'byams pa tshul khrims dbang phyug /rje gtsug lag phreng pa/ rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag /rgyal tshab grags pa don grub/bla ma tshogs gnyis dpal grub/ nyi tsha sprul sku/ sman lung ba blo mchog rdo rje/ bsod nams mchog ldan/ rab 'byams chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma khyab bdag bka' r+shasprirak+ta shārnyi dwo mista cho lha snardo/ ༷hā /ba gā ༵ ༵༵༵ snazlon gra 33 sna po/ masnye ༈ ṭ+wāṃ gh+nā ṭ+wāṃ dī / 'jam dbyangs grags pa/gsum pa mtha' ma lags par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor las byung ba sangs rgyas phal po che dang / 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa gnyis las/ dang po snyan sgya gong rgyan nam/ rmag chad dam/ sangs rgyas phal bo che zhes bya ba 'di la glegs bam drug bzhugs pa'i/ga par le'u dang po 'jig rten gyi dbang po rab tu byung ba/ gnyis pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i le'u/ gsum pa kun tu bzang po'i ting nge 'dzin dang rnam 'phrul rab tu byung pa'i 102
gsan yis las bka' 'gyur gyi mdo phyogs skor/le'u/ bzhi pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho shin tu ston pa'i phyogs gsal bar bya ba yang dag pa/ /( (༷ ༷hā /lespri pa pa/ /dī 〈sna ṭ+wāṃ ༈ spya/ sprapa ༵༵༵ dwo miX r+sha spya pa/ ༵ ༵ ldu bdun pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i sa gzhi'i rgyan shin tu bstan pa'i le'u/ brgyad pa zhing gi rgyud shin tu bstan pa'i le'u/ dgu pa 'jig rten gyi khams skya rgyud rnam par bkod pa shin tu bstan pa'i le'u/ bcu pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi le'u/ bcu gcig pa de bzhin gshegs pa phal po che'i le'u/ bcu gnyis pa sangs rgyas kyi mtshan shin tu bstan pa'i le'u/ bcu gsum pa 'phags pa'i bden pa bstan pa'i le'u/ bcu bzhi pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od zer las rnam par sangs rgyas pa'i le'u/ bco lnga pa byang chub sems dpa' dris pa'i snang ba'i le'u/ bcu drug pa spyod yul yongs su dag pa'i le'u/ bcu bdun pa bzang po'i dpal gyi le'u/ bco brgyad pa de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab kyi rtser gshegs pa'i le'u/ bcu dgu pa ri rab kyi rtser de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par 'phrul ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis tshigs su bcad pa'i le'u/ nyi shu pa byang chub sems pa'i rnam par dkod pa bcu bstan pa'i le'u rnams/ khapar nyer gcig pa tshangs par spyod pa'i le'u/ nyer gnyis pa byang chub sems dang po bskyed pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po'i dpe yang dag par bsags pa tshigs su bcad pa'i le'u/ nyer gsum pa chos snang ba'i le'u/ nyer bzhi pa rab mtshe ma'i gnas na rnam par 'phrul ba'i le'u/nyer lnga ba mtshe ma'i gnas su byang chub sems dpa' 'dus pas tshigs su bcad pa bstan pa'i le'u/ nyer drug pa yon tan gyi me rtog shan tu bsags pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bstan pa'i le'u/ nyer bdun pa gter mi zad pa bcu bstan pa'i le'u/ nyer brgyad pa de bzhin gshegs pa bzhud pa dang gshegs pa dang bzhugs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba'i le'u/103
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum nganyer dgu pa dga' ldan gnas su sems dpa' 'dul ba'i tshigs su bcad pa bstan pa'i le'u/sum cu pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis bsngo ba'i le'u'i stod rnams/ ga par rdo rje rgyal mtshan sgya le'unyi 'phros dang / sum cu rtsagacig pa sa bcu'i le'u/ sum cu rtsaganyis pa kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa bstan pa'i le'u/ sum cu rtsagasum pa ting nge 'dzin bcu'i le'u/ sum cu rtsabazhi pa mngor par shes pa'i le'u/ sum cu rtsalnga pa bzod pa'i le'u/ sum cu rtsadrug pa sems kyi rgyal pos dris nas grangs la 'jug pa bstan pa'i le'u/ sum cu rtsabadun pa che'i tshad kyi le'u/ sum cu rtsabargyad pa byang chub sems dpa'i gnas bstan pa'i le'u rnams/ nga par sum cu rtsadagu pa sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i le'u/ bzhi bcu pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan rgya mtsho bstan pa'i le'u/ zhe gcig pa dpe byad bzang po'i 'od zer bstan pa'i le'u/zhe gnyis pa kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa bstan pa'i le'u/ zhe gsum pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i skye ba 'byung ba'i le'u/ zhe bzhi pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i le'u'i stod rnams/ca par 'jig rten las 'das pa'i le'u'i 'phros dang / zhe lnga pa sdong pos brgyan pa'i le'u las bam po brgyad cu rtsadrug pa nas bam po brgya tham pa yan chad/ ga par sdong pos brgyan pa'i le'u las gong gi 'phros bam po brgya dang gcig pa nas/ bam po brgya dang bco lnga pa/ nor bzang gis kun tu bzang po bsten nas bzang spyod smon lam gsungs pa'i mthar sdong pos rgyan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs chen po las dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsnyen bkur ba'i spyod pa phyogs gcig pa lte ji snyed pa bam po brgya dang bco lnga/ le'u bzhi bcu rtsalnga/ lhasto lo ka sum khri dgu stong sum cu bzhugs pa lo tsā ba chen bo bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa legs par thob pa'i rgya gar nas 'gyur ba'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ mgon bo klu sgrub/ ā r+ya de wa/ 'jam dpal grags pa/104
gsan yig las bka' 'gyur gyi mdo phyogs skor/dharma rak+ṣi ta/ sau ri pa/ rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ mchims brtson seng / rje btsun sa skya ba chen bo/ sum pa lo tsā ba/ lho pa khyung ston/ gtsang pa ston grags/ g.yor po spug ston/nyang bsod nams dbang po/ jo stan zas gtsang / shangs pa sgang gi slob dpon grags seng /stag me ru'i zhad kun dga' 'bum/ phag khur ba dkon mchog bla ma/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ sbru ston pa/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/mthar rtsa'i mkhan chen grags pa rdo rje/ tshal rin po che grags don pa/ dgra bcom pa rin chen grags pa/ bla ma shākya rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub rdo rje gdan pa/ chen po slo gros rgyal mtshan/mkhas dbang rin chen chos dbang / rab 'byams pa tshul khrims dbang phyug /rje gtsug lag phreng ba/ rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag /rgyal tshab grags pa don 'grub/ bla ma tshogs gnyis dpal grub/ lha tsha sprul sku 'jig lten dbang phyug /sman lung pa blo gros mtshog gi lde/ bsod nams mtshog ldan/ mkhas grub rin chen rgya mtsho/ drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma khyab bdag sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/rgya nag nas 'gyur ba lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ thegs pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/༈ dzo ṭ+wāṃ /ṇā ( rdzu/ /sdi k+ṣiṃ chu(shā /( ṭ+wāṃ (( / zla/ dī gh+nā gh+nā spyas 〈sna shā ( go/ snyeg/ ṭā )pa lha zhi/ sgya hud/ ha'i hri tha'i/ gyi ju/ so chen sgyin/ trang gsang / gying ju/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma bsod nams seṅge / gar thig pa/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo pa chos dpal shes rab/ mkhan chen grags rdor ba/ tshal rin po che grags don pa/ dgra bcom pa rin chen grags pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub rdo rje gdan pa/ chen bo slo gros pa man gong dang 'dra'o/ /105
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngabzang spyod kyi brgyud pa gcig ni/ sangs rgyas/ kun dga' bo/ krimi'i gos can/ sha na'i tāl ca)ga/ spra rdzu kū pa pa/ lha k+ṣiṃ sna/nadri khye /(3 bahā ༵ tsho spyan/ /klu/dri/ shār+ya 5pa // ༵༵ pad+ma can/ gzhon nu ye shes/ rong pa sher seng / bag ston pa/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ spu ston bsod rgyal/ shes rab rdo rje/ chos dpal shes rab/ bsod nams seṅge / tshal grags don pa/ rin chen grags pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/ chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan/ 'bum ram pa/ rab 'byams pa tshul khrims dbang phyug /dpa' bo chos rgyal don 'grub/ spyan snga dkon mchog yan lag /drung pa grags don pa/ bla ma tshogs gnyis dpal grub/ sman lung pa blo mchog rdo rje/ bsod nams mchog ldan/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho dpal bzang po/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/gnyis pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs le'u stong phrag brgya pa las le'u bzhi bcu rtsadagu bod du 'gyur pa la glegs bam drug bzhugs pa'i/ da par dum bu dang po sdom pa gsum bstan ba'i mdo bam po gsum pa dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo lha dang / ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ gnyis pa sgo mtha' yas pa rnam par sbyong ba'i mdo bam po bzhi pa/dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ gsum pa gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i mdo bam po bcu sho lo ka nyis brgya/ le'u nyi shu rtsalnga pa dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / mu ni warma/ ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ bzhi pa ñtsha lam bstan pa'i mdo bam po gsum dang / sho lo ka brgya pa/ lnga pa 'od dpag med kyi zhing bkod bstan pa'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ kha bar drug pa de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrags pa'i zhing gi bkod pa'i mdo bam po lnga pa/ dzi na mi tra/ su ren+d+ra bo ti/ ye shes lde'i 'gyur/ bdun pa go cha'i bkod pa 106

kun mkhyen gsung 'bum nga'phags pa des pas zhus pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa ye shes lde'i 'gyur/ nyer brgyad pa byang chub sems dpa' dpal sbyin gyis zhus pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa 'gyur gong 'dra/ nyer dgu pa pad sa'i rgyal po 'char byed kyis zhus pa'i mdo sho lo ka nyis brgya ba 'gyur gong 'dra/ sum cu pa bu mo blo gros bzang mos zhus pa'i mdo bam po phyed pa 'gyur byang gong 'dra/ so gcig pa bu mo gang gā'i mchog gis zhus pa'i mdo sho lo ka brgya dang bcu tham pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/so gnyis pa mya ngarna med kyi sbyin pa lung bstan pa'i mdo bam po gcig sho lo ka sum brgya pa dzi na mi tra dang / ye shes lde'i 'gyur/ so gsum pa dri ma med kyi sbyin pa lung bstan pa'i mdo bam po gnyis sho lo ka brgya lnga bcu pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ so bzhi pa yon tan rin po che me tog kun nas rgyas pa'i mdo sho lo ka brgya dang bzhi bcu pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ so lnga pa sangs rgyas kyi yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i mdo bam po gnyis zug lo ka drug brgya ye shes sde'i 'gyur rnams/ cha par so drug pa lha'i bu slo gros rab gnas kyis zhus pa'i mdo bam po bzhi pa klu'i rgyal mtshan sgya 'gyur/ so bdun pa seng ges zhus pa'i mdo sho lo ka drug cu pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ so brgyad pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang chen thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo byang chub sems dpa'aphe shes dam pas zhus pa bam po bzhi ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ so dgu pa tshong dbon bzang skyong gis zhus pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ bzhi bcu pa bu mo rnam dag dang bas zhus pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa/ zhe gcig pa 'phags pa byams pas zhus pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ zhe gnyis pa byams pas zhus pa chos brgyad pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ zhe gsum pa 'phags pa 'od srung gis zhus pa'i mdo bam po gsum pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ zhe bzhi pa rin bo che'i phung po lung bltan pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa sho lo ka drug brgya dang bdun cu tham pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/108
gsan yig las bka' 'gyur gyi mdo phyogs skor/zhe lnga pa blo gros mi zad pas zhus pa'i mdo sho lo ka nyis brgya/ zhe drug pa 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis zhus pa sher phyin bdun brgya pa bam po gcig dang 〈sna lo ka brgya ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ zhe bdun pa gtsug na rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo sho lo ka dgu brgya bam po gsum pa chos nyid tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ zhe brgyad pa lha mo dpal phreng seṅge nga ro'i mdo bam po gnyis 71 lo ka bdun brgya pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ zhe dgu pa drang srong rgyas pas zhus pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ yi shes lde gsum gyi 'gyur te dkon mtshog brtsegs pa yongs ljags kyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ byams pa/ thogs med sku mched/ paṇa chen blo gros brtan pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba srel/ rat+na ā kā ra shān+ti/ rdo rje gdan pa/bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta/ a mo gha badz+ra/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ mchims brtson seng / bla chen sa skya pa/ lho pa khyung ston/ gtsang pa ston grags/ g.yur po gzu ston/ nyang stod bsod dbang / rgya ston rnyarmā shrī/dkon mtshog dpal/ spang khang pa grags rgyal/ shangs pa grags seng / spyil bu pa ltag ston/lo mchog /bag ston/ na thā lak+ṣa/ lu ston/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ mkhan chen grags rdor ba/ tshal rin po che grags don pa/ dgra bcom pa rin chen grags pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub rdo rje gdan pa/ chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rin chen chos dbang / rab 'byams pa tshul khrims dbang phyug/rje gtsug lag phreng ba/rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag /rgyal tshab grags pa don 'grub/ bla ma tshogs gnyis dpal grub/ lha tsha sprul sku/ sman lung ba blo gros mchog gi sde/ bsod nams mtshog ldan/ rin chen rgya mtsho/drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po sgyin pa rgya mtsho dpal bzang po/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ yang na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ mañdzu shrī /slob dbon klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ rat+na ā kā ra shan+ti pa/ se'u ri pa/ a mo 109
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngagha badz+ra/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags/ mchims brtson seng / sa skya pa chen po/ rdzo pa khyung ston grags/ spu ston bsod dbang / ko nag ral gri/ bla ma grags seng / bla ma shangs tshul/slob dpon yon tan dpal/ snye mdo kun dga' don grub/ chos rje rang byung rdo rje/ slob dpon rgyal ba dpal/ slob dpon brtson 'grus seṅge / bla ma blo gros seṅge / 'jam dpal chos kyi rdo rje/ tshal rin po che grags don pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ chen po blo spros rgyal mtshan/ 'bum ram pa rin chen chos dbang / chos rje tshul khrims dbang phyug /dpa' bo chos rgyal don 'grub/ spyan snga dkon mchog 'bangs/ drung pa grags pa don 'grub/ bla ma tshogs gnyis dpal grub/ mkhas grub blo mchog rdo rje man gong dang ro/ yang na h+nā ā kā ra shāsti nas/ rdo rje gdan pa/ bai ro tsa na dkyi ta/ a mo gha badz+ra man 'dra/ phung po gsum pa'i brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ thub dbang / kun dga' bo/ kriṣ+ṭha'i gos can/ sha na'i gos can/ nyi ma gung pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen/ na ga dzu na/'phags pa lha/ shrī mañdzu )nyi/ shān+ti pa/ rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ kha che paṇa chen/ dbyal chos bzang / dbyal pad+ma can/ gzhon nu ye shes/ shes rab seṅge / bag ston pa/ mgon bo 'bum/spu ston pa/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos shes/ slob dpon bsod seng / tshal grags don pa/ rin chen grags pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na/ rje blo mchog rdo rje nas/ bsod nams mchog ldan/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa chen bo/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/bzhi pa 'khor lo gsum bo ci rigs par gtogs pa sde tshan phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i mdo mang la glegs bam sum cu so bdun bzhugs pa'i po ti/ da par 'phags pa kabskal pa bzang po zhes bya ba zeg pa chen po'i mdo bam po nyer drug pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta ba〉 ga ra sing 110
gsan yig las bka' 'gyur gyi mdo phyogs skor/lha )( la/ spya rdo ba/ tālapa pripar+sha ༷pa balhar ༵ ༵/〉papa 35 ṭ+wāṃ pa ñtsā pashāmi ༵ )ra k+ṣiṃ spya pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ mu ni warma dang ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ ca sangs rgyas kyi sde snod tshul khrims 'chal ba tshar gcod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam bo bdun le'u (spri ༵// snaṇ+ḍi spra hūm̐ ñdzashā shā gh+nā ga/ /hā dzño /shārnyi shā /shā ār+sha ༷ngad sprin pa( spya shām+bhir ༵ shes sde'i 'gyur/ na sa bcu pa'i mdo bam po bdun/ nga sangs rgyas kyi sa'i mdo bam po gcig / ca mdo sde mngon 'byung rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur 'di rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/yang dag par rogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo/ dgra bcom pa kriṣ+ṭha'i gos can/ dgra bcom pa sha na'i gos can/ dgra bcom pa nyi ma gung pa/ rgyal rigs thams cad mkhyen ༵༵ /rmidzo /sa/ dīng/k+ṣiṃ ༵ gh+nā spridhi rnyi ma/ ṭ+wāṃ shā ñtsā k+ṣiṃ che/ (sbyo/ (( /shā ṭ+wāṃ dri/9sbyi na lha/ shrī/ dgral chos kyi bzang bo/ dbyal pad+ma can/ mkhan po gzhon nu ye shes/ rong pa shes rab seṅge / bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma mgon bo 'bum/ spug ston bsod rgyal/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/slob dpon bsod nams seṅge /tshal rin bo che grags don pa/ dgra bcom pa rin chen grags ba/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan/ 'bum ram pa rin chen chos dbang /tshos rje tshul khrims dbang 4ga /rje gtsug lag phreng ba/ rgyal ba dkon mtshog yan lag /rgyal tshab grags pa don 'grub/ bla ma tshogs gnyis dpal grub/ sman lung pa blo mchog rdo rje/ bsod nams mchog ldan/ chos rje 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal/ khyab bdag drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma bka' 111
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum nga'gyur ba chen po sgyin pa rgya mtsho/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/sangs rgyas kyi stobs bskyed pa'i tsho 'phrul bstan pa'i mdo bam po gcig /klu'i rgyal po rnga sgra'i tshigs su bcad pa 7sna lo ka brgya pa/ 'di gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ sangs rgyas bskyangs/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dri med sbas pa/ rin chen rdo rje/ dharma ā ka ra shakhri/ de la panyu dzā na shrī dang /jo bo bu n+ya shrī gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka la paṇ+ḍi ta su ma rti ṅgārti/ de la smṛ ti dzñā na 93/ de nas rong zom lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang po/ mnga' bdag ting 'dzin bzang po/ mnga' bdag nyang ral pa can/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ spang khang pa grags rgyan/ shangs pa grags seng /spyil bu ba stag ston shes rab 'od zer/ sa skya yang dgon pa slo chen sangs rgyas sras/ bag ston gzhon tshul man bshad ma thag pa'i bskal bzang sogs dang 'dra/ dge slong la rab tu gh+nā spras dzom ma k+ham̐/༵ ār+sha paspru kau ā/ dzño sna hūm̐ papa'u sbra pa/ 'ashā lha k+ṣiṃ pa/ skyosgru/ (ge/ pahā 'byung gnas sbas pa/ rdo rje gdan pa che 'bring chung gsum/ paṇa chen bu n+ya shrī/ steng lo tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ sdum thams cad mkhyen ba/ sem 'dzam gling rgyan/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ko nag ral sgra/ shangs pa grags seng / zhang kun dga' 'bum/ phag khur dkon ye/ bag ston gzhon tshul man bshad ma thag pa bzhin no/ /'di'i rjes su sangs rgyas dbang bskur ba'i /spya/ sna traṃ ṭ+wāṃ spra/ ṭ+wāṃ~X ༵ shāmir+sha dī /spru 〉pa kyang snarnyi pa ñtsā dzā/na ṭ+wāṃ paX dar+sha ṭ+wāṃ dī ṭ+wāṃ po drug dang le'u bcu gsum pa 'gyur gong 'dra/ 'di gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni bskal bzang dang 'dra/ 'phags pa 'du shes bcu gcig pa bstan pa bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal chems zug lo ka 112
gsan yig las bka' 'gyur nyi mdo phyogs skor/bcu gcig pa/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdo dang 'dra/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni rgyud 'bum gyi thob yig khrod na yod/ ca par da bcom ldan 'das kyi ye shes rgyas pa'i mdo sde rin po che mthar phyin pa'i mdo bam po nyi shu rtsa lnga pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ ga par ga theg pa chen po'i man ngag bam po bzhi ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ kasangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mdo bam po gsum dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ ca tshangs pa'i dpal lung bstan pa lhag lo ka bzhi bcu pa dge ba dpal kyi 'gyur/ ga bram ze mo dpal ldan mas zhus pa 71 lo ka dgu bcu pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ ca kun tu rgyu sen ring gis zhus pa gser gyi bye ma lta bu'i mdo dang / kha gser gyi mdo gnyis la sho lo ka brgyad cu ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ ga 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis dris pa bam po gcig / kha dga' bo rab tu byung ba'i mdo shug lo ka lnga bcu pa/ ca bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyal po'i mdo phyosna lo ka don lnga pa/ 'di rnams kyi brgyud pa ni bskal bzang sogs dang 'dra/ thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo bam po gnyis/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni sangs rgyas kyi stobs bskyed pa'i cho 'phrul bstan pa'i mdo dang 'dra/ phung po gsum pa skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa sho lo ka brgya sum cu pa/ kha'phags pa spobs pa'i slo gros kyis zhus pa bam po gcig ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'di gnyis kyi brgyud pa bskal bzang dang 'dra/ tshangs pa'i dra ba bam po gnyis 'di'i brgyud pa ni thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo'i brgyud pa bzhin no/ /zla ba'i mdo sho lo ka bcu gsum pa 'di'i brgyud pa ni/dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdo dang 'dra/ sangs rgyas rmya dbu rgyan zhes pa sho lo ka nyis brgya pa paṇ+ḍi ta shākya sing ha dang lo tsā ba de wan+d+ra'i 'gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul la 'jug pa ye shes snang ba'i rgyan bam po gsum ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ ca dad pa'i stobs 113
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum nga bskyed pa la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya'i mdo bam po lnga pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur rnams/ ja par dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin bam po lnga ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa rab tu zhi ba rnam par nges pa chos 'phrul gyi ting nge 'dzin bam po gsum skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid rnam par spros pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po bam po bco lnga/ le'u so brgyad pa/ dharma ta shī la'i rang 'gyur/ don rnam par nges pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs rnams/ nya par ca 'dus pa chen po las sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo bam po bcu le'u bdun pa rgya las bsgyur ba/ kha de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bam po gcig ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ du khye'u bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin bam po gsum ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ ngaspras shā ṭ+wāṃ pa// dam ༵ krā dwo dzño rnyi/sa d+me ṭhaṃ ma gra sdi shā dwo ༷nga ṇā ༵༵ k+ṣiṃ spya ts+tshā pa/pa kha rmad du byung ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs lhasto lo ka bdun cu pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ ca mar me 'bul ba'i mdo bam po gcig ye shes lde'i 'gyur/ ca las kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod pa'i mdo lhasna lo ka nyis brgya sum cu pa ye shes lde'i 'gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi dbu rgyan nas 'di'i bar gyi mdo bcu drug gi brgyud pa ni bskal bzang dang 'dra/ 'di'i 'og tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis zhus pa zhes bya ba'i lung theb kyang brgyud pa ma rnyed pas slar 'tshol rgyu/ ca bud med 'gyur ba lung bstan pa bam po gnyis brgyud pa bskal bzang dang 'dra/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa 'di'i brgyud pa ni thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo'i brgyud pa dang 'dra/ ta bar sprin chen po bam po bcu pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sor mo'i 'phreng ba la phan pa bam po bdun/ dharmā tā shī la dang / rgya'i lo tsā ba tong ā tsār+ya'i 'gyur/ ga sum cu rtsagasum pa'i le'u bam bo gsum ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ kha 'phags pa sgra chen po lhag lo ka re bzhi/ de ba tsan+d+ra'i 'gyur/ ca stan cing 'brel 114
