kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngapa'i mdo dang 'dra/ ca las rnam par 'byed pa bam po gnyis ba/ ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni bskal bzang dang 'dra/ 'di'i 'og tu gser 'od chung ba le'u nyer gcig pa 'dug kyang lung ma thob/khochi par chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba'i mdo/ skyes rabs kyi gleng gzhi/ lcang lo can gyi pho brang gi mdo/ 'dus pa chen po'i mdo/ byams pa'i mdo/ byams pa bsgom pa'i mdo/ bslab pa lnga'i phan yon bstan pa'i mdo/ ri'i kun dga' bo'i mdo rnams thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ gong gsal mdo brgyad kyi brgyad pa ni/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa chung ba dang 'dra/ pha ma'i mdo 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdo dang 'dra/ las kyi rnam par 'gyur ba bam po gcig pa/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rje 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal yan slar 'tshol rgyu/ de nas drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma bka' 'gyur ba sbyin pa rgya mtsho/drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ kha che'i mtha'i mdo zug lo ka nyis brgya dang lnga pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni bskal bzang dang 'dra/ rdo 'phangs pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo dang 'dra/ltang ba sde lnga'i dge ba dang mi dge ba'i 'bras bu brtag pa'i mdo shākya blo gros kyi 'gyur/ 'di'i brgyud pa dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdo dang 'dra/ nga gzhon nu dpe'i mdo sho lo ka nyi shu pa/ brgyud pa bskal bzang dang 'dra/ klu'i rgyal po dga' po dang nye dga' 'dul ba'i mdo/'od srung chen po'i mdo/nyi ma'i mdo/ zla ba'i mdo/ bkra shis chen po'i mdo rnams thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ 'di rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa chung ba dang 'dra/ bde byed kyis zhus pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ tsa klu'i rgyal po ma dros pas zhus pa bam po bzhi pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'di gnyis kyi brgyud pa yang bskal bzang dang 'dra/ 'di'i 'og tu gser mdog gi rtogs brjod rin bzang gi 'gyur/ ku na la'i rtogs brjod/ dpe zeng ba 128
gsan yig las bka' 'gyur gyi mdo phyogs skor/las sangs rgyas mtshog gi dpe ste dang po rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur rnams dang / (ji par 'jig rten bzhag pa ji tsam du bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par bstan pa las/ tshe dang ldan pa mo'u 'gal gyi bu chen pos dge slong rnams la smras pa tshig bcu bzhi pa bam bo brgyad pa rnams 'dug kyang lung ma thob/ ca ched du brjod pa'i tshoms dgra bcom pa chos skyob kyis 〉〉pa ༵/ ṭhaṃ sprapa dwo kau pazhi na r+shadīmab kli ṭ+wāṃ rnyi 'chi par dzor+sha cub /lha shā sna pashā pa paX dang 'dra zhing / yang na bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan yan bskal bzang bzhin la/ de nas mkhan chen dkon mchog tshul khrims/ mkhan chen rat+na ā kā ra/ gnyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ lo pa spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan/ rin po che bod mkhar ba/ me tri don 'grub rgyal mtshan/ shar pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ drung chen dpal 'byor bsod nams lhun 'grub/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha/ zur chos dbyings rang grol/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa chen bo/ drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma khyab bdag sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ yang na rje blo bzang bstan pa dar rgyas yan gyi brgyud pa ma rnyed/ de nas sku skye blo bzang 'phrin las/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ 'di'i 'og tu 'jig rten brjod pa'i mdo bam bo gcig 'gyur rnying / rgyu gdags pa/ sangs rgyas/ rang rgyal nyan thos kyi brtag pa/ chos mngon pa'i gdags pa'i bstan bcos bam po bdun pa ye shes lde'i 'gyur/ dgra bcom pa dge 'dun 'phel lung bstan pa/ 'di skad bdag gis slob dpon gyi bshad pa thos pa na/ zhes pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ li yul du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / gtsug lag khang dang / chos kyi rgyal bo dag 'byung ba'i tshul 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rtogs brjod shākya 'od kyi 'gyur rnams 'dug ba ma thob/ rgyal po gser gyi 129
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngalag pa'i mar me'i lo rgyus dang smon lam gyi mdo/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po/ 'phags pa byams pa'i smon lam/ 'di'i rjes su byang chub sems dpa'i rjes su mos pa'i smon lam zhes bya ba 'dug kyang lung ma thob/ mtshog gi spyod pa'i smon lam ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ gong gsal smon la ma bzhi lnga'i brgyud pa la bzang spyod kyi brgyud pa ni bsod nams mchog ldan yan rtogs pa chen po las phyag 'tshal ba sogs kyi brgyud pa dang 'dra la/ de nas chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ drin chen ②ba'i bla ma khyab bdag sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ yang na bsod nams mchog ldan nas/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa chen po/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ rgyal po gser lag gi mar me'i lo rgyus dang smon lam gyi mdo/ byams pa'i smon lam rnams kyi brgyud pa chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho yan slar 'tshol/ de nas drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ mchog gi spyod pa'i smon lam gyi brgyud pa ni chos kyi rgya mtsho'i mdo dang 'dra/ ga bsam pa thams cad yongs su ljags pa'i bsngo ba zug lo ka lnga bcu pa/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni bsod nams mchog ldan yan bzang spyod kyi brgyud pa snga ma dang 'dra zhing / de nas rje 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal/ drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma khyab bdag sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ 'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob pa'i bsngo ba sho lo ka bzhi bcu pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ brgyud pa dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdo dang 'dra/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi brdzo ba/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo dang 'dra/ bde legs su gyur pa'i tshigs su bcad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ brgyud pa ni chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho yan slar 'tshol/ de nas drin chen gaba'i bla ma khyab bdag sbyin pa rgya mtsho/drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ kha bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di'i 130
gsan yig las bka' 'gyur gyi mdo phyogs skor/brgyud pa bskal bzang dang 'dra/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad/ dkon mtshog gsum gyi bde legs kyi tshigs bcad rnams bzhugs/ 'di gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho yan slar 'tshol/ de nas drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma bka' 'gyur ba chen po sbyin pa rgya mtsho dpal bzang po/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i mdo la po ti gsum yod pa'i glegs bam/ da par le'u drug dang bam po bcu gcig pa yan/ kha par de nas le'u bcu gcig pa bam po nyir brgyad pa yan/ gapar de nas le'u bcu gcig pa'i smad nas bstan pa bzhag pa'i le'u lo rgyus 'phros dang bcas pa bam po zhe gsum pa yan gyi yongs su ldogs par bzhugs pa legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par ljags pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo/ dgra bcom pa krihā'i gos can/ dgra bcom pa sha na'i gos can/ dgra bcom pa nyi ma gung pa/ rgyal rigs thams cad pa/spya paX shālha ༵ spran/ /druṃ ༵ ༈ ( lha/sa ྅ ༈ /lhan/ spya ༵ (spraX rdzu( shā (ma/ /slo/ /sbyo/ shākya shrī/ dpyal chos kyi bzang po/ dbyal pad+ma can/ mkhan po gzhon ye/ rong pa sher seng /bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma mgon bo 'bum/ spu ston bsod rgyal/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/chos dpal shes rab/ bsod nams seṅge / rin po che grags don pa/ rin chen grags pa/bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ chen bo blo zos rgyal mtshan/ 'bum ram pa rin chen chos dbang / chos rje tshul khrims dbang phyug /rje gtsug lag zeng ba/ rgyal ba dgon mtshog yan lag /rgyal tshab grags pa don 'grub/ bla ma tshogs gnyis dpal grub/ sman lung pa blo mchog rdo rje/ bsod nams mchog ldan/ chos rje 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal/ drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma khyab bdag bka' 'gyur pa chen po sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ drin chen 131
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngabla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ myang 'das chen po 'dis mtshon bskal bzang dang brgyud pa 'dra la/ sgos brgyud med pa'i gong gi mdo kun la hor khong yod tshul la brten/ paṇa chen nas brgyud pa'i lung dag bo yod pa bag ston pas/ zhang kun dga' 'od zer la gsan pa'i brgyud pa ni/ paṇa chen shākya shrī nas lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ ko nag ral gri/ jo gdan zas gtsang / shangs pa grags seng / zhal snga pa ba〈snad nams rin chen/ mkhan po gzhon nu ye shes/ se ston 'byung ldan 'od/ mang mkhar ba byang chub seṅge / zhang kun dga' 'od zer/ bag ston gzhon tshul man bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra/ yang dbyal chos bzang gis khra phur paṇa chen la gsan pa'i dus lho pas kyang gsan pa yin zer ba las/ gsan yig nges tig ma byung bar brten/ bag ston rin po che nas/ sa skya yang dgon slo chen par gong du smos pa'i mdo rnams las sgos brgyud med pa'i bskal bzang dang brgyud pa gcig pa rnams skyar nas gsan pa'i brgyud pa ni/thub dbang / ma pham pa/thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ sangs rgyas bskyangs/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dri med smras pa/ rin chen rdo rje/ dharma ā kā ra shāsti ba/ de la paṇ+ḍi ta dzñā na shri dang / jo bo pu kyashri gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka la paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti krirti/ de la smri ti dzā na ṅgārti/ de la rong zom lo tsā ba chos bzang / mnga' bdag ting 'dzin bzang po/ mnga' bdag nyang nyi ma 'od zer/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ spang khang ba grags rgyan/shangs pa grags seng / spyil bu ba ltag ston shes rab 'od zer/ sa skya yang dgon pa slo chen sangs rgyas sras/ bag ston gzhon tshul man gong dang 'dra/ yang sgos brgyud med pa bskal bzang dang brgyud pa 'dra ba rnams steng lo nas brgyud pa srang phag khur ba la bag ston pas /mi( (lha (rdzun hūm̐ shā lha spri swā / ༵༵ sngu / ༵ lha liṃ pa// /lha shu'i/ rdzus ga(/sa' ༵༵ 132
gsan yig las bka' 'gyur gyi mdo phyogs skor/pa/ rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ pu n+ya shrī/ steng pa lo tsā ba/ so thams cad mkhyen pa/ so 'dzam gling rgyan/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ ko nag ral sgra/ shangs pa grags seng / zhang kun dga' 'bum/ phag khur dkon ye/ bag ston gzhon tshul man gong dang 'dra/ gzhi gtso bor ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po/ lam la thabs kyi cha gtso bor ston pa sa bcu pa dang dkon brtsegs nas gsang chen thabs la mkhas pa/ lam la shes rab kyi ga gco bor ston pa ting nge 'dzin rgyal po/ 'bras bu gtso bor ston pa sangs rgyas kyi sa ste zab mo'i mdo lnga'i brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ thub dbang / 'jam dbyangs/ rat+na ā kā ra shān+ti/ bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta zhi ba bzang po/ 'bro lo tsā ba/ seng dkar shākya 'od/ khyung po grags seng / she'u dgon pa ba/ byang chad pa/dkon she /mang mkhar tsha lung gi tog ston chen po dkon mchog /glang ngar brda ston bsod /dri dī byi/ ta//ga k+ṣiṃ byi hūm̐ ṭ+wāṃ spran ༵la da dzño pakli ṭ+wāṃ ༵༵ 'a/sna pazlon/ spyazlodaX ༷pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje man gong bzhin/ yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas/mkhas pa tshad ma'i skyes bu thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje man gong dang 'dra/ rtags yod pa rnams kyi brgyud pa gcig ni/ sangs rgyas/ byams pa/thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ rnam grol sde/ seng bzang / sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ shān+ti pa/pu r+tshe shrī/ steng lo/ dwags po ba/ khyung po grags she /lha rje grags skyabs/ 'or ston pa lha dbang /so ston chos she /dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo mchog pa/ ra sa ba ston shāka /bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ bla ma bsemad nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje man 'dra/ rtags can rnams kyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ ljags pa'i sangs rgyas/ spyan ras gzigs/ byams pa/ gser gling pa/ jo bo rje/ nag tsho lo tsā ba/ po rto ba/ sha ra ba/ bya 133
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngayul ba/ pus sman pa/ dpal ldan zo mo che ba/ byang chen pa/ bag ston/ mgon po 'bum/ bla ma dam pa bsemad nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje man 'dra'o/ /klu'i ༵ k+ṣiṃ ca/ k+ṇi /rnyipa kyi ༵༵ r+yaṃ hūm̐ /lha/ ༷ga r+nghi/shā blo pa shārnyi// lha rnyisna /sna pa/ tsho nywaX/ chung gsum/ zug ma shrī bha dra/ bi ma la shrī/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ khro phu lo tsā ba/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen ba/ spang khang pa grags pa rgyal mtshan/ shangs pa grags seng / zhal snga pa bsod rin/ mkhan chen gangs pa/ shes rab dpal/ dge slong kun dga' nyi ma/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ slob dpon mgon po 'bum/ spu ston bsod rgyal/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ bla ma chos dpal shes rab/ rin bo che grags don pa/ bla ma rin chen grags pa man sngar dang 'dra///pa stan stalha n+dha bsno dī pa~X pa/shā ṭ+wāṃ/ ༵༵ ñtsha pag/ spra pas/ k+ta/tshopa sgrubanā/ dzo ༵ ldar+sha ba'i bshes gnyen/ dzā na shrī/ gnyan lo dar ma grags/ khyung po grags seng / 'or ston pa/ so ston pa/ zhang ngar seng / rong pa chos mgon/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo kros/ dpung rgyan mdzis pa'i tog /bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ spu ston bsod rgyal/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ bla ma chos sgo ba man gong bzhin no/ /rtags can rnams kyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ rnam 'dren zas gtsang sras po/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ slob dbon sangs rgyas ye shes/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ sman pa'i zhabs/rgyal bas sbyin/ rat+na shrī/ shalta badz+ra/ rkarma badz+ra/ bu n+ya shri/ tra dza ya rak+ṣi ta/ thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ phag khur ba dgon mchog bla ma/ bag ston/ mgon po 'bum/ spu ston pa/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ bla ma chos dpal shes rab/ slob dpon bsod seng / rin bo che grags don 134
gsan yig las bka' 'gyur gyi mdo phyogs skor/pa/ rin chen grags pa/ chos rje shākya rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ chen po blo zos rgyal mtshan/ mkhas dbang rin chen chos dbang / tshul khrims dbang phyug /rje gtsug lag phreng ba/ rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag /rgyal tshab grags pa don 'grub/ bla ma tshogs gnyis dpal grub/ sman lung ba blo mtshog rdo rje/ bsod nams mchog ldan/ chos rje 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal/ drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po nyin pa rgya mtsho dpal bzang po/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/135

gsang sngags kyi 'byung gnas rgyud g+ne rin po che thob tshug༄༅/ /shākya'i dge slong 'jam dargyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i 11ba yig bstan pa'i rgya mtsho mkhas pa'i 'jug lnga(gas las gsang sngags kyi 'byung gnas rgyud sde rin 〈sna che rnams 〈snab tshul te rim pa gsum pa bzhugs 31/ /rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo//gnyis pa 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa brjod bya'i gtso bor byas nas ston pa'i rgyud kyi skor la po ti nyi shu gagacig yod pa las/ka pa kha pa ga pa gsum la rnying ma'i rgyud rnams bzhugs kyang lung ma thob pas 'dir ma bkod la/da lam gsang sngags sgyi 'gyur gyi skor las lung gang thob kyi mtshan thor bkod pa la/nga pa la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa las phyung ba rtsaba'i rgyud kyi dum bu dbang mdor bstan zhes bya ba kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta so ma na tha dang /'bro lo tsā shes rab 137

kun mkhyen gsung 'bum nga'bum lnga lo tsā/ ko nag ral gri/ grags seng / khang ston/ dkon mtshog ye shes/ dkon mchog bla ma/ bag ston man 'dra'o/ /yang na ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen/ rje btsun rtsemo/ rje btsun rin po che/ rje btsun sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ rong pa rga lo/ rong pa sher seng / bag ston man sngar ltar ro/ /rdo rje bdud ji'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u bcu gcig pa/ gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur ba/ 'di la dkyil 'khor bzhi yod/ brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ 'bar ba 'dzin/ spyod pa'i rdo rje/ dge ba'i mgon po/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ te lo pa/ nā ro pa/ sen+dha pa/ mar pa lo tsā/ ro mnyam rdo rje/ gser rje dgon pa ba/ dwags po sha ba gling pa/ mgon po gling pa gzhang rong ka pa/ sbrags gtsang ba/ rgya gar grags pa/ sras yon tan grags/ khams pa shākya rdo rje/ sras chos grags/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ 'og ma〈snag pa/ slo chen pa man sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor bzhin no/ /'di'i rjes su rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po spyan ras gzigs lnga bcu ba'am/ rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po'i rtog pa zhes bya ba le'u bzhi pa zhig 'dug kyang lung ma thob/ sgrol ma ku ru ku l+le'i rtog pa le'u lnga pa kriṣ+ṭha paṇ+ḍi ta dang / nag tsho'i 'gyur/ 'dis dkyil lubor gcig bstan no/ /brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ slol ma/ kun dga' bo/ nyi ma gung ba/ sha na'i gos can/ kṛ mi'i gos can/ nyi ma sbas pa/ rā hu la shrī/ bo nyi shrī/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ kho phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal/ rin chen 'bum/ sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo mchog pa/ slo chen pa/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal man gong dang 'dra'o/ /sgrol ma mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud le'u lnga brgya bdun cu pa nas phyung ba'i sgrol ma phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsagacig bstod pa phan yon dang bcas pa/brgyud pa ni sgrol ma ku ru kul+le dang 'dra zhing / 'di nyi ma sbas pa rnal 'gror bla med du bkral zhing / rdul tshon dang lus dkyil gnyis yod par bzhed do/ /rdo rje phur pa rtsaba'i rgyud kyi dum 152

kun mkhyen gsung 'bum nganams rin chen/ zur la ba tshul khrims skyabs/ 'phags pa skyabs/ ser sdings pa gzhon nu 'od/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ khyung lhas pa/ rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po/ rje btsun shes rab seṅge / rgyud chen sbyin pa dpal/rgyud pa tshul khyims bzang po/ chos rje rin chen 'od zer/ chos rje chos skyong rgya mtsho/ rje dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/ rje rnam rgyal dpal bzang / rje ngag dbang chos/ rje ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang dam chos rnam rgyal/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ drin chen bla ma chos rgya mtsho/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /yang na 'khon gad pa ṅgārti nas/ 'gar ston jo sras/ ang phug ri ston seṅge ljang pa/ khyung ston zhig po/ mkhan po tshul snying / chos sdings mkhan po rdo rje snying po/ chos sdings 'og ma/ shrī zur phug pa dar ma bzang dzño/ brdzu/ nā snyi pa/sna /la (shā zlo/darnyi ṭ+wāṃ pa/ /rnyi (1 kaushā rdzu /dri bsta sbyi k+ti (( sdishā sna r+sha 'gyur/ brgyud pa ni gsang 'dus rtsargyud ji lta ba bzhin no/ /bshad rgyud dgongs pa lung ston le'u bcu gnyis pa 'gyur gong 'dra/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba mngon par brjod pa rgyud thams cad kyi snying bo gsang ba rnam par phye ba zhes bya ba le'u drug cu rtsabargyad pa/ mkhan po su dzñā na shrī dang / lo tsā ba dge slong zhi ba'i 'od kyis bsgyur ba/'di la dngos su dkyil 'khor gcig yod/ lha mo bzhis yongs su zhus pa'i rgyud le'u bzhi pa panyu ta smṛ ti'i rang 'gyur/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud/ parnyi ta dzha na ka ra dang /lo tsā ba khu dngos grub kyis bsgyur ba la/ nag tshos 'gyur bcos byas pa/ rgyud 'di bzhi sga'i brgyud pa ni gsang 'dus rtsargyud kyi brgyud pa ji lta ba bzhin no/ /rtso rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa paṇ+ḍi ta ka ma la gup+ta dang / lo tsā ba mnga' bdag lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis 154
gsang sngags kyi 'byung gnas rgyud g+ne rin po che sgab tshugbsgyur ba/ 'di la dngos su dkyil gangor gcig yod/ brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang bo/ kun dga' snying po/ tha ga pa/ shārnyi pa/ shud+dha ka ra wa tha/ pad+ma ka ra/ de gnyis ka la lo chen rin bzang / gsum ka la lha btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan/ chos rje blo spros/ skyabs seng / sra brtan/ dkon mtshog mkhar/ dbang phyug rin chen/ bar thang pa yab sras/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ 3sna rje gling pa/ bla ma maboston po 'bum/ bram nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ ma nyi paṇa chen man sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i rjes su gnyis med rnam rgyal brtag pa nyer gnyis pa 'dug kyang lung ma thob/gsang rgyud rnam par 'byed pa drag po gsum 'dul/ le'u gsum pa/ lag na rdo rje gos sngon can drag po gsum 'dul gnyis ka paṇ+ḍi ta de wa pur+ṇa ma ti dang / 'gar chos bzang gis bsgyur ba snga ma la dza wa ris dkyil 'khor bzhir bkral lo/ /brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / mkha' 'gro ma sidha mu kha/ sa wa ri pa/ dza wa ri pa/ de wa pur+ṇa ma ti/ 'gar lo chos bzang / gshen rin chen dngos grub/ dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ dmar shes rab rdo rje/ dmar chos kyi rgyal po/gan chag pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ 'dzims pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / kun spang chos grags dpal/ sa bzang paṇa chen man sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang gcig /'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi rgyud rdo rje be+e con can le'u bco lnga pa 'di la dkyil lubor gcig yod/ 'di'i rgyud phyi ma phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can rdo rje gdengs pa'i rgyud khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i le'u paṇ+ḍi ta a ṭa ma shrī ma ti dang lo tsā ba tshos kyi dbang phyug /sa snañdzadī ṅgi/'iX/ shā spri /ciX (3kā ṭ+wāṃ kaushā ( /( zhi~X r+shadzi/ ༷sna ra papa pa/ 155

gsang sngags kyi 'byung gnas rgyud g+ne rin po che thob tshugrgyal mtshan/ ri khyod pa ba〈snad nams rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ bya 'gyur ba bsod nams seṅge / rje rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ ru thog pa mnga' ris bla chen/ kun mkhyen mkhyen rtse'i dbang phyug /mchod dpon kun dga' legs pa/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ mgon po bsod nams mtshog ldan/ zur chos dbyings rang grol/rgyal ba'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang rgya mtsho dpal bzang po/ slob dpon blo bzang 'jam dbyangs/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ drin chen bla ma chos rgya mtsho/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /yang na bcom ldan 'das shākya seṅge / dbang po'i gtsug rgyan/ pad+ma'i rje/ mkhas pa'i rje/ sangs rgyas ye shes legs skyes/ bkra shas blo brtan/phyogs kyi thar pa/ chos kyi bsrung ba/ ye shes rgya mtsho/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ srid pa gsung gcig /grags pa'i rdo rje/ chos kyi grags pa/ sangs rgyas dbyangs/ mahwa paṇ+ḍi ta/ shrī wā na rat+na/ byang pa rigs ldan chen po rnam rgyal grags bzang / shangs ston kun dga' dpal ldan/ru thog pa nam mkha' gzi bajid man 'dra/ nye brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang / grub chen sha wa ri/ paṇa chen nags rin man 'dra/'gyurarna/ dī& ༵ /zlo hūm̐ (( lha( k+ṣiṃ ṭ+wāṃ pa/ k+ṣiṃ pashā pa~X dzño m+p+raṃ /mi cuche tā(( dī zlo/ brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ rab gsal zla ba/ ye shes rdo rje/ kun dga' snying po/ bradzñā bo nyi/ muñtsa ko ṣa/ shārnyi ka ra/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ lo chung legs pa'i shes rab/ sum ston ye shes 'bar/ 'or ston lha'i dbang snyog /'or ston sangs rgyas 'bar/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ rje chos kyi seṅge / dag ston chos mgon/ dbus pa songs rgyas 'bum/lo mtshog pa/ slo chen pa/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal/ spang khang pa/ sa bzang paṇa chen man 157
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngasangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang 'dra'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang zugs gshin rje gshed nag po zhes bya ba'i rgyud le'u bco brgyad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta di paṃ ka ra shrī dzā na dang / nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal rnyipa ྅ñdzadī ṅgi ༵ /kyi1 dī k+ṣiṃ stang /shā snro3 ༵༵ r+ṇi pa (gu'i brdornyi ༈ dā ni/ lha krā paX dmi shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la i ta badz+ra/ 3 'o pa/ nā ro pa/ shes rab bsrung ba/ meji gling pa/ rā lo rdor grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa dharma seṅge / rwa dkon mchog seṅge / rwa shes rab rgyal mtshan/slo chen sangs rgyas sras/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal/ spang khang pa man 'dra'o/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa bdun pa paṇ+ḍi ta bha ro phyag brdum dang / rwa lo rdor grags kyis 1sgyuX rnyi/// gh+nā ༷pas sutsho dī spyashā pa/ga zlos/ pa/ dīkāpa spyu ༵ spri spya)pa ṣ+ṭṛ pardzu gha badz+ra che chung / skyo 'od kyi 'byung gnas/ skyo 'jam dpal/ skyo pad+ma/ skyo khams pa/ gnyan rin chen brtan pa/ gnyan 'od bsrung / gnyan chos rgyal/ slo chen sangs rgyas/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal/ bsod nams mtshog ldan/ zur chos dbyings rang grol/ thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po/ slob dpon slo bzang 'jam dbyangs/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ drin chen bla ma chos rgya mtsho/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad ba'i rdo rje la'o/ /yang na rgyal bzang dpal man sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang 'dra/ mtshams 'dir gshin rje gshed kyi 'khor lo skor ba'i cho ga dus dang nges pa bstan pa zhes bya ba 'dug kyang lung ma thob/ 'jigs byed kyi gtam brgyud kyi rtog pa dang / dngos grub kyi rtog pa zhes bya ba rtog pa bzhi par grags pa gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'jigs byed/ la li ta/ a mo lha/ ye 'byung / pad+ma badz+ra/ bha ro/ rwa 158
gsang sngags kyi 'byung gnas rgyud g+ne rin po che thob tshugchos rab/ ye seng / 'bum seng / rga lo/ sher seng / bag ston/ tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/sher dpal ba/ gra thang pa shes rab zla ba/ rdo ring rin bo che/ tshar pa rdo rje 'chang / kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /mkhan chen bslab gsum pa/ phag rmong / rdo rje 'chang dbang rab/bsedad nams mchog ldan/ rab 'byams chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ drin chen bla ma chos rgya mtsho/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /rtog gsum dang 3'u lo pa'i rtog pa gnyis kyi brgyud pa gtam brgyud kyi rtog pa sogs dang 'dra'o/ /rtog gsum ni rtog bdun gyi lung brgyud thams cad mkhyen pa ltar yang thob/ṣ+ṭṛ sbyi ༷ ༷ s+t+ri s+t+waṃ dhī / wa wa ༷༷ khronye | /snye smo // snye lha pa/ a ba li na pa/ yon tan bzang po/ ngag dbang grags pa/ de ba a ka ra tsan+d+ra/ don yod rdo rje/ shes rab bla ma/ dge 'dun bzang po/ sras saṅga bha tra/ gcen gtsang 'od/ gcung rdo rje rtsemo/ rtsibs ri ba nyi ma 'od/ rgyal ba bstan bzang pa/ zhang g.yul rgyal/ 'dzims pa rin chen shes rab/ bla ma sangs rgyas bzang po/ slo chen/ de gnyis ka la rgyal bzang dpal/ spang khang pa man dbang mdor bstan gyi brgyud pa snga ma dang gcig go /gshin rje'i gshed dmar po zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u dgu pa paṇ+ḍi ta rā hu la shrī bha tra dang / shong los bsgyur ba la/ dge slong tsan+d+ra shrīs zhal snga nas zhus shing / paṇ+ḍi ta tsan+t+ra )nyi dang / yar klungs pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis yam bu'i grong khyer du bsgyur ba/ 'di la dkyil lubor bcu yod/ brgyud pa 159
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngani/ gshin rje gshed/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ n+da ra ḍi ba/ gam+bhi ra ma ti/ niska lam ka de wa/ re wan+d+ras snya/ chag lo chos rje dpal/ bla ma dpal gyi rgyal mtshan/ klog skya pa/ don ri pa grags pa dpal/ spang khang pa grags pa dpal/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen man bshad ma thag pa'i dbang mdor bltan bzhin no/ /'di'i 'og tu gshed dmar gyi rgyud le'u nyer gnyis pa bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas 'gyur mdzad pa zhig 'dug kyang lung ma thob/ bcom ldan 'das ral gcig pa'i rtog pa'i rgyud skya rgyal po paṇ+ḍi ta shrī kha la ru tra dang / kho phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba/ 'di la dngos su dkyil 'khor gcig gsal/ mi pham sbas pa'i bshes gnyen gyis gnyis su bkral lo/ brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen po/ jo bo khar+sā pā ṇi/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ te lo pa/ niska lam ka shrī/ grub chen mi tra dzo ka /khro lo gnubs byams pa'i dpal/bla ma dbon ston pa/ yang 〉ba rin chen seṅge / thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ khyung lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma rin chen don 'grub legs pa/ 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ dka' bzhi pa rin chen mtshog grub dpal 'bar/rgyal yum tshul khrims bzang mo/ mnga' ris gter chen chos kyi rgyal po legs ldan rdo rje/ bla ma mo rgyan rgyal po/ paṇa chen kun dga' bkra shis bsod nams mchog ldan/ de gnyis ka la rab 'byams chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po sbyin pa rgya mtsho/drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ drin chen bla ma chos rgya mtsho/des bdag lan+dam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /zla bzang thig le rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po shin tu dgyes pa rdo rje gdon mi za ba'i dam tshig gi n+d+ra shārnyitsho zlo (( rī ༈ lha pa pa/pa tsho snaXng n+dha ṭā spyashā rnyi hūm̐ ༵ r+sha /sna dzño shā rtsa/ pa/ 160

wa wa gsangasngags kyi 'byung gnas rgyud sde rin po che thob tshul/po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ ri khod pa slo brtan/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shang chen/ ngor chen kun bzang / rgyal tshab kun dbang / yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ rje lha mtshog seṅge man sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang gcig /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i gzi bajid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa phyogs gcig pa paṇ+ḍi ta re len+d+ra de wa/ ma ni ka shrī dzñā na/ lo tsā ba /gats+tsha dī shā (padī gh+nā ༈ sna ñtsārnyi snaṅge druṃ/ ༵ shā snam da/parnyi gyi( dī gā gami spyashā /calha spyazlo gh+nā pa/ so 'dzam gling rgyan/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ ko nag ral gri/ jo gdan zas gtsang /shangs pa grags seng / rin chen 'bum/ bde ba can pa seng rgyal/ gar thig pa/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ bla ma chos dpal shes rab/ mkhan chen brag rdor ba/ chos rje grags pa don 'grub/ rjog byang chub dpal/ mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ chos rje nam mkha' dbang phyug /'bum ram pa rin chen chos dbang / rab 'byams pa tshul khrims dbang phyug /mang thos chos rgyal don 'grub/ spyan snga dkon mchog 'bangs/ sems pa grags pa don 'grub/ sdom brtson tshogs gnyis dpal grub/ sprul sku 'jig rten dbang smyug /mkhas grub blo mchog rdo rje/bsod nams mchog ldan/ rin chen rgya mtsho/ drin chen gaba'i bla ma khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ drin chen bla ma chos rgya mtsho/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /yang na grags don pa nas/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/mkhas grub rigs pa'i slog phreng / bla ma bstan pa rgya mtsho/ rgya ngag dbang chos rgyal/ gcung ngag dbang grags pa/ mkhas pa ngag dbang nor bu/ bla ma ngag dbang bzang po/ bla ma kun slo/163

gsang sngags kyi 'byung gnas rgyud g+ne rin po che thob tshul/rje brag sprul sku yan slar 'tshol rgyu/ de nas rab 'byams chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ drin chen bla ma chos rgya mtsho/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdun sgya sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo sho lo ka brgyad brgya pa/dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / shī len+d+ra bo nyi dang / ye shes lde 99/ ༵ ༵ ༷/ shaṃ spya tram̐ /nywa hūm̐/ dzhai ༷༷ nāṃ ṭ+wāṃ/ ṭ+wāṃ lha: ts+tsha ༵ ༵ spri| two gyi stobs bskyed pa baiḍūr+ya'i 'od ces bya ba'i gzungs paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la/ su rat+na bo nyi/ brnye ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab pa las/ phyis paṇ+ḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba/ sman la sngags kyis gdab pa/ 'di nyid sman bla'i snying po logs su byung ba yin pas rgyud tha dad du mi bgrang ngo / /'di rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs kyi brgyud pa ji lta ba bzhin no/ /'phags pa nor bu chen po rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang shin tu rab tu gnas pa gsang ba dam pa'i cho ga zhib mo zhes bya ba'i rgyud le'u bdun pa paṇ+ḍi ta bit+yā ka ra spru bha wa dang lo tsā ba dpal gyi lhun pos bsgyur ba la/ slad kyi paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang / lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyis k+ta ṇ+ṭhī dī/( ñtsā k+ṣiṃ ṭ+wāṃ/ /sna hūm̐/ (rnyi chehār+sha k+ṣiṃ )ba ༵ 〉sna gh+nā lha r+sha snashā snaX dā pa k+ṣiṃ shāX chos rje rin chen rgya mtshos gsan/ de nas drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po sgyin pa rgya mtsho/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ drin chen bla ma chos rgya mtsho/169
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngades bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /pha par de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po gsang ba rang bsrel gyi za ma rtog ces bya ba'i gzungs/ paṇ+ḍi ta bid+ma ka ra bra lha wa dang / lo tsā ba rtsangs de wan+d+ra rak+ṣi tas bsgyur ba/ byang chub snying po rgyan 'bum nas btus pa'i gzungs/ 'di gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs brgyud sor bzhag gam/ yang na sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen kun snying / slob dbon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa paṇa/ 'phags pa rin po che/ rga lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ sras sher seng / bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ spu ston bsod rgyal/ mkhan chen sher rdor/ chos sgo ba chos she /slob dpon bsod seng / dbus gling grags don pa/ rat+na girti/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/ rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ mkhyen pa'i rtse mo/kun bzang rtse pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ nyi ma gling pa tshul khrims bkra shis/ bsod nams mchog ldan/ rab 'byams chos rje rat+na sa mu tra/ drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma bka' 'gyur ba sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ drin chen bla ma chos rgya mtsho/ des bdag laram dgrangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa'i gzungs paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ ye shes sde gsum gyis bsgyur cing / skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa/ sangs rgyas bdun pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yan lag dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'gyur gong 'dra/sangs rgyas kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'gyur gong 'dra/ 'phags pa me rtog brtsegs ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa dri ma med pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/'phags pa tsan+d+ra gyi yan lag ces bya ba'i gzungs 'gyur sangs rgyas snying po dang 'dra/170
gsang sngags kyi 'byung gnas rgyud g+ne rin po che thob tshug'phags pa rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i snying po'i cho ga'i gzungs dge slong mar ban dkyi tas tho gar gyi yul nas rnyed pa/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 'di'i 'og tu rten cing 'grel bar 'byung ba'i snying po dang / 'di'i dab ma byung / ye shes ta la'i gzungs zhes bya ba gnyis 'dug kyang lung ma byung / 'phags pa sa'i dbang po'i gzungs ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'di la rdo rje gdan ba'i gsan yig bzhin/ rgyal ba'i gsan yig na sa'i snying po'i gzungs gsung ba dang / mkhyen brtse'i gsan 'or sa ba'i dbang po zhes snang ngo / /gdon mi za ba'i gzungs/ gzhan gyis /spya dzño raswā rnyi ༈ n+d+ra dwo/ (3 gh+nā pa/ shā snarnyi palha traṃ )snro pa/ hūm̐ tsho pa bya/ ༵ nāṃ ñtsā gh+nā /shā 'khor bshad pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyud du'ang mi 'gal lo/ /'phags pa sgo drug pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'di rnams kyi brgyud pa ni lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs kyi brgyud pa ji lta ba bzhin no/ /'phags pa chos thams cad kyi yon tan bkod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i gzungs rgya gar gyi mkhan po pra dzā warma dang / su ren+d+ra bo nyi dang / lo tsā d+dhi shaṃ ༷ ༷ ṭ+wāṃ ༷༷/ pyā sh+lau pyā /sa t+pū sde rdo nāṃ ṭī/ two ṭī spra ༷ tram̐/ ṣ+ṭaṃ dī/ ༷ so kun mkhyen/ so 'dzam gling rgyan/ lho pa kun mkhyen/ ko nag pa/ grags seng ba/ kun dga' 'bum/ kun ye/ gzhon tshul/ mgon po 'bum/ bsod rgyal ba/ shar rdor ba/ chos dpal shes rab/ bsod nams seṅge / grags don pa/ bka' 'gyur ba/ rdo rje gdan pa/ rig pa'i glog phreng / bstan pa'i rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang chos rgyal/ ngag dbang grags rgyan/ ngag dbang nor bu/ ngag dbang bzang po/ kun dga' blo gros/ dpal gling ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ bsod nams 171
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngamchog ldan/ chos rje 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal/drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma paṇa chen bka' 'gyur ba sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ drin chen bla ma chos rgya mtsho/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /rig sngags skya rgyal mo sgrol ma mtshog gi gzungs/ 'phags pa gzungs chen mo paṇ+ḍi ta ṭ+wāṃ / hūm̐ dzño/ ḍā gā shī sna/༵ /shātsho pa (spya /rdzu spya ༵ lhar ༵ r+sha ñtsha ༵ spra pa/na ༵ rmo r+yaṃ/ hā&/ paṇ+ḍi ta bi ma la mi tra dang / lo tsā ba bgro rin chen sde'i 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan brgya rtsabargyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ shākya thub pa'i gzungs/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ snang ba mtha' yas rjes su dran pa'i gzungs/ zla 'od kyi mtshan rjes su dran pa'i gzungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa sbyi'i mtshan rjes su dran pa/ rin chen gtsug tor can gyi mtshan rjes su dran pa/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs/ 'di'i rjes su pad+ma'i spyan zhes bya ba'i gzungs dang / su ru pa'i gzungs gnyis 'dug pa ma thob/ 'jigs pa brgyad las bsgrol ba'i gzungs/ khyad par can gyi gzungs zhes bya ba 'di rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs dang 'dra'o/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rtsaba'i rtog pa sum cu rtsadrug pa paṇ+ḍi ta gzhon nu 'bum pa dang / lo tsā ba shākya blo phros kyis bsgyur ba/ 'di la dkyil 'khor gsum yod/ brgyud pa ni/sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs/ rab gsal zla ba/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ swa sti pha la/ ye shes rdo rje/shes rab grub/ kun dga' snying po/ rab 'byor bskyangs/ shes rab bskyangs/ zhi ba snying po/dge mtshan bshes gnyen/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ dad byed go cha/ rin chen bzang po/ rkyang bo chos blo/ bra'o lha 'bum/ bra'o mi mnyam rdo rje/ ldong ston ye shes rdo rje/ zhang bya ru ba/ slo rjen sangs 172

gsang sngags kyi 'byung gnas rgyud sde rin po che thob tshugdpa' chen po shākya rgyal mtshan/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan ba/ rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ mkhyen pa'i rtsemo/ dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal po/ sems dpa' chen bo ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ bsod nams mtshog ldan/ de gnyis ka la mkhas grub rin chen rgya mtsho/ drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen bo sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ drin chen bla ma chos rgya mtsho/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /ma par 'dus pa rin po che rtog gi gzungs bam po brgyad/ le'u bcu gsum pa paṇ+ḍi ta n+t+wa len+d+ra bo nyi dang ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ brgyud pa ni/ rogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ tā ri/rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ gnyan ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ gnyan rin chen grags/gnas brtan dkon mchog seṅge / de'i sras 'og /dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/slo chen sangs rgyas sras/ bde ba can pa ye shes mgon po/ bde ba can pa seṅge rgyal mtshan/gar rig bsod rgyal/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje man gser 'od dam pa dang 'dra'o/ /'phags ba 'od zer can ma zhes bya ba'i gzungs paṇ+ḍi ta a mo lha dang / lo tsā ba ba ri rin sriX ༷nywa hūm̐X ༷ ṣ+ṭaṃ two/ ༷ sngi sri ༷ spya /༷ṅgā ༷ ༷༷pa/ spri ༷ pa spya shaṃ ( na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ bca ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa rgyal ba can zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra/ /dā na shī k+ṣiṃ/ shā shārnyi shā gh+nā spyab ñtsā k+ṣiṃ /shā ༷zlo dzo r+sha pazlo dīstan sprapa /lhan ༵ pha shā snas/ ༵ pa/ gh+nā lha 175

gsang sngags kyi 'byung gnas rgyud g+ne rin po che thob tshugchos rgya mtsho/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug rtor rnam par rgyal ma zhes bya ba'i gzungs (spya ༵ rnying gh+nā sna gh+nā trā k+ham̐ dwo pa m+p+raṃ spras byid/ ༵ shāshādhi r+sha dī sbyi dā/༵ ༷sbyo r+sha/spri shā /sna pa'i rab byed dang po thar lo'i 'gyur/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs dang gcig go /yang gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i gzungs rtog pa dang bcas pa chung ba 'gyur byang med pa/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ ngan 'phro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i gtsug tor rnam rgyal dang 'dra/ 'di'i rjes su gdugs dkar phyir bzlog chen mo zhes bya ba 'dug kyang lung ma byung / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir bzlog pa chen mo mchog tu grub pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs paṇ+ḍi ta pa ra he ha dang /lo tsā ba gzus dga' ba'i rdo rjes bsgyur ba/ brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ gong ma lnga/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ thog ston shes rab rdo rje man ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i gtsug tor rnam rgyal dang 'dra/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i gzungs/de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can lha yul ma chung ba paṇ+ḍi ta ma hā dza na'i rang 'gyur/ kun nas sgor 'jug pa 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad skya snying po dam tshig la rnam par blta ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'di la 'grel bas dkyil 'khor brgyad gsungs/ shes pa thams cad mthar phyin pa sgrub pa'i mchod rten zhes bya 177
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngaba'i gzungs/ mtshod rten gcig btab na bye bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs dang cho ga /'od zer dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i 'od ces bya ba'i gzungs paṇ+ḍi ta brdu ka ra sidha dang / lo tsā ba )sna( ༈ /nā zi ༈ rdzu /sgyur+sha rnyi/ ming ṭ+wāṃ rdzu( gh+nā ṭ+wāṃ pas bdīX /zu ༵༵ nye/ m+p+raṃ hūm̐ sdu papaji /pa rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gzungs paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / skyo 'od 'byung gi 'gyur/ 'phags pa be+e con chen po zhes bya ba'i gzungs paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ gzhan gyis mi zub pa rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs paṇ+ḍi ta su ren+d+ra bo sgyi dang / ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ bar du gcod pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / ye shes lde gsum gyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa thams cad la mi 'jigs pa sgyin pa zhes bya ba bsgyur byed kyi lo paṇa gong dang 'dra/ 'phags pa 'gro lding pa'i gzungs 'gyur gong dang 'dra/ tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i gzungs/ 'di rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs kyi brgyud pa sor gnas so/ /rgyal mtshan rtsemo'i dbung rgyan zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'gyur gong mtshungs/ brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ pun+ya shrī/ steng pa lo tsā ba/ so kun mkhyen/ so 'dzam gling rgyan/ lho pa kun mkhyen/ ko nag pa/ jo gdan zas gtsang / grags seng / rin chen 'bum/ bde ba can pa/ gar thig pa/ shes rab rdo rje/ chos dpal shes rab/ grags rdor ba/ grags don pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje gdan pa/ rgyal ston byang dbang / mkhyen pa'i rtsemo/ kun bzang 〉pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/nyi ma gling pa tshul khrims bkra shis/ bsdugad nams mchog ldan/ rje bad dkar 'dzin pa rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ drin chen bla ma chos rgya mtsho/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad ba'i rdo rje la'o/ /178
gsang sngags kyi 'byung gnas rgyud sne rin po che thob tshuglha mo bskul byed ma'i gzungs/ 'phags pa sgo bzang po zhes bya ba'i gzungs paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ ye shes sde gsum gyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa bu mang bo ston pa zhes bya ba'i tsho( rdzu/ shā pazlos shāspyu zhesnar dī r+sha snapa /byapa(na shā pa~Xng dzño shālha tsho shā/ zlos ༵ /shā spya ba'i rig sngags/ 'phags pa mig nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba/ gzhang 'brum rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i mdo paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la/ ye shes sde gsum gyi 'gyur/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rims nad zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/rims nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ k+ṣa ya'i nad sel ba'i gzungs/ 'di'i rjes su 'brum nad sel ba'i gzungs 'dug kyang lung ma byung / 'di'i rjes su bka' 'gyur la lar dug sel ba'i gzungs zhes pa 'dug kyang bka' 'gyur 'di la med pas ma thob/ mdangs phyir mi 'phrog pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/tsa par 'phags pa yangs pa'i krong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ren+d+ra bo nyi dang /brnye ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa mi rgod rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ bar du gcod pa thams cad sel ba'i gzungs/ 'di rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs dang 'dra'o/ /'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i gzungs le'u dgu pa paṇ+ḍi ta dharma shrī mi tra dang / lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang bos bsgyur ba/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs/ a wa nu 3 pa/ a lha gup+ta/ a shwa ka shrī/ bram ze dharma shrī/ 'gar lo tsā ba/ ston pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ byang sems shes rab rdo rje/ rgya yon tan bzang po/ sa phug pa shākya rdo rje/ sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo mchog pa/ slo chen pa/ bag ston ba/ sher rdor pa/ chos sgo pa/ grags rdor ba/ tshal grags don pa/shākya rgyal mtshan/ rig pa'i slog phreng / bstan pa rgya mtsho/ rgya ngag dbang chos rgyal/ ngag dbang 179
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngagrags rgyan/ ngag dbang nor bu/ ngag dbang bzang po/ bla ma kun slo/ khu ston ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ bsod nams mtshog ldan/ rin chen gyi mtsho/ drin chen gaba'i bla ma khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po sgyin pa rgya mtsho/drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags spru/drin chen bla ma chos rgya mtsho/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /yang na thub pa/ 'jam dpal/ me+e tā ri/rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ mchims brtson seng / mchims don ne+e/ mchims chos seng / mchims blo brtan/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum man bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra/yang na bshad ma thag pa ltar lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs kyi brgyud pa sor gnas so/ /brgyud m+p+raṃ dzño/ /smra sbyo ༷ gh+nā (sdidī pa) misnye pas k+ṣiṃ dzño 'u zlogā rnyi 'asprir+sha dzo r+sha ༈ ṭā pad/dzño hūm̐ pa/ sne'u zur pa/ bya yul ba/ bla ma bsod nams seṅge / mgon bo grags/ dbang phyug mgon bo/dbus ba sangs rgyas 'bum man gong du bshad ma thag pa'i mi g.yo ba'i gzungs dang 'dra/ yang na mi g.yo ba'i gzungs kyi brgyud pa phyi ma ji lta ba'o/ /rnam pa gcig tu na gong gi lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs dang yang 'dra'o/ /'phags pa gser can zhes bya ba'i gzungs paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra/ dā na shi la/ye shes sde'i 'gyur/spyan ras gzigs/byams pa/nam mkha'i snying po/ kun tu bzang po/lag na rdo rje/lan+dam dpal/sgrib pa rnam sel/sa'i snying po rnams kyi mtshan brgya rtsabargyad gzungs dang bcas pa/ 'di rnams kyi brgyud pa ni sngar sgya lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs dang 'dra zhing / lag na rdo rje mtshan brgya rtsabargyad pa'i sgos brgyud lugs gcig ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo khu/rdo rje gdan pa gsum/purje shrī/ steng lo/so thams cad mkhyen pa/ so 'dzam gling rgyan/nyo pa kun mkhyen/ko nag pa/jo gdan zas gtsang /shangs pa grags seng /rin chen 'bum/ bde ba can pa seng rgyan/ gad zig pa/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos dpal shes rab/ grags pa rdo rje/ dbus gling grags 180
gsang sngags kyi 'byung gnas rgyud ñdzi rin po che thob tshul/don/ bka' 'gyur ba/rdo rje gdan pa/rjog shes rab grags/ khams ba brag po che ba/ kun dga' rgya mtsho/rngog dpal 'byor don 'grub/rjog 'jam dbyangs 'od zer/ bsod nams mchog ldan/mkhas grub rin chen rgya mtsho/ drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen bo sgyin pa rgya mtsho/drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/drin chen bla ma chos rgya mtsho/des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ dzi tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ gong ma lnga/ rga lo yab sras/ bag ston pa/ mgon bo 'bum/ spu ston pa/ sher rdor ba/ chos sgo ba/ bsod nams seṅge / tshal grags don pa nas/badrend nams mchog ldan yan 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i gzungs le'u dgu pa'i brgyud pa bzhin la/ de nas rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po/ drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ drin chen slo ma chos rgya mtsho/ des bdag dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /'phags pa dkyil lubor brgyad pa zhes bya ba'i mdo paṇ+ḍita dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la/ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'di'i brgyud pa lugs gcig ni lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs dang 'dra zhing /lugs gcig la chos thams cad kyi yon tan bkod pa'i rgyal bo ji lta ba'o/ /'di'i 'og tu bdud ji 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'dug kyang ma thob/ yi dwags kha nas me 'bar ma la skyabs mdzad pa'i gzungs/ 'di'i rjes su 'jur bgegs sel ba'i gzungs 'dug kyang ma thob/ ye shes skar mda'i snying bo/ shes rab bskyed pa'i gzungs/ zos pa 'dzin pa'i gzungs/'di'i bar du las kyi sgrib pa rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'dug kyang dab ma byung bas lung ma thob/ rgyal ba bla ma'i gzungs/ 'di rnams kyi brgyud ba yang lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs dang 181

kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngaspyan ras gzigs yid bzhin nor bu'i rtog pa las smon lam 'byung ba/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po'i gzungs phan yon dang bcas pa zhes bya ba 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ lo tsā ba ye shes sde gsum gyi 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs spru thams cad kyi yum sgrol ma las sna tshogs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs rgyud le'u sum cu so lnga pa paṇ+ḍi ta dharma shrī mi tra dang / lo tsā ba chos bzang gis bsgyur ba/ spyan ras gzigs gyis gsungs pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsabargyad pa/ yang rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsabargyad pa sgrol ma mchog ces bya ba/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i gzungs/ sgrol ma rang gis dam bcas pa'i gzungs/ 'phags pa grags ldan ma'i gzungs/ 'di rnams kyi brgyud pa ni lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs dang 'dra la/ mtshan brgya rtsabargyad pa gnyis kyi bar du lha mo sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsabargyad pa zhig 'dug kyang lung ma thob/ slol ma las sna tshogs pa'i rgyud le'u so lnga pa'i sgos brgyud ni/ sangs rgyas/ sgrol ma/ kun dga' bo/ nyi ma khung pa/ sha na'i gos can/ kṛt+ta'i gos can/ nyi ma sbas pa/ sgra gcan dpal/ bo rti shrī/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ khro phu lo tsā ba/ rin chen 'bum/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ mchog ldan pa/ slo chen pa/ rgyal bzang dpal/ spang khang pa/ ma ti paṇa chen man sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang gcig /yang na/spyan ras gzigs/ a wa dhu ti pa/ gnyis med sbas pa/ rdo rje gdan pa a shwa ka /'chi med dharma shrī/ 'gar lo chos bzang / glan shes rab rgyal mtshan/ dbas shes rab rdo rje/ rgya rnal 'byor ba yon tan bzang po/ sa phug pa shāka rdor/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum man gong ltar ro/ /yang na/ sgrol ma/ ḍā gi so ma pra bha/ shrī a warta/ bram ze dharma shrī/ 'gar lo chos bzang man 'dra/ yang na/ 'gar lo nas/ gshen rin chen dngos grub/ dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ sgang 192
gsang sngags kyi 'byung gnas rgyud sde rin po che thob tshugston yab sras/ khu ston sher 'bum/ gru rdor seng / rong pa chos mgon/ lo mtshog pa man 'dra/mtshan brgya rtsabargyad pa 9 ma'i sgos brgyud lugs gcig ni/ spyan ras gzigs/ a wa 〉ti pa/ aṅgā gup+ta/ a shwa ka shrī/ dharma shrī/ 'gar chos bzang / glan shes rab rgyal mtshan/ dbas shes rab rdo rje/ rgya yon tan bzang po/ shākya rdo rje/ sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo mchog pa/ slo chen pa/ bag ston pa/ sher rdor ba nas/ chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho yan mi g.yo ba'i gzungs le'u dgu pa'i brgyud pa ltar la/ de nas/ khra tshang pa/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa chen po/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ drin chen bla ma chos rgya mtsho/ 'di 'og tu ral ba gyen rdzes kyi rtog pa bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'gyur zhig 'dug pa ma thob/wa bar lha mo dri ma med ba'i 'od kyis zhus pa'i mdo/ mdo mang skabs song bas brgyud pa yang der yod cing / spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ha ya sgru ba'i gzungs/ phyir bzlog rnam rgyal par+ṇa shawa ri'i mdo/ 'phags ma ri khod ma lo gyon ma zhes bya ba'i gzungs smra baṃ ra dang / ba ri'i 'gyur/'phags pa phyir bzlog pa stobs chen zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ lha mo sgra dbyangs ma la bstod pa/lha mo dpal lung bstan pa'i mdo/ 'phags pa dpal chen mo'i mdo/ dpal gyi lha mo'i mtshan bcu gnyis pa paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ brje ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ mchog thob pa'i rig sngags zhes bya ba/ lha mo dung can ma'i snying bo/ 'di rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs dang 'dra zhing / ha ya sgru wa'i gzungs kyi sgos brgyud lugs gcig ni don yod zhags pa'i snying po'i mdo dang gcig /lo ma gyon ma'i sgos brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rig pa'i lha mo/des byin gyis rlabs pa'i paṇa chen raṇ+ḍa ka ra gubha/ mañdzu ṅgārti/ sa mān+ta shrī/ rwa chos rab rwa ye shes seṅge / rwa 'bum seng / rga lo yab sras/ bag ston/ sher rdor/ chos sgo ba/ bsod nams seṅge / tshal grags don pa man mi g.yo ba'i gzungs le'u dgu pa dang gcig go /las 193
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngakyi sgrib pa thams cad sbyong ba zhes bya ba mi 'khugs pa'i gzungs/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ kun dga' bo/ dgra bcom pa rak+ṣi ta/ kriṣ+ṭha bā sa/ shā na bā sa/ sur+ya ha ba/ sarba dzā mi zlo/na paphalharmo ba klu lkaṃ gh+nā/ stanā de ye wa sgo/ rdzu/ /spya ñtsā ༵ hūṃ/ pas(shāX pa/ge rnyiX /snar+sha dzño ༵ shes/ mkhan chen 'brom/ rin chen bla ma/ bag ston pa nas/ khu ston ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi bar 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i gzungs le'u dgu pa'i brgyud tshul ltar la/ de nas bsod nams mchog ldan/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa chen po/drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/drin chen bla ma chos rgya mtsho/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /phyag na rdo rje rig pa mchog gi rgyud le'u med pa paṇ+ḍi ta brgyu ka ra pra bha dang / dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ 'di cung ma ljags pa 'dra'o/ /brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/je tā ri/ mya ngan med pa'i dpal/rol pa'i rdo rje/ a mo gha badz+ra/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ gong ma gsum/ chos rje sa paṇa/ slob dpon pad+ma mgon bo/ sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo mchog pa/ slo chen pa/ bag ston pa/ mabo na 〈sna 'bum/ bram nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ ma ti paṇa chen man sangs rgyas mnyam sbyongar sor bzhag go/yang na/ sangs rgyas/ phyag rdo ba/ rab gsal zla ba/ dzñā na badz+ra/ a nan+da gar+bha/bradzñā bo 3/ muñtsa ko ṣa/ shrad+dha ka ra/ lo chen rin bzang / lo chung legs she /sum ston ye 'bar/'or ston lha dbang / 'or sangs rgyas 'bar/ lho pa ting la)na dpal bzang / zhig mos seng /zhig chos mgon/ sangs rgyas 'bum man gong dang 'dra/ yang na/ mi g.yo ba'i stobs dpag tu med pa brtul phod pa 'dul bar gsungs pa'i rgyud dang 'dra'o/ /zha pa la rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud le'u nyer lnga pa paṇ+ḍi ta de bzhin gshegs pa'i dpal dang /chos rje sa skya ba'i 'gyur/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ klu sgrub yab sras ma 194
gsang sngags kyi 'byung gnas rgyud sde rin po che thob tshugtaṃ gi ba/ n+da khyu ta de wa/ kha che paṇa chen/ su ga ta shrī/ sa skya paṇa chen/ skyob pa dpal/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ lo mchog pa/ slo chen pa/ rgyal bzang dpal/ spang khang ba/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen man sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor sor bzhag go/yang na/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ me+e tā ri/ mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ a mo gha badz+ra/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ gong ma gsum/ chos rje sa paṇa man gong dang 'dra/ yang na/ ba ri lo tsā ba nas/ mchims brtson seng / mchims don rje/mchims tshos seng / slo gros brtan pa/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ 'on mchog pa man gong bzhin/ yang na/ phur ba gdum dang mthun zhing / lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs dang yang 'dra'o/ /phyag na rdo rje 'byung bo 'dul byed kyi rgyud stong phrag bcu drug pa las ji snyed pa rig par phye ba gnyis pa paṇ+ḍi ta bud+dha ka ra warma dang / lo tsā ba chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni lag na rdo rje be+e con can dang 'dra'o/ /lag na rdo rje gos sngon can kyi cho ga dang bcas pa'i gzungs paṇ+ḍi lha spyan /spya snyeng /rgyaX k+ṣiṃ tshoX /dbyi ṭ+wāṃ pa /sdi ji sna//āX (snashā pa nim/ spya snro k+ṣiṃ /rjesna / yab sras/ chos rje khu dpon/ rgyal tsha chos dbang / rong pa sher seng / bag ston man mi g.yo ba'i gzugs le'u dgu pa'i brgyud pa dang gcig /yang na lha mo brgyad kyi gzugs dang 'dra'o/'di'i 'og tu rmi lam mthong ba'i gzungs 'dug kyang lung ma thob/ lag na rdo rje'i mtshan brgyad gsang sngags dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs dang 'dra'o/ /lag na rdo rje'i snying po brgyad kyi ya gyal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra )( / ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ hūm̐ ༵ ༵ da/spyashā spri rtswa n+tā ba lhas sna ༈ ༵ sbyisbyi ciX lhashā sna /ba (che/ (diX pa/( sku mched/ chos rje khu dpon/'u yug pa bsod nams seṅge /ri phug ba shākya seṅge /lha sdings pa 195
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngadbang lcag rgyal mtshan/sa bzang ma ti/sa bzang 'phags pa/'jam dpal grags pa/ri khrod pa bsod rgyam/ 'jam dbyangs sher rgyam/ dpal ldan rdo rje/ bya 'gyur ba bsod nams seṅge / ru thog pa nam mkha' gzi bajid/rje mkhyen brtse'i zhabs/rje dbang rab/bsod nams mchog ldan/rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa chen po/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ drin chen bla ma chos rgya mtsho/des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad ba'i rdo rje la'o//yang na dpal ldan rdo rje nas/ngor pa dkon mchog 'phel/ rje lha mtshog seṅge / dge legs bshes gnyen/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ thar rtseb khu dbon gnyis/ bathend nams mchog ldan/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa chen po man 'dra/ yang na bsod nams mchog ldan nas/ zur chos dbyings rang grol dang / zha lu pa gnyis das gsan/ de gnyis las rgyal dbang mchog man 'dra'o/ /de'i bshad rgyud rdo rje ri rab chen po'i rtsemo khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzungs paṇ+ḍi ta shī len+d+ra | shaṃ / r+sā / tho//ṭ+wāṃ lha khye/dhī snye / cho ra / / ༷ ༷༷/ /༷ ༷/r+yaṃ/ / /snye/// rgya ston tsan+d+ra de wa/ ri khrod pa bsod rgyam/ chos rje dpal ldan rdo rje/ chos rje dkon mchog 'phel/ lha mchog seṅge / dge legs bshes gnyen/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ bsod nams mchog ldan/ mos rje rin chen rgya mtsho/drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma bka' 'gyur ba sbyin pa rgya mtsho/drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ drin chen bla ma chos rgya mtsho/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /yang na/ sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri lo tsā ba man 196
gsang sngags kyi 'byung gnas rgyud sde rin po che thob tshuggong bzhin/ yang na lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs dang yang 'dra'o/ /rdo rje mi pham pa me ltar 'bar ba rab tu rmongs byed ces bya ba'i gzungs paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ brje ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ brgyud pa ni/ bag ston yan rnam 'joms kyi bshad rgyud kyi brgyud pa phyi ma ltar la/ de nas sher rdor ba/ chos sgo ba/ grags rdor ba/ tshal grags don pa man mi g.yo ba'i gzungs le'u dgu pa'i brgyud pa dang gcig /yang na lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs kyi brgyud pa ji lta ba bzhin no/ /'di'i rjes su rdo rje phra mo thogs med kyi gzungs 'dug kyang ma thob/ lag na rdo rje bcu'i snying po ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ bdud ni thabs sbyor gyi snying po bzhi pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'di gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i 'og tu khro bo sme brtsegs la bstod pa'i gzungs sngags 'dug pa ma thob/'phags pa stobs po che zhes bya ba'i mdo/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ tshal grags don pa yan gza' yum ltar la/ de nas rjog byang chub dpal/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha' dbang phyug /'bum ram pa tshul khrims dbang phyug /dpa' bo chos rgyal don 'grub/ rje dkon mchog yan lag/drung pa grags pa don 'grub/ tshogs gnyis dpal grub/ grub pa'i rdo rje/ khra tshang pa/rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa chen po/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ drin chen bla ma chos rgya mtsho/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi rtog pa le'u bzhi pa/ mar pa chos dbang gis bsgyur ba/ brgyud pa ni/sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ sbyong mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ 'phro bzang snying po/ ma ṇi badz+ra/ kha che te dza de wa/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba/ gnyan tshul 'bar/ 'gos bzang 'bar/ ri nang ba gzhon nu seṅge /la stod dbang rin/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo mchog pa/ slo chen pa/ bag ston pa/ sher rdor ba man mi g.yo ba'i gzungs le'u dgu pa'i brgyud pa dang 'dra la/ yang na lha mo brgyad kyi 197
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngagzungs kyi brgyud pa bzhin no/ /rdo rje mchu zhes bya ba klu'i dam tshig gi /gnam lcags mchu zhes bya ba'i gzungs/'phags pa lcags mchu zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa lcags skya mchu'i gzungs/ 'phags pa lcags mchu nag po zhes bya pa'i gzungs/ 'di rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ me+e tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ ba ri lo tsā/ gong ma lnga/ rga lo yab sras gnyis/ bag ston/ sher rdor ba man mi g.yo pa'i le'u dgu pa'i brgyud pa dang gcig/yang na lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs dang yang 'dra'o/ /nor bu bzang po'i gzungs sho lo ka bco lnga pa paṇ+ḍi ta bibya ka ra sidha dang / lo tsā ba brje klu'i dbang po'i 'gyur/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni gong du bshad pa'i lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs dang 'dra zhing / sgos brgyud la/ rmugs 'dzin/ dza ma ri ba/ na ri pa/ a du la lha sa badz+ra/ bal po thugs rje chen po/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags pa/ rwa chos rab/ rwa 66 seṅge / rwa dkon mchog seṅge / rwa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ slo chen pa/ bag ston/ sher rdor ba man mi g.yo ba'i gzungs le'u dgu pa dang gcig go/nor bu bzang po'i rtog pa paṇ+ḍi ta mañtsa shrī dang / ba ri'i 'gyur/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon gad mkhan mchog gi brtag pa snga phyi gnyis la le'u bcu drug pa paṇ+ḍi ta ha na gup+ta dang / rab zhi lo tsā ba'i 'gyur/ gnod sbyin dpal zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'di'i sgos brgyud ni nor bu bzang po'i gzungs kyi gos brgyud bzhin no/ /gnod 'dzin chu dbang snying rje can gyi gzungs/ 'di'i sgos brgyud kyang nor bu bzang po'i gzungs dang 'dra/ 'phags pa gnod gnas dbang po ji ltar 'grang ba'i rtog pa zhes bya ba paṇ+ḍi ta sgeg pa'i rdo rje dang / rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur ba/ gnod 'dzin gyi mtshan brgya rtsabargyad pa 'di'i sgos brgyud ni nor bu bzang po'i gzungs kyi sgos brgyud sor bzhag go /'di'i rjes su 'phags pa me kha la zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'dug pa ma thob/ rig 198
gsang sngags kyi 'byung gnas rgyud sde rin po che thob tshugsngags kyi rgyal mo dbugs chen po zhes bya ba paṇ+ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / brje ye shes rje'i 'gyur/rin bo che brdar pa'i gzungs/ stong chen mo las byung ba'i sman la sngags kyis gdab pa zhes bya ba'i dpe ma byung bas lung ma thob/ sman gtong ba'i gzungs/ bskor ba bya ba'i gzungs/ mchod rten bskor ba'i gzungs/ yon sbyong ba'i gzungs/ yon yongs su sbyong ba'i gzungs/ phyag bya ba'i gzungs/ gos brgya thob pa'i gzungs/ 'di'i 'og tu mi dga' bar byed pa'i gzungs/ spyan rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ ngan song sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs gsum gyi dpe ma byung bas lung ma thob/ skran zhi ba'i gzungs/ ma zhu ba'i nad zhi ba'i gzungs/ snang ba rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ sdig pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ khros pa zhi ba'i gzungs/khros pa zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ tshig btsan pa'i gzungs/ bdag bsrung ba'i gzungs/ yid du 'ong ba'i gzungs/ mgrin pa snyan pa'i gzungs/don thams cad 'grub pa'i gzungs/ las 'grub pa'i gzungs/ dug thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ bcings pa las grol ba'i gzungs/bdud skrag par byed pa'i gzungs/ rma 'phyor bar byed pa'i gzungs/ me'i zug rngu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ mkhris pa'i nad sel ba'i gzungs/ bad kun gyi nad sel ba'i gzungs/ k+ṣa ya'i nad sel ba'i gzungs/ rims dang srog chags kyis mi tshugs pa'i gzungs/ 'di rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par ljags pa'i sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung gsum/bu〉 shrī/ steng pa lo tsā ba/ so thams cad mkhyen pa/ so 'dzamo gling rgyan/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ ko nag ral sgra/ ral nag ral sgra/ rdzo gdan zas gtsang / mkhan po grags seng / rin chen 'bum/ bde ba can pa seng rgyal/ gar thig pa bsod rgyal/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ mkhan chen grags rdor ba/ chos rje grags don pa/ rngog byang chub dpal/ mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ sman rgyal chos rje nam mkha'adabang phyug/'bum ram 199
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngapa rin chen chos dbang / bla ma bstan pa rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang chos rgyam/ ngag dbang kun dga'/pad+ma dkar po/ ngag dbang bzang po/ chos rje kun dga' blo zos/ sems dpa' chen po ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ drin chen bla ma chos rgya mtsho/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o / /yang na grags don pa nas/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ rdo khu gdan pa/ rig pa'i slog phreng / bla ma bstan pa rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang chos rgyam/ngag dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mang thos ngag dbang nor bu/ grub chen ngag dbang bzang bo man 'dra'o/ /'di'i 'og tu chu sbyin pa/ mchil ma/ snabs/dri chen/dri chu sbyin par gtong ba'i gzungs 'dug kyang lung ma thob/ 'jug pa'i spyod pa dkyil gzhur du dbang bskur ba ston pa gsang ba spyi rgyud paṇ+ḍi ta bid+ma ka ra spru lha dang / rgyal tsho bka' 'grar las/ dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ 'di man chos wo ge la nargyur byang mi rog/brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ bra kā sha tsan+t+ra/ rgyal bu rā hu la/ā nan+ta garta/ ta thā ga ta badz+ra/ shud+dha ka ra warma/ lo chen rin bzang / lo chung legs pa'i shes rab/grags 'byor shes rab/ sa chen/ rje btsun yab sras/ chos rje khu dbon/ slo chen pa/ rgyal bzang dpal/ 'phags pa rin bo che/ ma ti paṇa chen man sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang gcig /yang na/sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ rje btsun sa chen/ rje btsun grags rgyan/ chos rje sa paṇa/ 'phags pa rin po che/ khang ston 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ slo chen pa man 'dra/yang na/ bshad ma thag ba'i nor bu bzang po'i rtog pa sogs kyi gzungs phran mang po'i brgyud pa ji lta ba bzhin no/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod pa khyad par can ston par bsam gtan phyi ma'i rgyud/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni/sangs rgyas/'jam dpal/dzi tā ri/rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ skyu ra a skyabs/rdo 200
gsang sngags kyi 'byung gnas rgyud g+ne rin po che thob tshugrje rgyal po/don 'grub ye shes/ shākya rdo rje/ sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ slo chen pa/rgyal bzang dpal/ gangs khrod pa/ ma ti paṇa chen man sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang gcig /yang na/'og nas 'argyung ba'i dpung bzang gi brgyud pa bar ma dang 'dra/rnam pa gcig tu na gsang ba sbyi rgyud kyi brgyud pa phyi ma dang 'dra'o/ /dzor/sgrupazlo dzño / dī ༷༵༵ par n+dha ji ༷pas( ṣ+ṭṛ dzor+yaṃ risna rnyir n+dha bapa smra( zlodzi dzño rdo rje/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇa chen/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ khang ston 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ slo chen sangs rgyas sras/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal/ spang khang pa/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ ri khrod pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ shes rab rgya mtsho/ dpal ldan lda ྅/ dkon mchog 'phel/ lha mtshog seṅge / dge legs bshes gnyen/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha'adapal bzang /nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ bsod nams mchog ldan/ rin chen rgya mtsho/ drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma bka' 'gyur ba chen po sbyin ba rgya mtsho/ drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ drin chen bla ma chos rgya mtsho/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /yang na/ chos rgyal 'phags pa nas/ pad+ma mgon bo/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ slo chen pa man gong bzhin/ yang na/ nor bu bzang po'i rtog pa sogs gzungs phran mang po'i brgyud pa ji lta ba bzhin no/ /gsang sngags kyi spyod pa thams cad sgyir ston pa dbung bzang gis zhus pa'i rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/me+e tā ri/ shu myu ta sa ma nyi/rdo rje gdan pa che chung gnyis/ n+da k+ṣa ta/ kha che paṇa chen/ dā na shī la/ lo mchog pa/ slo chen pa/ bag ston pa/mgon bo 'bum/ bram nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ ma ti paṇa chen man sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang 201
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngagcig /yang na sangs rgyas/ langam dpal/ tā ri/rdo rje gdan ba che chung / ba ri lo tsā ba/ gong ma lnga/ rmo chen pa man gong ltar ro/ /yang na ba ri ba nas/ mchims ba33 seng / mchims don nai/mchims chos seng / mchims blo brtan/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo mchog pa/ slo chen pa man gong dang 'dra/ yang na lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs dang ro'o/ /yongs su bsngo ba'i rgyal po sngags dang bcas pa ji snyed pa paṇ+ḍi ta bit+yā ka ra spru bha dang /lo tsā ba ye shes snying po dang dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ brgyud pa ni/ gser 'od dam pa le'u nyer dgu pa'i brgyud pa sor bzhag go/yongs su bsngo ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba lo tsā ba rnam par mi rtog pa'i 'gyur/ dgongs pa'i rgyud kyi phreng ba chen po byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par nges pa chen po bstan pa las/ nor bu rin po che la mkhas pa bstan pa yongs su bsngo ba chen po'i rgyal po paṇ+ḍi ta dharma ka ra dang / lo tsā ba dpal 'gror gyis bsgyur ba las/ slar yang bibyāka ra bra bha dang / brje dpal rtsegs kyis bcos ba/ 'di gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ kun dga' bo/kṛhā'i gos can/ sha na'i gos can/ nyi ma gung pa/ rgyal rigs thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gh+nā klo/༵/phasna r+yaṃ r+nghi snro kū/ k+ṣiṃ two dhī/sapa nga da/k+ṣiṃ gh+nā paX spyan/ /swār+sha spyi( dzño/na rtswa ( ga(spya ba sher seng / bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ bsod rgyal/ sher rdor/ chos dpal shes rab/ rin bo che grags don pa/ bla ma rin chen grags pa/ chos rje shākya rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje gdan pa/ blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rin chen chos dbang / tshul khrims dbang phyug /gtsug lag 'phreng ba/ dkon mchog yan lag /rgyal tshab grags don/ tshogs gnyis dpal grub/ khra tshang pa chen po/ bsod nams mchog ldan/ mkhas grub 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal/ drin chen rtsaba'i bla ma khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po sgyin pa rgya mtsho dpal bzang po/drin chen bla ma 'jam dbyangs 202

tsin+ta ma ṇi'i phreng ba phan bde'i rol mtsho/dang / bya 'dab dang / rtse zur phan tshun tha gus sbrel ba la ba dan dang / rnga yab dang / dril bu bar ma chad bas spras pa/ sgyi skor chen po'i ñtsha rol nas shing shin tu ring ba bco lngar ba dan bco lnga phyogs skyong bco lnga'i skus rtog byas pa dang / de'i 'og tu sngags bris pa rang rang gi kha dog can rang rang gi phyogs su btsugs nas nub re bzhin de dag gi rtsaba'i gtor stegs khar phyogs gtor dang / de dag gi bar bar du gdugs dkar gyi rgyal mtshan la sogs pa rang rang gi tsho ga bzhin du btsugs shing / sher mdo ltar ba dan rnams kyi bar du tha gus sbrel bar 'phan dang rnga yab dang / dril bu la sogs pa bar ma chad pas smras pa/ khyams nang ma yan chad la dkar me bzhi brgya tsam dang / sher mdo ltar phyi nang bar gsum gyi khor ra khor yug tu mar me ni bar skor la brgya lhag dang / phyi skor la rdo ring gi 'gram g.yas g.yon jo bo'i zhal drang thad du kong bu chen po phyogs re la 'dom gsum gsum yod pa'i dkar me chen bo dang / phyi skor la khog ma che ba sdong bu lag pa tsam pa mda' tshad kyi mar mes 9 skor gshor ba dang / de bzhin du rwa mo che sogs dang / nang gi khyams 9 ma'i ka tshar grangs dang / yon chab brgya phrag brgal ba kha che gur kum bre du ma nyin re bzhin btab pa/ spos kyi rengs bu mi 'dra ba du ma bsregs pa'i dud pas skor lam khyab cing bar snang la sprin bzhin gshod/ skor lam tshun spos chus chag chag btab/ zhal zas mda' tshad lhag la mar gyi rgyal srid sna bdun sogs kyis sbras pa brgya rtsabargyad re nyin re bzhin du/ rdo ring g.yas g.yon du sa stegs la rtsam khal bzhi brgya re las byas pa'i lha balhags chen po rgyan dpag med kyis sbras pa la ba dan gyi brgyan pa re byas/ gzhan yang gye re man zeng nas gter du bzhes pa'i dngul tham rta mgo ma sogs phul zhing mchod yul mchod rdzas mchod byed thams cad bde stong gis rgyas btab ste phul ba'i me+e/ nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad rigs lnga'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs 227
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngakyis til gyi gang bu ltar gang ba dang / ltang bshags 'don dus de dag gi 'og gzhi tsam gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas so lnga dang sman bla bde gshegs bdun/ byams pa tshe dpag med sgrol ma gdugs dkar dbyangs can ma rnams dang / grub chen brgyad cu ku cor gsung / rje rang gi dbu'i steng na rigs gsum mgon po dkar phyogs kyi chos skyong phal cher yang yod par mkhan chen phyag rdor pa'i gsung las so/ /de dus ku cor pa lha sa'i rags khar mtshams byas yod pa krol nas phyin pas glang chen gdong nas sha ba ri dang phrad cing / grub chen brgyad cu smon lam la phebs pa dang / nam gung grub chen brgyad cus skor ba dang / smon lam byed pa/lha klus bskor ba mthong tshul yang bris na legs/ de'i skya ser gyis skor ba rgyun mi 'chad do/ /bud med zhig gis gtsug lag khang la gobyud nas me srung ba rmis pa dang / skye bo mtha' yas pa skor lam nas nam mkha' la 'gro ba gar 'gro byas pas/ nged cag jo bo la mtshod pas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du 'gro zer ba rmis shing / (mo12༷ jo bo'i mdun du rjes mar me zan sgril rmi lam brtags pa gsum gyis dgon gnas brtags pas dga' ldan bzang ba'i rtags byung / dga' ldan la phebs/ zhabs kyis bcag /rgyal tshab dang 'dul 'dzin sogs kyis dang por sa gzhi brtags pa dang / brtags nas dge 'dun la gsol ba dang / de nas dge 'dun gyis gnang ba sbyin pa dang / lag gi bla bsko ba dang / rdo btegs pa'i mtha' las byung ba'i rung khang gcod pa dang / tshad las ma lhag bar jigs pa sogs kyi phyag len dag zer can mdzad de/ 'jam dpal rtsargyud las/ dus kyi tha ma de la ni/ /sems can kun la mtshog sgyin byed/ /'jig rten nga ni mya 3 'das/ /sa yi steng ni stong gyur na/ khyod nyid byis pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par 'gyur/ /de tshe dgon chen rab dga' ba/ /kha ba can na yod pa yin/ /zhes gsal bar lung bstan pas/ khyod ni rje btsun/ byis pa ni so skye'i tshul 228
tsin+ta ma ṇi'i phreng ba phan bde'i rol mtsho/bzung ba/ sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed pa sangs rgyas 'dra ba 'ong ba ste/ lab snyon gyi rnam bshad chen mo las/ rgyal khrims 'chugs pa'i dus su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gsal bar byed pa'i dge slong gcig 'grang byas pa de da ltar bshad pa'i dge slong grags pa'i mtshan thogs ba 'di yin/ dge slong des bstan pa 'tshol ba mang du byung ba rnams tshar gcod cing / yang dag pa'i don dang bstan pa rnam dag gi khrims srol btod pa ni 'dzam bu'i gling du 'bu sbos rtsog pa'or bskor ba dang / snyigs dus bod du dge slong grags pa'i mtshan can byung nas chos srog btod pa ni mtshungs te/ zhes dang / mdo sde gdams ngag 'bog pa las/ 'bri dang ldan gyi sa mtshams su/ /dga' zhes bya ba'i dgon pa 'debs/ /blo bzang zhes bya'i skyes bu 'argyung / zhes dang / gsang bdag gis/ dbang bskur ri yi 'dabs dag tu/ /btsun mo lding gi ngos phyogs su/ /dge 'dun dpag med 'du bar 'gyur/ /ri ni gang yin 'jam dpal 'chad/ /mnga' ris byang khams kun gyi skyabs/ /phyogs bcur sde dgon rgyas par 'byung / /zhes pa lta bu mang /kra121 de'i tshe 'ol kha bsam gtan gling du bzhugs/ chos mang du gsungs/ gnyal ra grong mkhan po'i dgongs cags kyi 'bul ba gser zho stong / dngul sogs kyi 'bul ba bzhes/gnas der ston mtshams bcad/ bla ma dang yi dam 'jam dbyangs dbyer med la gsol ba drag tu btab/ gsal sgron gyi zin bris btab dus kyi ltas ngo mtshar 'byung tshul rnam thar thad dar 'bri na tshes grangs kyi ltas rim par bris/ gnas ga3ga gis chog / khya122 glang lo'i zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la/ 'jam dbyangs lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dngos su snang ba'i g.yas g.yon byams pa dang 'jam dbyangs bgro ba mdzad pa gnyis kyang snang / dkyil gabor gyi gtso bos rgyan bzang po sna tshogs pas spros pa'i rin po che'i bum pa chus gang ba dar bzang po sna tshogs kyis mgul dkris can rje la ster rtsis kyi phyag 229
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngabrkyangs nas/ bum chu 'di jo bo chen po ati sha snye thang gi skyi chu 'gram na bzhugs dus rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dang / rje btsun byams pa gnyis/ sku gsum dang gcig gang yin la tshos kyi bgro ba mdzad pa'i chu 'dres pa'i chu yin/ 'di jo bo nas bzung ste/ da lta'i bar la lo sum brgya dang bcu song / de bar nyer sa ma rnyed/ da khyod la ster ba yin no gsungs pa rmis/ jo bo'i zugs la mnga' ba'i sku gsum ngo bo gcig dang tha dad tshul/ gsang 'dus kyi sku gsung thugs gcig dang tha dad tshul bzhin mkhyen dgos pa khyod bar du ma rtogs zhes lung bstan pa zhug/ gh+nā rnying 〉pa dzño ༈ :sna r+shadī kau ṇā skyoX k+ṣiṃ ༵ snapa paraslo sa lha /pa n+dha dzo dzosna( gsungs pa'ang de yin no/ /de dus bde mchog gi zhal thang dang tshes bcu'i mchod pa'i rdzas bkod nas shad zan gtong ba yin zer ba'i yi ge gcig mthong ba rmis/ gra123 de nas tshes bzhi'i nub mo rin po che sna tshogs pas sbras pa'i khri zhig gi steng na thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che yin zer ba'i bla ma gcig bzhugs pa des/ dpal gsang 'dus gargyud kyi glegs bam gcig gnang nas 'di'i bdag po gyis shig gsungs pa mjug nas cung ma tshang ngam snyam du gzigs pas thams cad tshang 'dug /de nas phyag gnyis kyis glegs bam de blangs/ hūṃ badz+ra khu tiṣ+ṭha zhes pa'i sngags phyag rgyas lan gsum dbu'i steng du btegs/ khar sang nub sngon ma la bum pa chus gang ba ster rtsis byed pa'ang 'di'i ltas yin par 'dug dgongs pa byung ngo / / dra124 tshes lnga par mar pa'i thugs bcud bsre 'apo'i skor mang du yod par zugs nges byung / cu125 tshes drug la chos longs sprul gsum gyi bsre ba skor dgu 'phags pa yab sras dang rgyud kyi dgongs par nges pa sngon med rmad byung brnyes/4126 tshes bdun par rtogs bsre ste spyod bsdus gzigs pas gnyid dang rmi lam gyi 230

tsista ma ṇi'i phreng ba phan bde'i rol mtsho/chen po gsang mtho ba mis brdungs pa min par nges pa byung / 'bras spungs nas phebs dus nas slo bur du sa yang yang g.yo ba 'ja' kha dog sna lnga 'do lir zug pa byung / wa146 de nas gru bzhi nas dga' ldan du phebs pa na thog mar yangs pa can du mchod gtor rgya cher bshams nas ston pa'i sku dang gzhal yas khang dang yi dam gyi drung du smon lam dang 'phrin las bcol ba rgya cher mdzad/ sha147 de nas 'du khang du mang ja la gdan drangs pa med par phebs nas tshogs dbur phebs te bsdo ba rgyas par mdzad pa'i mjug du bde smon gyi bsdo ba rgyas par mdzad cing / dge 'dun tshogs pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su shis brjod rgyas par gnang ba phyis kyi rten 'brel che bar dgongs/ 4148 de nas gzim khang la phebs/ bsnyung tshul bstan/ sang nyin 'dul 'dzin rgyal tshab sogs yod dus rgyal tshab kyis zhal ta 'dra bdag tshor gnang bar zhus pas/ paṇa zhwa leb 'jog dbur bzhag pa rgyal tshab sku pang du 'phangs shing gos zer gcig gtad nas don 'di go bar gyis la byang chub kyi sems sbyongs gsungs shing gdan sar yang don gyis bskos par mdzad do/ /de nas bde mchog gi tshogs gabor byas nang mchod lan so gnyis myang ste rdor bzlas mdzad cing / sang nyer lnga'i snga dro dang por zhabs skyil krung phyag mnyam gzhag mdzad cing 'od gsal chos sku mdzad nas/ bar do longs spyod cags skur sangs rgya tshul bstan te/ sku gzhon nu'i lus can 'ja' 'od 'phro can/nam mkha' nas me rtog gi char dang 'ja' sogs mdzad do/ / 3149 dpa' bo mkha' 'gro grangs med pas spyan drangs te bar dor longs sku las rmad byung bkod pa sogs su sprul sku'i mdzad pa yin te/ dpal gsang 'dus lha so gnyis kyi rten bsten pa sogs su bzhengs par mdzad de rmad byung bkod pa sogs su mchog gi sprul skur mdzad la/ gdams ngag las/ de nas 'phos nas shar phyogs su/ /rmad byung bkod mdzes zhing khams su/ /seng ge'i nga ro zhes 241
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngabya ba'i/ /rgyal ba de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing / de bzhin du bde ba can du rgyal sras skya tshul dang / dga' ldan du rje btsun byams mgon gyi mdun du pad+ma las rgyal sras 'jam dpal snying por zhakhrungs shing chos nyan pa sogs sprul pa bye ba phrag brgyas 'jig rten gyi khams 'di la sogs par la lar bla ma dang / la lar yul gyi rgyal po dang / gtso bo dang / bram ze la sogs pa'i tshul dang / zhing khams la lar sangs rgya ba'i tshul sogs mtha' yas pas 'gro ba gang la gang 'dul gyis sprul pa'i bkod pa mtha' yas pas 'gro ba drangs par mdzad/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs dang dus kun tu rgyas par gyur to/ /smras pa/sngon byon rgyal ba dpag med sngon du'ang / /tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i gting zab legs smin gyi/ /nor bus gtams pa'i snying stobs rba rlabs la/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal rnams dgyes 'dzum byin brlabs pas/ /thub pa'i bstan la thub dbang gnyis pa bzhin/ /bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan bstan pa yongs ljags su/ /thos pas snying tshim thos bsam sgom gsum kun/ /gcig min phyogs bcur gcig char 'phel rgyas mdzad/ /mgon po khyod kyi yon tan pha mtha' bzhin/ /ma lus brjod min dang bas 'dir 'bad dge /sngon zugs bskyed bzhin mdo sngags zab rgyas kyis/ /'gro kun sku gsum thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /khyod la dad dang rnam pa ra thar pa 'di/ /mthong thos dran reg skye dgu ma lus pa/ /mngon mtho'i ba gam mthon po rim brgyud de/ /rgyal dbang seng ge'i nga ro ltar gyur cig /ces mnyam med rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po'i rnam thar 242
tsin+ta ma ṇi'i phreng ba phan bde'i rol mtsho/ras ris kyi tshul brgya dang nga gsum tsin+ta ma ṇi'i phreng pa thub bstan rgyas byed phan bde'i rol mtsho chen po zhes bya ba 'di yang / rje bla ma de nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa shākya'i dge slong mang zos 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes rnam thar ras ris chen mo 'bri tshe mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs dang gsang ba'i rnam thar/ ches cher gsang ba'i rnam thar gsum dang / grub pa'i dbang phyug legs bzang pa'i rnam thar rab gsang rmad byung dang / 'jam dbyangs dang dngos su mjal ba'i rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i zur 'debs dang / mkhas dbang gung ru rgyal mtshan bzang po'i rtogs brjod 'grel ba legs bshad sgron me dang / gnas rnying kun dga' bde legs kyi pyi dang gsang ba'i rnam thar gnyis ka tshang ba'i dad pa'i 'jug ngogs dang / 'jam dbyangs kha che'i tsong kha brgyad cu sogs rnam thar dang / rang phyogs kyi khri rin po che rin chen 'od zer dang las chen kun rgyal/ mkhas dbang paṇa chen bsod grags/ pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub dang / mkhar nag pa sogs kyi chos 'byung du ma dang / deb sngon sogs rang gzhan gyi chos 'byung du mar brten nas go rim sogs legs par bsgrigs pa 'dis kyang kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang / khyad par 'jam mgon tsong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa sgo thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /243
