lam rim gyi rnam bshad lung rigs gter mdzod/da༅༅/ /kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i gsung 'bum las byang chub lam rim gyi rnam bshad lung rigs gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs 31/ /na mo gu ru mañtsa shrī k+to ṣā ya/ bslab gsum rin chen tshogs kyis rgyud gtams shing / /mang du zos pa'i gting mtha' mi mngon pa/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rba rlabs gal chil g.yo//lung rtogs chu gter rtsaba'i bshes la 'dud//slob pa'i dus nas snyigs ma'i 'gro 'drin snying stobs srid na rab brtan pa'i//rgyal dang rgyal sras kun gyis pad+ma dkar po ltar bsngags me tog gis//mkha' khyab 'og min rtser song grags dkar ba dan mthon po lhang nge ba//mnyam med 'gro ba'i bla ma zas gtsang sras de'i zhabs bad gtsug na mdzes//mgon de'i zab rgyas chos kyi chu bo kun//sa gsum skal ldan gling du phel mdzad gar//sna tshogs ston mdzad mi pham bla ma dang //rgyal ba'i yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud//tshig re don brgyas bshad kyang mi rogs rgyal ba'i yum//lung bzhin rigs pas dgongs don gsal mdzad pa'i//shing rta chen po klu sgrub thogs med gnyis/ /thub bstan bcu gnyis rgyan gyur nyi zla bzhin/ /shing rta chen po 245
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngagnyis kyis legs bkral ba'i/ /zab mo'i lta ba rgya chen spyod pa'i lam/ /ma nor yongs ljags pa/ sna spras gaspriX snarmirdo dzo snang/ /nāṃ dwo papa kāpa rnyisdi spra sdus smras rnyil klu/ /sta k+ṣiṃ hūm̐ /pa( skar srin po khyim gyi lha sogs gabor tshogs dbus/ /'dzum mdzad mang pos lung bstan ma 'ongs kha ba can nang dgon chen dang / /sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par lung bstan rgyal pa gnyis par gus phyag 'tshal/ /phyogs re tsam min mdo sngags ma lus pa'i/ /tshig don mgon de'i bzhed pa dpyis phyin pa'i/ /'chad mkhas sras mchog shing rta che lta bu/ /mkhas shing grub brnyes mang pos nor 'dzin 'gengs/ /mdo rgyud kun don skyes bu gsum lam pu /nyams len gnang gsal shing rta che gzhung bzhin/ /rnam 'grel tsam zhig rang blo sbyangs phyir dang / /chen po'i bkas bskul bzhed pa sgrubade lta dī/sra rna/ ma/ 'dren zla med dam pa thub pa'i dbang pos gdul bya'i khams bzhin du mdo phyogs chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong dang sngags la dbyangs gsal gyi mtha' can sgya rgyud sde stong phrag so gsum bshad pa mtha' dag gi don paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis bshad/ grub thob rnams kyis man ngag gis rnam par phye ba ma lus pa 'di ni sangs rgyas sar bgrod pa'i skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa chen mor grags pa rgyal ba gnyis pa'i ring lugs 'di'i tshig don ci rigs kyi cha rnam par 'grel ba la/klad kyi don dang / gzhung gi don dang / mjug gi don gsum/ dang po la mchod brjod dang / rtsom par dam bca' ba dang / skal lngan mkhas pa rnams la nyan par bskul ba gsum/dang po la bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal ba dang / ston pa la bstod cing phyag 'tshal ba dang / bstan pa spel pa'i ched du sras brgyud bla ma dang bcas par bstod pa gsum/246
lam rim gyi rnam bshad lung rigs gter mardzod/dang po ni/ thog mtha' bar gsum du bkra shis pa'i ched du dang / sgrib gnyis dag pa sdig pa sel ba sogs kyi ched du rje btsun gyi mtshan tsam brjod kyang 'grub pa ni/ mtshan brjod las/ thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba/ /mtshan ni yang dag brjod pa'i mchog /ces dang / 'gro la phan pa'i don du khyod/ /ye shes lus can 'jam dpal gyi/ /ming brjod ba ni don che ba/ /dag par byed cing sdig sel ba/ /zhes pa ltar yin pas/ des na bla ma lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal ba ni/ na mo gu ru mañdzu ghoṣā ya zhes gsungs pa bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal 'o(/ /zhes pa yin te/ na ma'am na mo ni phyag 'tshal ba'am 'dud pa/ gu ru ni bla ma dang smi ba dang brlang ba gong ma sogs las 'dir bla ma dang mañdzu 'jam pa dang / māṣā sgra'am skad dam dbyangs la 'jug /ming mtha'i ring ga dang ya ni dgos ched kyi tshig go /de yang mdo lde rgyan las/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la mkhas bar ma byas na/ /'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid mi 'thob ste/ /de bas gzhan dag tshar bcad rjes su bzung phyir dang / /rang nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson byed/ /ces pa gnas lngar ma sbyangs na 'phags pa dgra bcom pas kyang thams cad mkhyen pa mi 'jub cing / so so'i dgos pa sgra dang tshad mas gabrul ba tshar gcod cing / bzo dang gso bas rjes su bzung ba/ nang don rig pas kun shes bar bshad pa ltar yin pas/ 'di'i tshig gi slo 'dogs gcod pa'i ched du sgra sgrub dī sdipa zlopa m+b+ya kau ji pa/spya rdzu stasna ci dzi snaX dī k+to k+ṣiṃ rnyirnyi / nga/spra k+ṣiṃ dzño pas//༵༵ spyi) ṭ+wāṃ ṭī ༵ lha /ṭ+wāṃ rdzu( ljangs/ smadaX r+yaṃ stanā ༷tsha/ṭ+wāṃ shārnyi m+p+raṃ sprapa ༵༵ ༵ ṭ+wāṃ /ji ༈ si/ rnyi( ka lā pā las gsal byed las zhes pas si dbyi/ ka lā thā las re pha dang zhes pas/ nam sra 247
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngakyis rnam bcad byas/ na ma2grub ste phyag 'tshal lam 'dud ces so/ /uṇa las/ k+ṣ-i t+pā dag gi khur yang ngo / /zhes pa'i k+ṣ-i rnam par g.yeng / k+ṣ-i nges par gnon pa la'o/ /zhes pa'i nges par gnon pa'i byings k+ṣ-i bzhag /uṇa las da'i rkyen ku byin/ u bzhag /kra ka la yaṇa bzhin sgya don yin pas phyis/ 'di nyid las ṇ+ḍata kyi u ra yang ngo / /zhwa'i ñtsā khur byas/ mtshams sbyar pas/ gu ru/ si byin/ i phyis/ re pha dang sa dag gi rnam bcad byas/ gu ru ste bla ma'am gong ma'o/ ñtsa mdo'i byings mañdzu bzhag /rjes 'brel phyis/ u rkyen drug pa'i nga si byin/ dra dang i phyis/ as bzhag /ka lā pā las nga si ngas dag gi a dbyi/ rtags mtha' yon tan mañdzu grub ste/ 'jam pa'o/ /gu 〉nga sgrogs pa/ a tsa rgyan/ khu pa lha yon tan byas pas/ k+to khu grub ste dbyangs sam skad do/ /ka lā pā las/ der gnas rnam dbye rnam dbye 'os rnam dbye phyes/ mañdzu gho khu grub ste 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ de la rnam dbye bzhi ba'i gcig tshig de byin/ dra phyis/ tsan+t+ra pa las/ de nga si dag gi ya arla dag go zhes pas/ de ya byas/ ka lā bā las/ de ya'o/ /zhes dang / a yig sgra ldan la ring po'o/ /zhes pas gho dzi'i ā ring po byas pas/ na mo gu ru mañdzu nyo ṣā ya grub ste/ bzhi ba'i gcig tshig mdzad pas brjod bde khyad ma gtogs bla ma dang 'jam dbyangs zhes so sor byed rgyu min pas daphyod ldan rnams kyis yid la zungs/ mtshan r+shaspya dī pa'i sbyinā shāng (( sna( )sna gyi/ ༵ // ñtsā the dī/ra rnyi( /dri spyagam pad spri rtsonam rlob rnyiji las/nyon mongs nye ba kun nyon mongs/ /bag chags bcas pa gtan spangs pa/ /zhes pa ltar nyon mongs ba'i cab reg dang bral bas na 'jam pa/ zhes rje rin po ches gsungs pa gtso bo yin/ snyan pa yid du 'ong ba'i gsung gis bdag med nam mkha'i mthar shug par sgrogs pas na dbyangs te/ mtshan brjod 'grel chen las/ snyan pa yid du 'ong ba'i gsung dang ldan pas na 248
lam rim gyi rnam bshad lung rigs gter mdzod/'jam dbyangs so/ /chos thams cad bdag med pa'i sgra chen po sgrogs pas sgra che ba'o sogs gsungs te/ 'jam dbyangs rgyal ba kun gyi yab tu gyur ba yang chos bshad ba'i sgos yin te/de ni dpal ldan zla grags dang mkhas grub chen po 'jam dbyangs grags pa dang legs ldan gyi rtog ge 'bar ba sogs las bshad pa'i phyir te/ lung mang du dogs nas ma bris so/ /des na sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed skya mtshan bskal bar brjod pa dang / rje btsun 'di'i mtshan lan re brjod pa mnyam par gsungs pa'i phyir te/ mtshan brjod 'grel chen du mdo drangs pa las/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi mtshan mchog tu dad pas bskal ba'am bskal ba las lhag par brjod na bsod nams ci tsam skye bar 'gyur zhe na/ de la grangs med cing tshad med pa rab tu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /yang rigs kyi bu'am rigs rmya bu mo gang la la zhig gis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan bzung ne snga ma las 'di nyid bsod nams kyi phung po shin tu mang po rab tu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du gyur ba'i pyir ro/ /zhes sogs dang / slob dpon shalta bas kyang phar phyin zeg ba'i 'jam dbyangs ni bskal ba mtha' yas pa'i gong du rgyal bo nam mkha'i dus de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal bo las sems skyed/ dge slong rgyal ba'i blo kros dus sa bcu thob cing bskal ba brjod kyis mi langs pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gzigs su lung bstan pa yin/ gsang sngags kyi skabs su dka' 'grel las/ e ma ho sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /'jam dbyangs ngag ni yin par dgongs/ /gang phyir shes rab gzugs med kyang / /dbyangs nyid du ni dmigs pa yin/ /zhes drangs nas sna tshogs sprul pa dang / 'grel chen las kyang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos longs sprul sku 249
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngasngags thams cad kyi ngo bor bshad pa yang mdzad pas sna tshogs sprul tshul yin no/ /de ltar bshad pa gus pa bskyed pa'i ched tsam yin snyam pa sel ba'i ched du de nas sogs gsungs par bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ phun tshogs dge legs sogs zug lo ka gcig byung / phun tshogs la skad dod saṃ bā da phun tshogs dang / saṃ ba ti 'byor ldan nam phun tshogs dang / shrī dpal lam g.yang dang / lak+ṣi phun tshogs sam dpal lam shis pa sogs yod/ des na dge ba dang 'byor ba kun kyi gnas yin pas phun tshogs dang / dge legs la ming bcu bdun te/ paṇ+ḍi ta dpal 'dzin gyis mngon brjod mu ltag phreng ba las/ dge dang bkra shis dge legs bzang / /ma dram shu snyam skal ba dang / /skal ldan legs ldan ngan sel dang ༈ /bde ba mtho ris mtho ris gnas/ /zhi ba lhasnesham bde legs/ /zhes dang / 'chi med mdzod lo grags 'gyur las/ dge dang bsngags 'os zhi ba dang / /bzang po phan thob bkra shis legs/ /skal ba skal thob 'dod thob dang / /ngan sel bde legs mo ma yin/ /bstod 'os zhes gsungs pa ltar dge ba yang ngo bo kun slong ci rigs kyis khyad par du 'phags pas/ dge legs te bsngags par 'os pa dang bstod par 'os pa rna ba bye ba ri'i rtogs brjod ltar bye ba ste grangs mi langs pa du ma sangs rgyas kyi ba spu re'i rgyu la yang dgos te/ 'jig rten khams kyi mtha' med pa'i nyan rang skye 'phags kun dang 'jig cen pa'i skye bo kun gyi bsod nams bcur bsgres pas ba spu'i bu ga gcig 'grub la/ de bzhin du ba spu'i bu ga thams cad la so so'i de 'dra re dgos pa'i phyir te/ blo gros mi zad pa dang dkon mchog sprin ltar du/ rin chen phreng ba las rang sangs rgyas kun las byung dang / /slob dang mi slob las byung dang / /'jig rten ma lus kun bsod nams/ /'jig rten bzhin du dpag med gang / /de bcur bsgres par gyur ba yis/ /ba spu'i bu 250

kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngate byang chub sems dpa' chen po rmi lam gyi nang na yang chos thams cad rmi lam dang 'dra ba spra (spri spra pas rming/ hā ( /spya shā m+p+raṃ rnyisna( ṭ+wāṃ paX dīr+sha k+ṣiṃ /sna ñtsha ṅgi sdidī gh+nā ( ༷sdi phyir mi ldog pa'i rtse mos pyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid du rig par bya'o/ /zhes dang / nyi snang las/ de ltar shes rab dang thabs kyis yongs su zin pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rnal 'byor gyi chos bsgom pa'i rtse mo thob pa gang yin pa ni rmi lam gyi nang du yang 'di'i rnal 'byor dang lhag mthong yid la byed pas sems can thams cad kyi khams la stos pa dang bcas pa nyid du gnas pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa ni thegs pa'i rim pa'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can brnyes pa ste/ bstod pa las/ gsang sngags zeg pa'i gzhung ltar na/ /sbyor pa'i lam pa yin par gsal/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /zhes byung / thun mong ma yin pa mdo sngags gnyis las sngags rmya yang rgyud sde 'og ma gsum dang shun mong ma yin pa bla med kho na'i lam ni pañdzasra /pa spya spyasdi spra ༵༵ daspri /sna ༵ lta dzño /sdi ṅgi/saza ༵ zlo(pa gh+nā )pa spra ( ༈ /pa kyang thob yod/ bla med kyi rjogs rim dga' bzhi stong bzhi rnam dag skye dus sbyor lam bzod ba yan kyi rtogs pa skye bar 'gyur te/ rim gnyis myur 'jug las/ bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i tshe na phar phyin dang shun mong pa'i sbyor lam bzod pa man gad de'i dus nyid nas skye zin la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sbyor lam ni bsam gtan nas skye ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs zug/ /gsal slon las/ ljags rim dus su sngags kyi sbyor lam zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa rgyal tshab kyi sbyor drug gi khrid/ rim gnyis myur 'jug dang / ba so ba'i sbyor drug gi ljags 300
lam rim gyi rnam bshad lung rigs gter mdzod/rim gyi khrid dang skal bzang 'jug ngogs gnyis dar sngar ltar bshad pa rje rin po che'i bzhed pa dri ma med pa yin te/ 'dir dbang ma thob par gsang slogs su song dogs nas lung khungs las ma bris te/ jo bo lha cig gis kyang de lta bu'i ldogs rim mtshan nyid pa stong rkyang la phyag chen du btags pa tsam ma yin pa'i sngags kyi 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po grub snying sde bdun nas yang yang bsngags pa tshe gcig gi 'tshang rgya'i lam rnyed par bshad pa yin no/ /gsum pa bstan pa la bya ba mdzad tshul la/ rgya gar du mdzad tshul dang / bod du mdzad tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ dpal rdo rje'i gdan byang chub chen po'i pho brang du mu stegs kyi smra ba ngan ba lan gsum du chos kyis pham par mdzad nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bzung zhing / zhes pa nas/ thams cad kyis ni lung yang len/ zhes 'byung ba ltar ro/ /zhes byung / 'di la log smra tshar bcad pa'i che ba dang / rang sde'i ma rtog log rtog bsal ba'i che ba dang / phyogs ris med par sde ba kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan du gyur ba'i che ba gsum las/ dang po ni/ dpal rdo rje'i gdan zhes bskal pa 'jig dus yang 'di me chu rlung gsum gyi 'jig pa gang gis kyang mi 'jig par nam mkha' la skar ma ltar sdod pa dang / dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad 'tshang rgya ba'i gnas yin/ der thub pa'i sku ma hā be〉'am byang chub chen po zhes pa yod cing / gtsug lag khang mang bo yod/ der jo bo skor ba mdzad cing byams snying rje byang chub kyi zugs sbyong ba mdzad cing bzhugs dus mu stegs kyi smra ba ngan pa lan gsum du tshos kyis pham par mdzad pa yin te/ jo bo der thugs sbyong mdzad cing bzhugs dus gcig lho phyogs nas mya stegs pa'i paṇ+ḍita gdugs bcu gsum phub pa gcig byung nas/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bdag po ni khyod yin/ mu stegs bstan pa'i bdag po ni kho bo yin pas rang cag gnyis rtsod la su rgyal ba 'jug dgos zer nas/ rgyal bo dpang byas brtsad pas/ jo bos tshegs med par tshar bcad pas/ gdugs 301
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngabcu gsum po jo bo la phul/ zhabs sbyi bo'i gtsug tu blangs/ slob ma byas nas phyi rol pa de thams cad nang ba'i bstan par btsud do/ /yang sang phod lo dus su mu stegs pa'i ston pa gdugs brgyad phub pa gcig byung pas snga ma bzhin tshar bcad/ de'i sang phod mu stegs skya ston pa gdugs lnga phub pa sgra tshad la shin tu mkhas pa gcig byung nas/ snga ma bzhin zer ba la jo bos kyang rtsod par zhal gyis bzhes/rtsod pa'i dus btab/ rgol phyir rgol gyi gdan bshams/panyi ta mang po dang skye bo'i tshogs 'dus pa'i dbus su brtsad pas/ panyu ta sum cu tsam gyis go gzhan gyis mi go/de nas bco lnga tsam gyis go/de nas phra bar gyur pas rim bzhin bcu dang /de nas lngas go /de nas rab tu phra bas kho rang gnyis kyis go /gzhan gyis mi go bar gyur pa der mu stegs des tshigs bcad gcig dris pas/ khyod der sdod gsungs nas/ jo bo sgrol ma la maṇ+ḍal phul gsol ba btab pas thugs la wal gyis byung nas lan btab nas paṇ+ḍi ta tshar bcad de slob mar byas zhes yaṣ+ṭi paṇ+ḍitas dge bshes lo tsā ba la lo rgyus zhib par gsungs pa ltar yin te/ brgyad cu ba las/ byang chub chen po'i pho brang pu /thams cad 'dus shing 'tshogs pa na/ /rang dang gzhan gyi sde pa yi/ /grub mtha' bad pa'i rgol ba kun/ /siṅga'i nga ro'i sgra skad kyis/ /thams cad kyi ni klad pa 'gems/ /zhes dang / lhang ga lar phyi nang gi rtsod pa chen po byung nas/ nang pa'i phal che ba mu stegs pa la lhasnar zhing mu stegs pa'i rtsod pa bzlog pa ma rnyed dus/ bu mo gcig gis jo bo ku su lu'i gas byas pa'i lus la 'od 'phro ba mthong nas gnas brtan la/ sbrang po lus la 'od 'phro ba gcig 'dug zhus nas/ gnas brtan gyis jo bor shes nas zhu ba phul bas zhal gyis bzhes nas/ mu stegs pa thams cad tshar bcad/ sngar lhagar pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta thams cad tshur la thob cing bstan pa bskyangs pa yin lte/ bstod pa las/ khyod kyi mkhas pa mthong ba yi/ /brda' la brdar pa'i skyes bu yin/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi rgol pa ni/ /kun kyang 302
lam rim gyi rnam bshad lung rigs gter mdzod/tshar bcad pham par mdzad/ /ces so/ /de bas na rang gi sde pa gong 'og gi bstan pa la'ang ma rtogs log rtog ze tshom gsum bsal nas lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rgyas par mdzad pa yin te/ rgyal po ma hwa pā la'i ring la bi kra ma shī la'i gtsug lag khang du spyan drangs/ lde mig brtswa brgyad kyi bdag po mdzad nas/ dge slong nyi shu'i sde gcig gis gra yang btsug/dge slong ci bde ba kha cig gnas dbyung yang mdzad cing bstan pa'i dri ma bsal bar mdzad pa'i phyir te/ bstod pa las/ bdag dang gzhan sgya rgol ba ni/ /kun kyang tshar bcad pham par mdzad/ /ces dang /brgyad cu pa las/ khyod ni sde pa ba〈sna brgyad kyi/ /kun gyi sgyi la bzhugs pas na/ /thams cad kyis ni lung yang len/ /zhes can/ /gsum pa ni/ des na sde pa kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan du 'dzin te/ de ltar phyi rol ba dang rang sde'i grub mtha' ngan pa thams cad lung rigs kyis tshar bcad/ ma ga ha ste ma r+ya dbus dang ā ga ra 'gyur ba dang dhā ra 'chang ba ste/ sgra gzhung las ma ga dhā la sogs pa rnams so/ /zhes (ka/ ༈ ṭ+wāṃ lha:sna |shā rnyi (/ k+ṣiṃ che ṭ+wāṃ dī pa' k+shi/ ༵༵/saka 'alta( hūm̐ ༵ shā druṃ sgrar+sha spyadapa sbyo zlo gh+nā ༵ hūm̐ k+ti dī kli ñtsā tshupa shā /spra ṭ+wāṃ gh+nā m+p+raṃ gh+nā lha(shu lhasna kāX gā ṭ+wāṃ spyaX par n+dha sulha pa/ na rab tu byung ba dang / rnal 'byor ba ku sa liṃ ba dang / mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs pa de thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu ltar 'dzin cing / n+da kra ma la'i snga gdong pa~X padī snaXn ṭ+wāṃ sdi sgrupa/sto/ rdzu dri dī la dzā hūm̐ snro paspri /sa (pa sbya sna (3 ༵ sna rnyiji pa) gsum/ /n+da kra ma ni shī la na/ /rab byung brgya phrag ma 'o(nga tsam/ /rtsaba'i sde bzhi tshang bar 303
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngabzhugs/ /sde pa'i khengs dregs mi mdzad pas/ /ma ga dhā yi yul gyi ni/ /gnas gzhi ma lus thams cad kyi/ /ston pa'i gshor ni bzhi po yi/ /kun gyi gtsug gi nor bur gyur/ /ces gsungs so/ /yo tan+ta bu ri kha cig 'bur lding zer yang mtsho gcig bsub nas gtsug lag khang byas pas mtsho sbas krong dang / n+da kra ma shī la rnam gnon ngang tshul lo/ /gnyis pa bod du mdzad tshul la tshos la log rtog bsal zhing srol gsar du btod pa dang / tshangs spyod dang bslab gsum gyi gnod pa bsal tshul dang / bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyu ngos bzung ba dang / nge gsum so so nas tshang bar bshad pa dang / bstan 'gro'i don mdzad pa'i 'bras bu slob ma'i khyad par lnga/ dang po ni/ lha bla ma khu dbon gyis lo ts+tsha ba rgya brtson 'grus siṅga dang / nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba gnyis rim pa bzhin rgya gar du brdzangs te 'bad pa chen pos yang dang yang zhes pa nas/ bstan pa rin po che dri ma dang bral bar mdzad do/ /zhes byung / 'di la lha bla ma khu dbon gyis lo ts+tsha ba rgya brtson seng dang nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba gnyis la gser tshan che ba bskur nas/ rgya brtson seng gis jo bo la/ bod du bstan pa dar yod pa glang dar gyis bstan pa bsnubs pa dang a tsa r+ya dmar pos sngags bsgyur pas/ rab byung thams cad phab par byas/ sham thabs sngon bo can bya ba gcig gis kyang sbyor ba dang sgrol ba bya ba'i tshos log sna tshogs bstan nas bstan pa 'grib par zugs pas bod rgyal gyis khyed spyan 'dren du btang pa na ning bzhin mi gsungs par zhu sogs snga phyir yang yang zhus pas zhal gyis bzhes te/ 'od gangs can sgya bltan pa'i srog shing lha chen po bla ma byang chub 'od kyi ring la spyan drongs te/ jo bo chu rta la gabrungs shing / nga dgu bzhes pa'i dpa' po zhes ba lcags 'brug la 'dab btegs/ khyu ma〈snag ces pa lcags sbrul la bal yul du phebs nas lo gcig bzhugs/ re gcig pa chu rta la mnga' ris su byon nas las rgyu 'bras dang 304
lam rim gyi rnam bshad lung rigs gter mdzod/sems bskyed las brtsam pa'i chos gsungs shing / mdo sngags tsha grang ltar mi 'gal bar mdo sngags thams cad gdan zog gcig tu nyams su len tshul skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim byang chub sgron ma brtsams shing bshad pas theg pa gsum dang mdo sngags kyi gnad la phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa dang the tshom pa'i dri ma chos spong gi nyes spyod kyi mun tshogs thams cad lhag ma med par bsal pas sku drin bsam gyis mi khyab/ re gsum bzhes pa'i nyi sgrol byed ces pa shang pho sbre'u la pu rangs su bzhugs pa'i tshe dge bshes ston pa rang lo 3ra gcig gi dus su rdzo bo dbus su gdan drangs te/ re drug bzhes pa'i me mo phag gi lo la bsam yas su phyag phebs/ lo de'i mjug snye thang du phebs la/ lo 'dir snye thang du byams 'jam dbyangs chos kyi bzo ba mdzad pa'i bum chu byin/ re dgu pa rnam 'gyur zhes pa lcags pho ltag la yer ba lha ri'i mgul du dge bshes ston pas 'bul mo che zhus/ don gsum bzhes ba rgyal po'i lo zhes pa shing pho rta'i dbyu gu zla ba'i tshes bco brgyad la snye thang du gshegs pa rnams yin te/ bka' gdams glegs bam rin po che las/ don gsum bsdad nas dga' lngan 'phro/zhes dang / shing pho rta yi lo dus su/ /dgra gu zla ba'i brto brgyad la/ /'jig rten mi rtag bskul pa'i phyir/ /rgyal ba gnyis su thim pa lags/ /zhes gsungs shing / dus gshor ṭīka chen du jo bos lcags mo yos la bod du bstan brtsis mdzad par gsungs pas/ de yang chu rta la 'khungs par bzhed la/ lam yig gsang gshor ma dang zhang sha ra ba'i lam rim brjed byang rnams dang gung 'grigs pas 'di kho nar shes par gyis la sna tshogs pa'i sgro 'dogs kyi rjes su ma 'brangs shig /'on kyang 'di la kha cig lo ngo brtsis pa'i don bzhi pa chu lug la 'das zer/yang kha cig chu rta la gshegs zer/ kha cig nga dgu pa lcag 'brug la jo bo rgya gar nas phebs/lo ngo bcu bzhir bzhugs zer ba dang / bka' gdams chos 'byung las kyang re gcig pa chu rta 305
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngala bod du phebs shing lo bcu gsum bzhugs zer ba dang / kha cig re gcig pa me rta la phebs nas lo bcu gnyis zer ba mi 'thad de/ sprul pa'i glegs bam dang mi mthun pa'i phyir/ der ma zad gnod byed gzhan yang yod de/ jo bos nga gsum par rtog ge 'bar ba gsungs dus da nas lo nyi shu na lus 'di bod du 'dzog gsungs pa dang / de nas lo gnyis 'das pa nga drug pa me glang la bod du byon dus bri ka ma la shī lar da nas lo bco brgyad na lus 'di bod du 'jog gsungs pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir/ des na lam rim 'di ltar jo bo nga bdun pa sa stag gi lo la bod du phebs nas mnga' ris su lo gsum/ snye thang du lo dgu/ dbus gtsang gzhan du lo lnga/yongs dril bod du lo bcu bdun bzhugs pa yin te/ nag tshos bstod pa brgyad cu pa las/khyod sngon so ma pū ri na/ /rtog ge 'bar ba gsungs pa'i tshe/ /da nas lo ni nyi shu na/ /tshe yi 'du byed gtong 'gyur gsungs/ /de nas lo gnyis 'das pa na/ /bod du byon pa'i dus su ni/ /bri kra ma la shī lar ni/ /da ni lo ni bco brgyad na/ /me+e yi 'du byed btang nas ni/ /lus 'di bod du bzhag nas ni/ /dga' ldan gnas su 'gro'o zhes/ /ji ltar gsungs bzhin ma nyakhul bar/ /gyur pa de ni ngo mtshar che/ /zhes dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i lung bstan pa las kyang /tshe ni bod du byon na zung bar 'dug gsungs/ ji tsam gyis thung zhus pas bod du ma byon na dgu bcu go gnyis shub/ byon na bdun cu rtsagasum las mi chub/ /ces gsungs so/ /de ltar bod du lo bcu bdun skal ldan rnams la gdams ngag ma lus pa bstan/ bstan pa'i srol nub pa gsar du btsug /srol cung zad yod pa rnams 'phel bar mdzad de/ mdo sngags mi mthun snyam pa dang / thos bsam dus nyams len med snyam pa dang / gsung rab gdams pa'i mchog min snyam pa sdugags kyi log rtog dang ze tshom gyi dri mas sbrags pa rnams legs par bsal te/ bstan pa rin bo che dri ma dang bral bar mdzad do/ /306
lam rim gyi rnam bshad lung rigs gter mdzod/gnyis pa tshangs spyod dang bslab gsum la gnod pa bsal ba ni/ spyir na gangs ri'i khrod du bstan pa snga dar la dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang pad+ma sam+bha bas bstan pa'i srol btsugs pa la/ stong pa nyid kyi go ba gnad du ma song ba la brten nas thabs kyi cha la skur zhing yid la byed pa thams cad 'gog pa'i rgya nag gi mkhan po hwa shang gis bstan pa 'grib par byas pa slob dpon chen po ka ma la shī las legs par bkag nas rgyal ba'i dgongs pa gtan la phabs pas sku drin shin tu che la/ zhes pa nas/ kha ba can pa thams cad la sku drin gyis khyab par mdzad do/ /zhes byung / de la bod slong btsan sgam po'i dus thon mi sa( ṭas sum rtags sogs bod kyi sgra'i bstan bcos brgyad brtsams shing / mdo za ma tog bkod pa dang / spang skong dang / mdo sde dkon mtshog sprin sogs bsgyur zhing / rgyal pos dge bcu'i khrims byas bod rnams chos la bkod pas mtshan srong btsan sgam por btags so/ /jo bo rnam gnyis gdan drangs te bstan pa'i srol btsug /de'i rjes su rgyal rabs bzhi 'das pa na sa pho rta la pho brang khang dmar du khri srong sde btsan 'khrangs/ bcu gsum bzhes dus rgyal sar bton/ ye shes dbang po pho nyar mngags te za hor gyi mkhan bo zhi ba 'tsho pho brang du spyan drangs/ kha che a nan+tas lo ts+tsha byas nas zla ba gcig la dge ba bcu khams bco brgyad rten 'brel bcu gnyis sogs bshad pas/ bod kyi lha srin khros te 'phang thang chus khyer/ dmar po ri la thog brgyab/mi nad dang phyugs nad byung bas/ zhi 'tshos slob dpon pad+ma sam+bha ba spyan sprongs la lha srin gdug pa 'dul dgos gsungs nas/ pho nya bdun gyis mang yul du slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas phebs pa dang 'phrad de spyan drangs/ rim gyis bod kyi lha srin gdug pa rnams dam la 'dogs shing byon te/ has po ri la phyag phebs btsan po dang mjal te/ mal gro'i phur byon nas bod kyi lha srin rnams dam la btags shing de nas slob dpon de bsam yas su spyan 307
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngadrangs/ sa chog mdzad/ mkhan po bo ti sa lhas sa dpyad mdzad nas o tan+ta bu ri'i gtsug lag khang ltar ri rab gling bcu gnyis nyi zla zung gcig mtha' lcags ris bskor ba me yos la rmangs bting nas/ sa yos la tshar nas mkhan po bo ti sa tā dang slob dpon pad+ma gnyis kyis rab gnas lo bcu gsum du dga' ston mdzad/ lug lo la thams cad yod smra'i sde'i dge slong bcu gnyis spyan drangs te/ sbas mnyu shri sogs sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung / bod du rab byung gi cho ga'i zog ma dang dge 'dun gyi sde gsar du btsug ste/ slob dpon n+da ma la mi tra sogs paṇ+ḍi ta dang / sad mi mi bdun sogs lo ts+tsha ba rnams kyis chos mang du bsgyur te/ bdud 'dul sngags pa gling du sngags 'chang ṅgārma girtis dbang bskur/ rnam dag khrims kyi gling du dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shi la sogs kyis sdom pa 'bog /bsam gtan gling du rgya'i ha shang sogs kyis bsam gtan byed/ de dus nas hwa shang gis gnad ma go ba'i bshad spru byas 'dug /brda' sbyor gling du brda' sbyor dang / dkor mdzod gling du nor 'jog /bai ro tsa na'i gling du chos bshad spru mir+sha k+ṣiṃ na/ dī r+sha zlok+ta sna( gh+nā rnyilhas ༵༵ )sna sna da/ma paspri rnyiX dzizlo rjo k+ṣiṃ dzo ༵༵ ṭ+wāṃ mdzad byang dang bam po dang lha lo na'i grangs du mchis pas gtan la phabs nas dkar chag tu bris pas mkhan po dang slob dpon dang chos rgyal de gsum gyis bstan pa dang sems can gyi don bla na 'phags pa mdzad do/ /de'i me+e mkhan chen gyis bod du mu stegs mi 'ongs chos lugs kha gnyis su byas pa'i rtsod pa 'byung / de'i me+e nga'i slob ma ka ma la shī la spyan drongs la rtsod pa byed chug /rtsod pa tshos phyogs su zhi bar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs nas gshegs/ de ltar mkhan slob de gnyis kyis bstan pa'i srol legs par btsugs kyang stong pa nyid kyi ngor med dgag la bya byed bral tshul bshad pa'i go ba gnad dam lam du ma song par pyin ci log tu 308
lam rim gyi rnam bshad lung rigs gter mdzod/bzung ba la brten nas/ thabs kyi cha kun la skur ba 'debs shing yid byed thams cad 'gog pa'i rgya nag gi mkhan po hwa shang gis bstan pa 'grib par byas te/ de'i tshe hwa shang dpon slob rnams kyis lus ngag gi chos byas pas sangs mi rgya/ byar med la gnas na sangs rgya zer/chad lta la zhen nas dge sbyor mi byed/ bod phal cher de la dga' ste/ de'i lugs slob ces bu ston gsungs/ dpal dbyangs dang rbarat+na sogs nyung shas gcig mkhan po bo nyi sa lha'i lugs byed pas lta spyod ma mthun pas phan tshun rtsod pa na/ btsan pos mkhan po bo sgyi sa lha'i lugs bzhin gyis gsungs pas/ gcig char pa rnams khros te chu sgra rnon po re bzung nas/ rim gyis pa ril gsod zer pas/ rgyal pos ye shes dbang po 'bod du lan gsum btang bas rjes mar mkhan po'i lung bstan bshad nas de ltar du slob dpon ka ma la shī la spyan 'dren pa'i pho nya btang pas/ hā shang gis tshor nas yum rgyas pa sogs spyan drangs lte rtsod yig chos bya mi dgos nyal bas chog ces ston pa'i bsam gtan nyal ba'i 'khor lo dang / rtsod spong ༷༷༷ ༷khyi | kau/ ༷/ k+ṣiṃ hūm̐ ṭ+wāṃ/ ṣā ṭ+wāṃ g.ya ༷ ṭ+wāṃ /༷spya two twi r+p+pa /ṭ+wāṃ shī la byon pa dang btsan pos gung la bzhugs/ hwa shang g.yas gral byas/ slob dpon g.yon gral du byas/ rim gyis pa rnams de'i mjug tu mthud de/ btsan pos gnyis lnga'i lag tu me tog gtad de/ rtsod la gang rgyal bar me rtog phul cig /pham pa de 'dir ma sdod ces bka' stsal pa dang / hwa shang na re/ las dge mi dge gang spyad kyang mtho ris dang ngan song du 'gro bas 'khor ba las mi thar zhing sangs/ rgyas thob pa la sgrib pa yin te/ dper na sprin dkar nag gang gis kyang mkha' la sgrib pa dang 'dra/ gang zhig ci yang mi sems ci yang mi bsam pa de 'khor 309
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngaba las yongs su thar par 'gyur ro/ /ci la yang mi sems mi rtogs mi dpyod pa de mi dmigs pa yin pas gcig char du 'jug pa ni sa bcu pa dang 'dra'o zer ro/ /ka ma la shī la'i zhal snga nas/ de ltar yang mi bsam zer ba des ni so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab spangs pa yin no/ /yang dag pa'i ye shes skya rtsab so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab yin pas/ de spangs pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab kyang spang par 'gyur ro/ /so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab med na rnal 'byor pa gang gis rnam par mi rtog pa la gnas/ gal te chos thams cad dran pa med cing yid la bya ba med pa yin na/ nyams su myong ba thams cad mi dran zhing yid la mi bya bar mi nus so/ /gal te bdag gis chos dran par mi bya'o snyam na de shin tu yid la byas par 'gyur ro/ /dran pa med pa tsam de la byed na brgyal ba'am bogs pa'i dus su rnam par mi rtog par 'gyur ro/ /yang dag pa'i so sor rtog pa med par rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jug pa'i thabs med do/ /dran pa tsam bo de bkag kyang yang dag pa'i so sor rtog pa med na chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med pa la ji ltar 'jug nus/ stong nyid ma rtogs par sgrib pa spangs par mi 'gyur pa kho na'o/ /des na yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis phyin ci log gi snang ba rgyang sring pa yin no/ /des na dran bzhin du mi dran byar mi rung ngo / /dran pa dang yid la bya ba med par sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa ji ltar 'gyur/ nyon yongs pa yang ji ltar spong / de bas na yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis don nges par rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas dus gsum pyi nang thams cad stong par rtogs nas rtog pa rnams nye bar zhi ste lta ngan thams cad spang ste/ de la brten nas thabs shes rab la mkhas pas sgrib pa thams cad bsal nas sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/ 'khor gyis kyang brtsad pas/ gcig char pas lan smra ma nus par/ hwa shang gis me tog phreng ba slob dpon la 310
lam rim gyi rnam bshad lung rigs gter mdzod/〉pa ṭ+wāṃ lha pa sbya (pa spya ro/ la/k+ti k+ṣiṃ patsa〉 sprasag sbyi pyi dri ༵ r+yaṃ spri k+ṣiṃ gh+nā sdidī/ ṣ+ṭṛ r+sha/sazhi nāṃ stsal nas hwa shang rgya'i yul du brdzangs/ dpe rnams gter du sbas so/ /slob dpon ka ma la shī las de ltar chad lta ngan shos de legs par bkag nas sgom rim gsum gyis dpyad 'jog gi sgom sangs rgyas bar du bzod tshul dang / dbu ma snang bas drang nges kyi mdo sde shin tu mang pa'i bshad tshul bkral/ mtha' gnyis spong lugs rgyal ba'i dgongs pa gtan la phabs pas sku drin sbyir sa gsum na che zhing khyad par gangs can la sku drin shin tu che'o/ /de ltar na srong btsan sgam po rgyal sar byon pa'i sa glang nas ral pa can gshegs pa'i lcags bya yan chad la lo nyis brgya dang bcu gcig song 'dug pa 'di'i ring bod du bstan pa snga dar gyi tha snyad byas/'di yan chad du bod kyi chos rgyal rnams kyis gtsug lag khang stong rtsabargyad bzhengs par grags so/ /ral ba can phyag na rdo rje'i sprul bar grags shing sngar sde snod gsum yul skad sna tshogs su bsgyur ba skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab lte phyin chad de las gzhan du mi 'gyur ba byas shing bkas bcad gsum byas te/ sde ba gzhi thams cad yod smra las gzhan mi shāshā shārnyiswā ga~Xn dri swār+sha~X rdzu palha brdzu(/nadībs bhe+e dro ༵ ༵ khrim dīsna ḍā / lha( ṭ+wāṃ dī chen po la dbus gtsang gi mi bcus dbus su bsam yas su phebs pa'i mtshams 'di nas (spra nā k+ṣiṃ ñtsā ṭ+wāṃ n+tā m+p+raṃ (shā paXdī dri ༷ dri la smre/bagla ṭ+wāṃ da ṭ+wāṃ dzo pa /shā k+ṣiṃ r+sha 〉 sta /sna shā /( gh+nā go drug song bar byed dgos te/ lo go drug du bstan pa mi 'byung bar bshad pa'i phyir/ bka' chem las/ lo skor brgyad kyi bar sangs rgyas bstan pa med par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs la/ bu 311
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngadang bcom ral gnyis bdun bcu song zer ba gnyis gung legs pa 'dra yod kyang 'di skabs su lo rtags gsal bo med pas dpyad dka' la sna tshogs gcig 'dug kyang ma bkod/ de nas mkhas pa mi bcus bstan pa srel ba'i phyir du so sor gnas gzhi brtsigs te/ de yang dbus su klu mes kyis la mo lcags de'u brtsigs/ de la slob ma bzhi byung ba'i gru dmar tshul khrims 'byung gnas kyis sol nag thang chen/ de las mched pa la thang tsho skor zer/ zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang snyog gis rwa tshag dang rgyal lha khang bajigs/ de la zhang tsho skor zer/rngog byang chub 'byung gnas kyis yer pa'i lha khang dang gzhu'i kun dga' ra ba brtsigs/ de la rngog tsho skor zer/ glan ye shes shes rab kyis rgya gsar sgang brtsigs/ de la glan tsho skor zer/ sum pa dang 'og gis g.yul gro lha khang brtsigs/ rag shis 'phrang 'og gi lha khang brtsigs/ sbas yung 'gur bajigs/ sbra'i mkhan bu mal shes rab sems dbas stod lung tsha thog brtsigs/de nas thag ma dang yon gra gnyis bzung / de la sba tsho skor zer/ dang por rag shis 'phrang 'og brtsigs/ de nas mal gro ka tshal dang zhwa'i lha khang bzung / de dag la nag tsho skor zer/ de ltar dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa mi bcus pyin yang sum pa dang gtsang gi 'o brgyad sprun gnyis las mched pa med pas mi drug tu grags skad kyang thams cad kyis sprul zhing / 'a zhwa dang 'bre gnyis de dag bcur ma gtogs kyang so sos gnas gzhi mang du brtsigs nas bod khams yon tshun chad khyab par byas shing / tshogs tsho skor dgu las gyes pa sogs bu'i chos 'byung du stos/ de nas stod 'dul dang smad 'dul gnyis dbus su sleb pa'i dus rags pa mnyam ste/stod 'dul pa'i rab tu byung ba'i thog ma lo chen rin chen bzang po dang lha bla ma ye shes 'od yin la/ smad 'dul ba'i rab byung gi snga ma klu mes kyi dngos slob gru dmar dang zhang rdo rje dbang phyug sogs yin pas 'di rnams phal cher dus mnyam la/ zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug las 312
lam rim gyi rnam bshad lung rigs gter mdzod/lo chen lo phyed tsam gyis bgres par 'dug pa sogs las so/ /de lta bu'i phyi dar la rgyud sde'i don drod sogs thob nas byed tshul bshad par ma go bar sngags pa las dang po pas kyang sbyod pa'i dus kyi thams cad byed par bshad pa a tsar+ya dmar po tshad ldan yin kyang / de'i slob ma (spra ṭ+wāṃ dī kau tshi pardo /pazlo dī pa( :dri pa rnyipa (dīpa lha/ rtswa ༵ ṭ+wāṃ m+p+raṃ pa/ spra )snro bad spridī skur dus sher dbang dang gsang dbang dngos kyi phyag rgyas byas pas bstan pa'i rtsab dang gzhi rten tshangs spyod kyi sdom pa la gnod pa chen po byas pa 'jig rten thams cad kyi mig gcig bu skyes bu dam pa 'dis lam sgron las/ dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyud chen las/ /rab tu 'bad pas bkag pa'i phyir/ /gsang pa shes rab dbang bskur ni/ /tshangs par spyod pas blangs mi bya/ /gal te dbang bskur de 'dzin na/ tshangs spyod dka' thub la gnas pas/ /bkag pa spyad par gyur pa'i phyir/ /dka' thub sdom pa de nyams te/ /brtul zhugs can de pham pa yi/ /ltang ba dag ni 'byung 'gyur zhing / /de ni ngan song nges ltang bas/ /grub pa nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs nas bkag pa ltar shin tu legs pa yin te/ mnyam sbyongar las/ dkyil gobor dag tu ma zhugs dang / /dam tshig rnams ni spangs pa dang / /gsang ba'i de nyid mi shes ༵ pa/sa//sgru/༵ ༵ pyaX ༷/dzo rnyi ( /lda/shā sna/da/zlo /dpa zlo dzopa /dri dī ṅgi pashā kyi lhashā hāzlo ba bdun la ni/ /ma sgom par yang dngos grub thob/ /gang la sgom pa dang ldan zhing / /gal te dam tshig sdom la gnas/ /skye 'dir las dbang gis ma grub/ /skye ba gzhan du dngos grub thob/ /re zhig dam tshig nyams pa na/ /dngos grub thob pa lta zhog gi /mi yi skye ba'ang rjed par dka'/ /zhes gsungs/ pa ltar nyes pa che bas legs par bkag cing / gzhan yang 16ma pa 313
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngagsum gyi 'bog tshul dang lta ba log par bzung pa rnams dang sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi skyes bu gcig gis nyams len mi rung snyam pa'i log par bzung ba rnams nub par byas nas mdo sngags kyi gnad phyin ci ma log pa'i bstan pa 'phel bar mdzad pas kha ba can pa thams cad la sku drin gyis khyab par mdzad do/ /gsum pa la rgyu gsum ngos bzung ba dang / so sor bshad pa gnyis/ dang po bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyu phun sum tshogs pa gsum ngos bzung ba ni/ de ltar thub pa'i dgongs pa gsal bar byed pa'i gzhung rtsom pa la'ang phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu gsum yod de/ zhes pa nas/ slob dbon 'di la ni gsum ga mnga' 'o/ /zhes byung / spyir bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyu yod de/ rgyu re res kyang bstan bcos rtsom nus tshul ni/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas na tshig dang don la gabrul ba mi 'ong zhing brjod bya nang don rig par mkhas shing / bzo gso sogs la mi rmongs pas bstan bcos rtsom nus/ bstan bcos de'i don ljags pa'i sangs rgyas nas bzung dam pa bar ma chad par brgyud pa'i man ngag yod na'ang 'khrul ba 'ga' mi 'ongs pas bstan bcos rtsom par shin tu nus/ yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs/ gsung gi gnang ba thob na don lha la zhus tshog bas mi 'khral ba'i bstan bcos tshad ldan rtsom nus na gsum ga tshang na ches phun sum tshogs par 'gyur la jo bo chen po la gsum ga mnga' bas so/ /gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ de la yi dam gyis rjes su bzung pa/ /zhes pa nas/zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /zhes byung / spyir sangs rgyas byang sems mang po'i zhal gzigs ba yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya ba'i man ngag la brten nas sangs rgyas byang sems nam mkha' gang tsam gzigs gsungs te/ bstod pa las/ khyod skya sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /byin rlabs zugs la skyes pa yin/ /zhes gsungs shing / byams snying rje byang chub 314

lam rim gyi rnam bshad lung rigs gter mdzod/'byor pa chen po a me byang chub rin chen/ dgon pa ba 'angong dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ rnal 'byor ba shes rab rdo rje/phyag dar ston pa/byams pa blo gros lnga dang /de rnams kyi nang nas khu 'og 'brom gsum gtso bo yin la/ gzhan yang khyung bo rnal 'byor ba dang / mar ba do ba/ rwa rdo rje grags dang /ba ri lo tsā ba sogs bgrangs yas byon pa lags/gnyis pa ni/ de dag gi nang nas kyang bla ma nyid kyi 'phrin las rgyas bar byed pa'i brgyud 'dzen chen bo ni sgrol mas lung bstan pa'i 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas so/ /'di dag ni rdzu(da sna hūm̐ tram̐ gh+nā dzño shā snashā spya/ ༵༵ sna k+ṣiṃ gh+nā r+yaṃ ༷ spra /spya spra /sna zlo sno /lha pa) sgrol ma'i mdun du gsol ba btab pas/nang bar lha khang gcig tu rnal 'byor ma gcig yong der dris gsungs/ nang bar rnal 'byor ba ral pa shar re ba la zham me gcig byung bas/ me rtog phul nas zhus pas/bod du byone na phan ni thogs nas 'ongs/khyad par36 pa si ka gcig la brten nas phan thogs re 'ongs par 'dug de la byin gyis slobs shig gsungs nas lung bstan to/ /rnam thar rgyas pa nag tsho dang / mchims gyi yi ge dang / lam yig chen mo rnams yin no/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu lam rim mdzad pa po'i che ba rgyal ba thams cad kyi yab gcig rje btsun 'jam dbyangs nyid phebs shing bstan pa rin bo che phyogs thams cad du rgyas bar mdzad pa yin te/ de yang bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs pa chen po/ 'jig rten thams cad la rgyu med par yang gcig tu mnyes gshin pa'i ngang tshul can/ ring mo zhig nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che mtha' dag gi pha rol tu byon pa/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zugs kyi 'od zer gyis slo zos kyi pad+mo kha phye bas shes bya'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag la gzigs pa 'bum du 'bar ba'i thogs pa med pa'i 317
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngaspyan dang ldan pa/ zun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan 'jig rten thams cad khyab pa/ mtha' yas shing mu med pa'i yon tan rin po che'i tshogs kyis zugs kyi bang mdzod yongs su gtam pa'i bdag nyid chen po mtshan brjod par dka' ba 'di ni/ thun mong ma yin pa dngos po'i gnas tshod tsam brjod na/ bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i snga rol nas sa bcu yongs su ljags par mdzad de/ dag pa'i zhing dang ma dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su yang la lar ni gabor lo bsgyur ba dang / la lar ni khams kyi rgyal po dang / 'ga' zhig tu ni brgya byin dang tshangs pa'i gzugs dang / de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dang rab tu byung ba'i tshul la sogs pa gdul bya dang 'tsham pa'i sku'i rnam par 'phrul ba dpag tu med pa/ ji ltar nam mkha'i lam nas zla ba'i dkyil lnga'or gcig nyid kyis sa'i steng du chu snod tha dad pa sna tshogs zhig gi nang du gcig char rang gi gzugs du ma ston pa de bzhin du 'bad rtsol med par nye bar bstan pa las/ bdag cag rnams la ni/ 'u bu cag dang 'gro ba ris mthun par skye ba bzhes pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyid kyi rnam par bstan pas don mdzad do/ /zhes bya bar khong du chud par bya ba yin pa gor ma chag pa'am ze tshom med pa ste/'di la bdag nyid yid ches par bya ba'i lo rgyus kyi gtan tshigs gtam du gling ba'ang thos so/ /zhes rigs ldan grags pa'i rnam 'phrul mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs pa yin te/ mdo las/ du ba las ni mer shes dang / /chu skyar las ni chu shes ltar/ /byang chub sems dpa' slo ldan gyi/ /rigs ni mtshan ma dag las shes/ /zhes gsungs/ sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa dang 'phrin las la dpag na'ang de ltar rtogs nus la/ lung bstan yang sangs rgyas nyid kyis mdo rgyud du mar lung bstan cing / mkhas grub chen po du mas kyang lung bstan pa'i tshad ma'i lung shin tu mang pa'i phyir/ spyir dus ngan pa mi rnams chos dang mi ldan pa 318
lam rim gyi rnam bshad lung rigs gter mdzod/dang / rgyal po rnams ma rung ba dang / mi dang mi min kun glang dar dus bzhin tshos la snang dus 'jam dbyangs kyis byis pa so skye'i tshul gyis yang yang phebs nas sems can mang bo 'dul bar bshad cing / khyad par ston pa 'das nas sa steng stongs pa na rje btsun khyod nyid byis pa'i gzugs kyis sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i mdzad pa byed cing / kha ba can du rdo rje gdan gnyis pa dgon gnas chen po byed pa dang / dge 'dun sgya sne dang dgon gnas chen po du ma phyogs bcur rgyas shing / de la dad pa rnams rmad byung bkod par skye bar lung bstan pa sogs yod pa'i pyir/ khyad par dang po ni/ 'jam dpal gargyud kyi le'u nyer brgyad pa las/ de dus 'jigs su rung ba yi/ /de tshe sems can chos ldan min/ /rtag tu chos la mig gnas shing / /rgyal po rnams ni ma rung yin/ /mi dang mi ma yin rnams ni/ /kun kyang bstan la rnam par sdang / /ngas bshad chos kyi mdzod rnams ni/ /de yi thams cad 'jig par 'gyur/ /de dag 'dul pa'i don gyi phyir/ /zhes pa nas/ skye bo skyabs ni med pa dang / /sangs rgyas zhing ni stongs pa na/ /sngags kyi gzugs kyis sems can la/ /byis pa'i tshul gyi yang dag shod/ /sems can mang po 'dul byed cing / /phun sum tshogs pa spyin byed la/ /dus kyi tha ma de la ni/ /sems can kun la mchog sbyin byed/ /ces gsungs so/ /khyad par gnyis pa yang 'jam dpal rtsargyud kyi lung de'i de ma thag tu/ 'jig rten nga ni mya ngan 'das/ /sa yi steng ni stongs gyur na/ /khyod nyid byis pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par 'gyur/ /de me+e dgon pa rab dga' ba/ /kha ba can na yod pa yin/ /zhes dang / jo bo yab sras shing rta'i lo yer pa nas lha sar phebs dus jo bo shākya mu nis dge bshes ston par gsung gis lung bstan pa'i 'chi med rdo rje glu las/ mar me mdzad kyang gnas mchog 'dir/ /sgrol mar bcas te sprul stong 'gyed/ /lhag par chags med bsod snyoms pas/ /phyogs bzhi'i 319

lam rim gyi rnam bshad lung rigs gter mdzod/dang zhib cha 'dra ba gcig 'jam dbyangs kyis gsungs par 'dug /'on kyang nga la lhag pa'i lhas gsungs dus/ dbang bskur ri yi 'dab dag tu/ /btsun mo lding gi ngos phyogs su/ /dge 'dun dpag med 'du bar 'gyur/ /ri ni gang yin 'jam dpal 'chad/ /dbus gtsang mdo khams rgya yul gyi/ /mchod yul dam pa tshogs gzugag rten/ /mnga' ris byang khams kun gyi skyabs/ /phyogs bcur lde dgon rgyas par 'gyur/ /zer ba sogs byung ste/ 'di zur tsam yin khyed rang gang dgos yi dam la zhus pas yong bar snang zhes gsungs so/ /khyad par gsum pa dag zhing dang rje rin po che la dad pa khyad par can gyi zhing der skye bar sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan te/ mdo sde gdams ngag 'bog pa'i bstan pa dwangs snyigs 'byed pa'i le'u zur du bsgyur pa 'di'i nang na bod kyi lung bstan mang yang pyis su mang pos dkrugs bcos sna tshogs byas kyang sngar ma bcos pa'i lung mkhas pa du mas drangs pa las/ kun dga' bo/ da lta nga la shel dkar gyi/ /phreng ba phul ba'i khye'u 'di/ /nga yi bstan pa'i gadren byed la/ /ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus su ni/ /'bri dang ldan gyi sa mtshams su/ /dga' zhes bya ba'i dgon pa pa/bsdu /rgyu/sna (shā spra sna pa'i mi( k+ṣiṃ lhaX /sha/tshor shā rnam pa pā ba ṭ+wāṃ sna( shāshā/ rna/n+d+ra lhami la/ /dbu rgyan 'bul zhing mchod pa byed/ /ston pa'i mdo bzhin gsung slogs shing / /snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis gsol ba 'debs/ /nga la gsol ba rab btab nas/ /bstan pa lo stong bar du gnas/ /de nas shar phyogs logs su 'gro/ /rmad byung bkod pa'i 'jig rten du/ /siṅga'i nga ro zhes byar 'gyur/ /de la dad byed zhing der skye/ /zhing mchog de ni khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs pa/ phar ngos 'bri gung dang de nas ldan gyi sa mtshams su dgon pa dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling 'byung ba dang / 'debs pa po'i mtshan zur dang / gabor chen po mang du bsdu 321
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngany+pha /shā /la /pa spya/ rdzuX pasha ṣ+ṭaṃ sgruban+dha blo /lha' dī/ r+shadī ༷r+shasna ( spya/salha ba lha/ / sna zloshāshā shing / mchod dbyangs dang / gsol 'debs skabs gsum ma lta bus drag tu gsol ba btab pas bstan pa bod du lo stong du gnas pa dang / sku pyi ma la byang shar mtshams kyi dag zhing rmad byung bkod par rgyal ba siṅga'i nga ro zhes bya ba rnam dag gangs rir bshad pa lta bu der/ da lta'i dad byed thams cad der skye tshul dang / skyes tshad kun me+e gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i zhing mchog de ni gzhan las 'phags tshul rnams bshad pa'i phyir te/ 'di ni mang thos mkhar nag pas bkod pa bzhin du bris/ brag sgo'i lung ma dag pa gcig dang rnying ma yin snyam nas log par smras 'dug /de la the tshom med de/ de ltar rgyud dang bod 'dir yang mkhas grub du mas lung bstan pa'i pyir te/ paṇa chen rin po che dang zhang dmar ba mkhar nag sogs kyis drangs pa'i 'jam dpal rtsargyud las/ dang por yi ge ba grags dang / /sdom brtson thams cad bsgrags pa yang / /ston pa'i bstan pa gsal byed pa/ /bstan pa de tshe sa steng du/ /rnam par nyams shing snang med la/ /bstan ba'i gzugs brnyan yid du 'ong / /byed par 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /thams cad byang chub lung bstan te/ /nga yi byang chub mchog thob 'gyur/ /de bzhin 'jig rten sbyin gnas 'gyur/ /srid pa gsum gyi mthar yang byed/ /sngags dang rgyud la mngon brtson pa/ /grags pa 'dzin par shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa yang phal cher snga ma dang mthun la/ 'tshang rgya bar bshad pa dang / lko brag phyag rdor pa las kyi rdo rjes gsang bdag la zhus pa las/ blo bzang grags pa sangs nam rgya zhus pas/ sangs nam rgya ngas mi ston/ 'jam dpal dang spyan ras gzigs kyis ston par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs shing / rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtshos 'jam dbyangs la zhus pa las/ de'i tshe snying stobs phul du phyin pa'i 322
lam rim gyi rnam bshad lung rigs gter mdzod/sems dpa' chen po 'di nyid ni/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing dpag tu med pa 'das pa'i byang shar mtshams su ngo mtshar rmad byung bkod pa sna tshogs pas mtshes pa zhes bya ba'i zhing du de bzhin gshegs pa siṅga'i nga ro zhes bya bar 'tshang rgya zhes lung bstan/ de nas bzung lte ma dag pa'i zhing rnams su sngags rgya cher spel ba bkod pa sna tshogs kyi sgo nas bgrang ba las 'das pa thabs mkhas kyis mdzad/ da dung zhing khams mtha' yas pa rnams su skad cig gcig gis yang de nyid mang du rgyas par mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs shing / de dang mthun par gsang bdag gi lung bstan las kyang / gsang 'dzin las kyi rdo rje la/ /sngon nas nye bar 'brel ba yi/ /blo bzang grags pa 'di nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul pa ste/ /paṇa chen rkyang gi lus bzung nas/ /mdo dang sngags kyi don bshad cing / /nges pa kho nar 'tshang rgya'o/ /rgya gar rgya nag bal bo dang / /dbus gtsang mdo khams yul phyogs su/ /skye ba bzungs shing 'gro kun rnams/ /thar pa'i lam la zhakhrid par byed/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni lhag pa'i lha/ /dbyangs can ma ni las rgya ste/ /nges pa kho nar byang chub bo/ /'phags pa'i slob ma 'du bar byed/ /lus 'di bor me+e dga' ldan du/ /byams pa'i drung 'gro chos nyan 'gyur/ /'jam dpal snying bo zhes bya ba/ /sems can kun la brtse ba lte/ /de ni sa bcu'i mthar pyin te/ /zhes gsungs shing /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sprul pa dang / skye ba sna tshogs yul so sor phebs tshul dang /sangs rgya bar bshad cing / slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i bskul byang las kyang / nyon cig rgyal bo dad pa can/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten byon dus nye bar gshor/ /mya ngan 'das me+e khu pa kup+ta zhes/ /zong khyer 'ga' ru snya ba bha trar grags/ /shar phyogs rgya nag yul dang nye ba'i char/ /shākya'i dge slong slo bzang zhes bya 'byung / /rgyal pa'i sras po grags pa'i mtshan can des/ /shākya mu ni longs spyod rdzogs skur bsgyur/ /pha rgyud zab gnad phra mo'i rnal 'byor 323
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngadang / /mtha' bzhi spros bral rtogs pa'i lta ba yis/ /skal bzang gdul bya mang po smin grol (((/ /zhi~X ༷༷ snro pa'i bami( ( ༷༷sna (33 /sa/ /( ༵༵༵ rnyi 〈sna rnyi(da~X ༵ shāX las/ /'od zer bye ba'i phung po rab tu 'gyed/ /ces gsungs pa dang / gdams ngag 'bog pa'i mdo gnyis las pyi ma la rmad byung bkod par 'tshang rgya bar bshad pa dang yang dga' ldan du phebs pa'i lung bstan rnams mi 'gal te/ mdzad pa ston tshul tsam yin la/ de bzhin du ma cig lab kyi sgron ma'i lung bstan las kyang / de lta bu'i rgyal khrims dang chos khrims 'chugs pa'i dus su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mun pa'i smag tu klog 'khyugs pa lta bu zhig 'byung / zhes gsungs pa su yin dris pa'i lan du lung bstan las/ bu mo khyod kyis dris pa'i byang sems de/ /ma 'ongs bskal bzang sangs rgyas bdun pa yin/ /da lta byang chub sems dpa' snying stobs mchog /snyigs dus log spyod bod kyi yul du 'byung / /dge slong tshul 'dzin grags pa'i mtshan thogs te/ /gang gi zhing du siṅga'i nga ror grags/ /khrims 'chal log spyod spobs pa zil gyis gnon/ /khrims 'chal dpag med yang dag khrims la sbyor/ /thub nyid srol btod bstan pa'i chags rtags 'dzin/ /bstan pa gsal bar byed pa'i dge slong mtshog /mtha' yas rgyud sde'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur zhing / /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa'i bcud phyung nas/ /gdul byar gyur pa'i skal ldan tshim par mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ rgyud sde mtha' dag gi sngags lam rim/ khrid chen brgyad sogs mdzad/ yang lab sgron gyi lung bstan las/ma cig gi zhal 'dzum pa mdzad de gsungs pa/ bu mo khyod dri ba la ha cang yang rem zhing / khyad par yang snyigs ma'i dus bstan pa la bya ba byed par nus pa'i dge slong de'i dri ba la nan che bar gda' ste/ de legs so/ /de bas na bu mo khyod kyi dri ba nan che ba de sangs rgyas kyi bstan 324
lam rim gyi rnam bshad lung rigs gter mdzod/pa la gus pa yin pas nyon/ 'dul khrims 'chugs pa'i dus su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gsal bar byed pa'i dge slong gcig 'byung byas pa de/ da ltar bshad pa'i dge slong grags pa'i mtshan thogs pa 'di yin/ dge slong des bstan pa 'chol ba mang du 'byung ba rnams tshar gcod cing / yang dag pa'i don dang bstan pa rnam dag gi khrims srol brtod pa ni/ 'dzam bu gling du thub pas chos 'khor bskor ba dang snyigs dus dge slong grags pa'i mtshan can byung nas chos srol btod pa ni mtshungs te/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal ba 'di'i lung bstan shin tu mang zhing thugs rje dang mthu stobs shin tu che ba ni/ rnam thar zur 'debs las/ nga'i rmi lam du rdo rje 'jigs byed dang mjal bas gsol ba btab/ khyad par du zhal yang yang bstan du gsol zhes zhus/ sang phod da tsam lung pa 'di'i mda' ru yod/ de bar du bde bar gyis gsungs pas/ de gang yin dpyad pa'i phyir ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas/ khyod kyi bur 'dug pa la thug pa yin gsungs pa la sogs pa'i gsang ba'i gnas rnams du ma gsungs nas/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rdo rje 'jigs byed nyid dge slong gi rnam par sprul pa yin par gor ma chags shing / de bzhin du rje btsun nyid phebs pa 'jam dpal rtsargyud kyi lung bstan ltar yin pas/ gangs can gyi mgon po rgyal dbang dge 'dun rgya mtshos kyang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi shis brjod las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /ma rung bdud dpung 'joms mdzad gzhin rje gshed/ /mi yi gzugs kyi rnam rol tsong kha pa/ /dbyer ñtsha rmo hūm̐ spyu n+dha hā/ snarnyi/ /zhesna skyo /(sna sna sna zlo chi gā parnyi / sbyi gh+nā ༈ r+sha ba~X dī shā/ dka' zhing / mthong thos reg gsum gyis phan pa dpag med thob par rje btsun gsang ba'i bdag pos grub chen phyag rdor ba la gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ de'i ched du gdul bya dman 325
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngapa la yang thun mong du snang tsam gyi mdzad pa brjod par bya ste/ gnas rnying ba kun dga' bde legs kyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar las/ gnyis pa ni rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse gcig m+p+raṃ (smyupa lcu/ chakhri /lja ji sra rnyi pa ñtsā k+ṣiṃ ṭ+wāṃ spra spya hūm̐ dzo dzosna r+sha rnyi da/traṃ /ji rnyit+na ༷sbyo r+ṇi snapa bzhugs pa nyams su blangs pas brgyud pa'i gdams pa kho nar dgongs zhes pa nas/ lam rim gyi skabs su/ de ltar thub pa'i dgongs pa gsal bar byed pa'i gzhung rtsom pa la yang phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu gsum yod de/ nas/ bdag nyid chen po 'di la ni gsum ga lhag dang bcas nas mnga' ba'i tshul ni bshad zin to/ /zhes sogs ltar yin la/ de 'dra ba'i mdzad pa bstan pa'i gsung gi bdud mimyang pa'i sras bslab pa gsum bsrung ba/ mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa/ lde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i rnga bo ches gsum du sgrogs pa rgyan drug lta bu gnam gyi skar tshogs lta bu'am/ lha'i yongs 'du'i ron pa 'bras bus khur gyis bajid pa'am/ ma dros pa'i mtsho pad+ma dang me tog gis brgyan pa lta bu bsam las 'das pa zhig byon pas nub dzā lan+dhar nas/ shar phyogs rgya mtsho chen po la zug gi bar khyab par byon nas/ rgya gar rgya nag bal bo bod gangs can gyi ljongs ma lus par dge 'dun gyi sde dang mdo sngags kyi bshad sgrub kyis khyab par mdzad pa'i slob ma'i grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bdag 'dras brjod par ga la nus/ gtso bor gyur ba rags rim ngo mtshar ba rna bar thos pa 'ga' tsam brjod par bya ste/ bla ma tshos gsan pa bzhi nye/ dbu ma ba/ lho brag phyag rdor ba/ bra gor mkhan po chos skyabs pa mang po/ rje btsun re mda' ba dang bzhi'o/ /sras kyi thu bo gnyis ni/rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen dang / 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan/ nang thugs kyi sras rigs ldan rnam 'phrul mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa dge legs dpal bzang / de gsum 326
lam rim gyi rnam bshad lung rigs gter mdzod/ni gsang bdag gis lung bstan pa'i slob ma gsum zhes rje btsun chos rgyan gsung ste legs so/ /bdud sde'i gnyen po sras par tshar gyi 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad ni/ rtogs ldan 'jam dkar ba/ gnas brtan byang seng ba/ shar ba rin rgyal ba/ gnas brtan bzang skyong ba nye dbus pa bzhi/ rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ dge bshes shes rab grags pa/ dge bshes 'jam dpal bkra shis/ dge bshes dpal skyongs pa ste mdo smad pa bzhi/ 'di dag kyang lung rtogs kyi yon tan dpag par dka' zhing / rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin brtan po mnga' ba yi dam kyi lha du mas rjes su bzung ba sha stag go /tsha kho dpon po ngag dbang grags pa/ mdo smad pa grags pa blo gros/ ldong ston dzñā na shrī/ dge bshes sha ston te/ bya bral la ma thegs gong gi sras snga tshar bzhi/ zhwa lu ba legs pa rgyal mtshan/ rje blo gros chos skyong / ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan gsum ni/ 'jam dbyangs snyan brgyud chu bo'i mgo 'dzin pa'i chos rje gser khri ba gsum/ hor ston nam mkha' dpal/ shar pa rin rgyal gnyis ni 〉shar gyi bstan pa'i gsal byed gnyis/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shas dpal ldan/ mtshungs med chos rje rgyal mtshan bzang po/ rje btsun shes rab siṅga / thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub/ tsha kho dpon po ngag dbang grags pa/ stod sher bzang / smad sher bzang bdun ni 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sras chen bdun/ chos rje dkon mchog tshul khrims/ mkhas pa rgyal dbang kha che/ gnyal rgod rin bsam/ mkhyen rab grags bzang / gnyal chen shes rab rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dpal seng / snar thang rab mchog bdun ni dbus gtsang bstan pa'i snyon me bdun/ byang sems shākya bsod nams/ byang sems kun dga' bzang po/ byang sems slo gros rgyal mtshan/ byang sems tshul khrims dpal bzang / byang sems gzhon nu rgyal mchog /byang sems rgyal mtshan grags bzang / byang sems rgyal sras bde 'byung ba dang bdun ni gzhan 327
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngadon lhun kyis grub pa'i sems dpa' bdun/ byams chen shākya ye shes/ byang dar ma/ mdo smad pa legs bzang gsum ni mi dbang gtsug na mdzis pa'i tī shri gsum/ ma gcig dpon bo nam mkha' dpal bzang / yar rgyab dpon po bsod nams rnam rgyal/ zhwa lu ba bkra shis rgya mtsho/mus srad pa slo gros rin chen bzhi ni mang thos mkhas pa bzhi/ zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa/khu ge ngag dbang grags pa/ lho ba rgyal mtshan seṅga / bla ma dpal ldan pa/ ldan ma yon tan dpal pa/ mdo smad pa bsod nams shes rab/ rong po lce nag /mdo smad pa 'od zer brgyad ni bstan pa phyogs mthar skyong ba'i dar chen brgyad/ 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal/ stag lung lo tsā pa ste lo chen gnyis/ rin po che dpal ldan pa/ rin po che bsod nam/sa bzang po/ rin po che byang chub rdo rje/ rin po che bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'bri gung rin bo che don grub rgyal po/stag lung rin po che bkra shis dpal 'od drug ni sa skyong chos rje drug /tshos rje sher 'byung ba/rgyal ba rin bsam pa/ byang gling grags rin pa/ mnga' ris bsod nams rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal/ gu ge sangs rgyan/ 'jam dbyangs rin grags/ dmar khams grags bzang / slob dpon brtson grags/ slob dpon legs ldan pa/ bla ma stag leb byang rgyal ba/ bla ma byang dpal ba ste bcu gnyis ni mang du mkhyen pa'i bstan 'dzin bcu gnyis/ sbre zhing rin po che byang dpal dang / rin chen dpal gnyis ni mkha' spyod grub pa'i gdung rabs gnyis/ skyes mchog smon lam pa dang / ri mi 'bab pa bsod nams rin chen gnyis ni skyes bu ngo mtshar can gnyis/ spyan snga kun blo/ spyan snga gzhon 'od/ spyan snga blo rgyan/ spyan snga dpal bzang / spyan snga nam rgyal/ spyan snga bsod lhun/ spyan snga rin rgyal/ spyan snga rin chen 'phel brgyad ni skye dgu'i bla ma spyan snga brgyad/ gung thang chos rje mjes pa dpal/ bla chen nyan shāka /stag phu ku shri dpal don pa/ te'u ra ba ye shes dpal/ mkhan chen chos rgyal dpal bzang / mkhan chen rgyal 328
lam rim gyi rnam bshad lung rigs gter mdzod/bzang / mkhan chen kun rdor/ mkhan chen byang dpal te bla chen brgyad/ chen po grags bzang /chen po dwags bo 'od zer siṅga / chen bo blo 'phel/ chen po kun rgyal/ chen po bkras rgyan/chen po 'jam dbyangs kha che/ chos sgo ba bkra shis rin chen te chen po bdun/ dka' bcu dar bzang / 'ba' ser dka' bcu/ tso tsa dka' bcu yon rgyan/ lhul dka' bcu/ mtha'i chung dka' bzhi ba don yod/ brag dgon dka' bzhi pa rin chen dpal/ rgyal ba dka' bzhi pa rin chen chos rgyal/ gye re dka' bzhi pa sangs rgyas dbang smyug /stag phu dka' bzhi pa sangs rgyas bzang po/ g.yag sde dka' bzhi pa bsod nams bzang bo/ kro ba dka' bzhi pa/ mtshur phu dka' bzhi pa/ dka' bzhi pa chos seng / dka' bzhi pa grags pa rgyal mtshan te gzhung lugs smra pa'i dka' chen bcu bzhi/ jo gdan zla ba blo gros/ jo gdan bsod nams lhun grub/ dzo gdan legs rin pa/ kong po jo gdan bzhi ni sbyangs pa'i yon tan brtul zhugs 'dzin pa'i jo bo stan gcig pa bzhi/ gnas brtan chos bzang ba/ gnas brtan rgyal steng pa don grub dbal/gnas brtan rgya ma pa dge 'dun rgyal po/ gnas brtan 'od zer bkra shis/ gnas brtan gzhon nu sangs rgyas/ sanas brtan kun 'bum ste/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i gnas brtan drug /ku cor rtogs ldan sangs rgyas dpal bzang / rtogs ldan nam mkha' sho re/ rgod phrug grags pa 'byung gnas/ rtogs ldan ral zhig pa/ bu le rnam rgyal te zab mo'i rtogs pa ldan pa lnga/ gzhan yang lha gzigs grags pa rgya mtsho/ rgya ston blo bzang grags pa/ drung gzhon nu dpal ba/ mkhan po bsam rgyal/ bla ma gser thub pa/ yang steng rin po che/ zhi blo dpon po/drung nam mkha' ba/ bla ma mgon po byang chub/ bla ma bsod rin/ drung chos 'phags ba/ bla ma shāka rin pa/ bla ma zla ba bzang po/ bla ma chos rgyal mtshan/ rgya ra sangs rgyas ye shes sogs mtha' yas pa cig byon te/ mdor na gsang bde gung gsum/ dga' skyor zul gsum/ lo bya 329
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngayul rin chen sgang gsum/ rgyal glang thang phro ba gsum/ rwa sgreng 'chad kha spyil bu gsum/ 'bri ltag tshal gsum/ e gnyal dwags gsum gyi chos dbon/ thang po che sogs g.yor phyogs kyi chos dbon rnams kyis de dus rjes rin po che'i drung du ma btud pa mi snang ste/ yid bzang rtse ba chen po'i zhal nas/ de dus sa chen po 'di rje btsun tsong kha pa'i gdugs dkar po gcig gis khyab par byas nas yod pa yin zhes gsungs so/ /lam rim 'di mdzad pa po'i che ba ste/rgyas par mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnam thar gsum dang / 'dun legs ma'i ṭīk+ka sogs las shes par bya ste/ lho brag grub chen gyis lung bstan pa las/ 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang dpag med 'ong / chos sde tshan chen khyed kyi ring la 'debs/ dge 'dun tshan che ba khyed kyi ring la 'du/ 'phags pa'i slob ma yang lnga drug bstan pa dang sems can la phan ba rgya cher 'byung / mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs yang ches cher gsal bar byed cing /sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa 'dra ba'i ring lugs 'ong / 'gro ba mang po gcig thar pa'i lam la 'khrid par 'dug pas shin tu ngo mtshar zhes gsungs pa ltar/ da lta 'bras spungs la rgyun pa'i tshogs mang dus bdun stong dang nyung dus yang lnga stong nges can dang / de dang cha 'dra ba se ra dga' ldan bkra shis lhun po gsum la yod pas de 'dra rgya gar du byung skad mi snang bas ngo mtshar cing dad pa'i rgya mtsho yang yang 'phel bar byos shig /gnyis pa chos kyi che ba la byang chub lam rim chen mo 'di khyad par bdun gyis 'phags pa yin te/ mdzad pa po rgyal ba gnyis pa/ bshad bya'i chos jo bo'i man ngag skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim/ 'chad tshul khyad bar 'phags pa/ lam gyi ngo bo nges pa/ go rim nges pa/ grangs nges pa gsum dang / bskul ba po mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i lo chen sogs chen po du ma dang / gnas khyad par 'phags pa rwa sgreng rgyal ba'i dben gnas su/ gabor khyad par 330
