kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngasprapa smra / shā snapa ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ /parnyi na bai/nga/pa r+sha ༵ /sas dīspran ༵༵ zlopang dwo sprapa ༷dī gh+nā (spra so/ /nges par 'jug pas ni rten lnga po rnams so/ /dge slong tshur shog ces gsungs pas ni grags pa la sogs pa rnams so/ /ston par khas blangs pas ni 'od srungs chen po'o/ /dri bas mnyes bas ni legs sbyin no/ /bla ma'i chos khas blangs pas ni skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo'o/ /pho nyas ni chos sgyin no/ /'dul ba 'dzin pa ma gtogs pa lngas ni mtha' gzhub kyi mi rngams sdu / /bcu'i tshogs kyis ni dbus kyi mi rnams zug/ /skyabs su 'gro ba lan gsum bzlas bas ni sde bzang drug cu'i tshogs kyis bsnyen par rjoges par byas pa rnams te/ de dag gi so sor thar pa'i sdom pa ni gdon mi za bar rnam par rig byed la rag las ba ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs zug/ /ston pa lo so drug dus bsnyen ldogs dang byang chub mnyam brjes/ lnga sdes mthong lam dang bsnyen rdzogs mnyam thob/ gling 'bum las/ de'i me+e bcom ldan 'das lo nyi shu rtsadagu 'dod pa rnams la rol te/ rga ba dang / na ba dang / shi ba gzigs nas yid byung lte/ nam phyed kyi dus su rta bsngags ldan la chibs nas nags su gshegs te lo drug tu dka' ba spyad nas/chu bo ne raji nar khus mdzad de/ dga' mo dang dga' stobs ma las lan bcu drug tu nying khur byas pa'i 'o zug gsol/ na'atshong bkra shis las nadag bzhes te byang chub kyi shing drung du ma 'dzings par bting / skyel mo krung bcas/ byang chub ma thob skya bar du skyil krung mi gzhig go zhes zugs bskyed/ bdud kyi dmag bye ba phrag sum cu rtsadrug btul nas mngon par ljags par sangs rgyas te/ tshangs pas bskul nas wa ra na sir chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te lnga sde dang / de nas nye ba'i lnga sde dang / krong gi khye'u gtso bo lnga bcu btul/ shing bal can gyi nags 396
so thar gyi sdom pa'i dogs gcod/khod du gshegs nas sde bzang drug bcu'i tshogs btul/ dmag ldan gyi grong du gshegs nas dga' mo dang dga' stobs ma gnyis bden par bkod/ lteng rgyas su gshegs nas lteng rgyas 'od srung btul/ yul ga yar gshegs nas chu klung 'od srung dang / ga ya 'od srung btul/ ral ba can stong brag rnams la tsho 'phrul gsum gyi gdams pa mdzad/ 'od ma'i ltang brang gnyis su gshegs te rgyal po gzugs can snying po gabor bcas dang / ma ga lha'i bram ze dang khyim bdag stong phrag du ma btul te 'od ma'i tshal bzhes nas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab bu mang gi mchod rten na bzhugs so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de dus yul sdus kyi bram ze n+ya hro lha skyes sam 'od srung gis ston pa la/ khyod ni ston pa/ kho bo nyan thos so zhes smras/ ston pas kyang nga khyod kyi ston pa/ khyod nga'i nyan thos so zhes gsungs pas bsnyen rdzogs thob/ 'od srung gi snam sbyar phul ba ston pas bzhes nas phyag dar khrod kyi snam sbyar de la gnang ngo / /nyin brgyad la slob par gnas/ de nas dgu pa la dgra bcom thob bar gsungs pa 'di'ang ston par khas blangs dus su mngon/dri mnyes ni/ ston pas legs sgyin la/ gcig tu dgos pa ni gang yin gsungs pas/thar pa'o/ /de la dgos pa gang yin/ dad pa'o zhes gsungs par dris lan thebs pas/ mnyes pa tsam gyis bsnyen ljags thob/ 'di 'od srung phyin yin nam snyam/tshur phyosnag ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas te rim gyis byon te 'od ma'i tshal na bzhugs so/ /grong na la da'i bram ze gnas len gyi bu mo lku ri ma'i bu/ pha bram ze skar rgyal las skyes pa'i nye rgyal dang / grong shing thag can gyi bram ze gzugs can snying po'i mdun na 'don gru 'dzin gyi bu bang nas skyes dang gnyis kyis mu stegs ston pa gzhan spangs te yang dag rgyal ba can nas rab tu byung lung bstan thob nas 'ongs pa'i sha ri'i bu la rta zul gyis chos bltan pas 397
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngabden pa mthong / des mo'u 'gal gyi bu la chos bstan pas bden pa mthong / de gnyis thog mar rta thul shing drung na bzhugs par btud de/ ston pa'i drung du songs te zhabs gnyis la phyag btsal nas/ btsun pa bdag cag zhes sogs kyis bsnyen pa ra rdzogs par gsol ba btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de gnyis la dge slong tshur shog /tshangs par spyod cig ces bka' stsal bas/ skra dang kha spu breg nas zhag bdun lon ba tsam dang / lag na lhung bzed dang bya ma bum thogs pa dang / dge slong bsnyen par cags nas lo brgya lon pa'i spyod lam lta bur gyur rto/ /de bzhin gshegs pas tshur shog bka' stsal bas/ /skra byi snam sbyar kyon pa'i lus ldan zhing / /mod la dbang po rab zhi gnas gyur te/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pas lus gzugs bkab bar gyur/ /zhes lhas bsngags so/ /'di gnyis kyi 'khor lnga brgya'ang de ltar lhan cig par mdzod 'grel las so/ /go rim lnga sde'i rjes sam dbyad/ bram ze gnas len gyi bu stod ring yang bden bzhi bstan pas bden pa mthong / gsol ba btab pas tshur zugag gis bsnyen par ljags/ de nas dgra bcom thob bo/ /skyabs 'gro lan gsum byas pas bsnyen ljags ni/ bcom ldan 'das wa ra na tra nas/grong khyer sde can dang / de nas ras bal can gyi nags su gshegs te shing drung na bzhugs so/ /grong khyer sde can gyi bud med la rtse'i lde bzang drug cu'i tshogs bud med cig bor pa tshol tu phyin/ bcom ldan 'das mthong nas phyag 'tshal bar/ gzhi gsum dang mtho ris kyi gtam dang /'dod pa'i nyes dmigs sogs dang / bden bzhi rgya cher bshad pas stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du bden pa mthong /skyabs 'gro sngon du byas nas dge bsnyen du gsol ba btab bo//de nas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 31nga / lung gzhi las de tsam las ma gsungs/ lung ma mo las gsol bzhi'i las ma bcas pa na skyabs 'gro'i tshig gsum gyi bsnyen par ljags pa dang /gsol 398
so thar gyi sdom pa'i dogs gcod/bzhi'i las bcas pa na bsnyen thegs min par bshad pas/ skyabs 'gro'i tshig gsum gyi bsnyen ljags ni gsol bzhi'i sngon du'o/ /mdzod 'grel dang ma mo ltar na steng yang de gsum gyis bsnyen rogos so/ /kha cig dge bsnyen la de'i ming btags zer/bla ma'i chos khas blangs pas bsnyen rjogs ni/ ston pa ser skya'i gnas shing n+ya wo lha'i kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i me+e skye dgu'i bdag mo bud med lnga brgya dang lhan cig bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas phyogs gcig tu lubod pas/ ston pas chos bshad de cang mi gsung bas/ skye dgu'i bdag mos bud med la 'bras bu bzhi thob ba yod na bud med la rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs gnang bar gsol bas/ khyim pa gos can dkar can sogs gsungs nas ma gnang / lan gsum bskyar kyang ma gnang / de nas ston pa ser skya nas yul na di dar gshegs pa thos pas skye dgu'i bdag mo bud med lnga brgya dang bcas rang rang gi skra bregs/ chos gos gyon te ston pa'i rjes su song nas/ ston pa na di sga'i gru dzi'i gnas na bzhugs pa la/ skye dgu'i bdag mo lus ngal zhing rdul gyis phog bzhin du phyag 'tshal gsol ba btab pas/ khyod gos 'di ltar gyon la sogs gsungs nas ma gnang / lan gsum bskyar kyang ma gnang bas/ de sgo khang gi phyi na mchi ma 'don zhing ngu ba la/ kun dga' bos zhus pas/bud med rab tu byung na bstan pa ring du mi gnas pa/ bud med lnga yang rkun pos bcom pa'i dpe/ chos 'dul ring du mi gnas/ bud med rigs la rtsand byung na chud zos 'gro ba'i nyes pa bshad pas/ 'on kyang lci ba'i chos ji srid 'tsho'i bar bsrung na bsnyen ljags bya'o gsungs pa'i bka' stsal/ kun dga' bos skye dgu'i bdag mo la smras pas/ de ltar lus ngag yid gsum gyis len par khas blangs pas bsnyen par cags/ de bzhin du bud med lnga brgya 'ong /'dir lci'i ba'i chos zhes/ lung ma mo/ mdor bla ma'i chos zhes gsungs pa ni 'gyur khyad de gu 399
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngaru ni bla ma dang smi ba dang brling pa sogs la 'jug pas so/ /pho nyas de ni/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na'o/ /sangs rgyas rang byung gis bsnyen ljags yin pas man snye las kyang de dus dge slong du gyur rto gsungs/ dbu skra bsil tshe nas dge slong dang rgyal rnams kyang ma der rtag tu rab byung byed par bshad pa phal cher rang byung kho na dang de rnams kyi dus su bsnyen rogs mi gsal yang mdo dang mdzod 'grel dag ltar na zad mi skye'i ye shes la mi stos par smon lam ston pas yin nam/ bsnyen par rjegros tshul bcu yin kyang de dag la sngon chog zer ba 'khul bar rtogs sla/ da tshog la mkhan po med na sdom pa skye mi skye lha dzopa r+sha r+sha pa ( /baX /dri driX gh+nā pa( /ba/ji spra wa spri ba/ sdiX (lha )(lha dzi~X āshā bshad/ 'o na/ rang dang mkhan po'i ming ma brjod pa thob dus mi shes pa rnams la mi skye bar bshad pa dang 'gal snyam na mi 'gal te/ de dag gtan nas mi skye bar ma gsung bar mi skye tsam gsungs pa'i phyir dang / gzhi'i skabs su'ang dmigs bsal gsung mod kyang der gsung la/ sgyir btang mang la zhu ba'i skabs 'dir gzhi rnam dag la dmigs bsal zhu ba'i gzhung yin pa'i pyir dang / zhu bas mkhan po'i ming ma brjod par gnyid sogs la'ang skye bar bshad pa'i phyir/ mkhan po sdom ldan min kyang blo ngo'i dbang gis skye ba yod de mkhan po bsnyen par ma rogs ba las kyang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa'i pyir/ mkhan po med kyang skye ba de sngon chog la dogs gcod min te/ de la mi stos par yang jis/ med kyang skye bar yang nges pa'i phyir dang /u pa rla'i dus su da tshog byung yang tshar la/ da chog rjes su de byas chog mi chog la'ang de ltar dris pa min te/ de ltar na tsho ga rung mi rung 'dri rigs kyi mkhan po yod med las skye mi skye'i dogs gcod mi rigs pa'i phyir dang / go dka' sla dang / the tshom skye mi skye'i khyad par yod 400
so thar gyi sdom pa'i dogs gcod/pa'i phyir/ tsho ga gnyis gang rung la ma yin par spyir de med par sdom pa skye mi skye la'ang min te/ bsnyen par ljags tshul bcu'i phal cher shes zin pa de'i phyir dang / de dag bcas tshar ba dang smyung tshar ba'i phyir des na da chog la yin te/ da chog la mkhan po dang bcas pa'i khyad par bshad pa la dogs pa skyes pa'i pyir/ skyes tshul yod de/ sgyir mkhan po med na dang /thob dus dang / ming gnyis ma brjod na mi skye bar bshad pa la 'o na de ltar gtan nas mi skye'am snyam pa'i dogs pa la/ pyi'i da sdom skye ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo dge 'dun yin pas mkhan po med kyang de ldan ltar skye ba dang / gsol 'debs sogs skye ba'i dngos rgyu tshang phyin thob dus phra mo mi shes pa ming gnyis ma brjod kyang skye ba'i dmigs bsal dang / mkhan po yid la'ang mtshan nyid de thams cad du'am zhe na tha snyad dam blo ngor yod pas chog pa gtso bo yin pas/ bsnyen par ma cags kyang skye ba'i dmigs bsal sogs bshad pa'i phyir/ zhes 'di na daphyod ldan 'ga' zhig gis ltar snang gi gzhan lugs bkag nas rang gi bla ma'i dgongs pa'i bdud ni btung zhing gzhan la nyer ba la gas par gyur to/ /so thar byang sems sngags kyi sdom pa gsum gyi/ngo bo theg chen skabs khas blangs ltar bsrung ba'i sems pa mngon lkog sa bon dang bcas pa/ldan tshul/ ngo bo tha dad la rgyud du mar thal ba'i skyon/ grub bde dbyer med kyi gcig yin na/snga phyi'i gtong rgyu phyogs res gsum nyams par thal ba sogs dang / gong ma gong ma 'og ma 'og ma'i gtong rgyu yin par thal ba/ gsum ldan med par thal ba sogs skya phyir ro/ /des na ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad yin te/ ngo bo gcig gang zhig ldog pa tha dad pa'i phyir/ dang po grub nye/ chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa bzhin gnas skabs ngo bo gcig yin kyang / slar dbyer yod pa gcig yin pa'i phyir te/ 'o chu 'dres pa gnas skabs so sor mi dmigs kyang ngang pas 'byed rung ba bzhin/ de gsum gnas skabs ngo bo so sor ma dmigs kyang skye gtong sogs 401
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngakyis so sor 'byod rgyu yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ gnas skabs ngo bo dbyer med kyang bslabs bcas skye gtong gi ldog cha tha dad yin pa'i phyir/ bslabs pa tha dad gcig btang la gnyis ldan sogs gtong tshul tha dad pa'i pyir/ de gsum thob me+e srung ba'i sems pa snga ma snga ma'i steng du gong ma'i bslabs pa dang bsrung sems kyis sems pa gcig rim gyis gong 'phel du 'dod/ yang na sems pa mngon lkog gis pye nas/ gsum ldan par byas na legs so/ /kha cig /so thar me+e 'phos tshe gtong ba'i gnad gzugs can zer ba mi 'thad de/ zeg chen skabs su ma nges pa'i phyir/ kha cig /khas blangs dbang gis zer na mi 'thad de/ khas blangs nas ma skyes pa yod pa'i phyir dang / khas ma blangs kyang dge sdig gi ldan pa du ma yod pa'i pyir/ des na sdom gsum gyi ldan dus ring zung mi 'dra ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ bcas dbang dang khas blangs dbang gis yin pa'i phyir/ de gsum gyi bcas pa mi 'dra ba yun ring zung khas blangs pa'i cho ga ltar thob pa'i phyir ro/ /bslab bya gsum 'gal ba 'gag zug tshe byed tshul yod de/ rang gzhan gyi don nam dgos pa gang che 'dzin dgos kyi/ chung ngu'i ched du chen po btang mi rigs pa'i phyir/ chung ngu'i spra ( sdi snro dzoca pata ༵ chu/ /spra sna hūm̐/sa/ gā kau ༵ zlo ༵ stu dri ༈ /spya sbyipa hā rnyilha /lha ṭ+wāṃ /sna sna gyi rtsabazhi sogs bsrungs pa las lhag pa'i phyir ro//dge slong rnam dag pha ma dang /dge slong pha nang la byin len chags pa la lag nya zos pa'am byin len ma byas par za ba'i skyongan byung dogs te byin len byed dogs rang gi za ched min tshe dang / rang gi za 'dod nas des kyang blangs nas gzhan byin zos na'o/ /dgrad gzhi che ba sogs/ thun tshod rung ba'i thun mtha' ni/ nyi ma dmar thag chod tshe yin te/ gung nas de bar la skom tsam mtshan mo mi 'ongs pa'i phyir/ byin rlabs la 402
so thar gyi sdom pa'i dogs gcod/dgos pa ci snyam na/ snga dro nas byin len byas nas byin rlabs byas pas de bar gsog 'jog 'gog ched dang / skom nad kyang nad pa kho nar ma nges rang bzhin pa kha cig la'ang 'ongs chos gos dras drub dar chog rjes nas mngon te/ kun dga' bo la de'i rnam bzhag thog mar bslab pa'i phyir/ 'di yang rje btsun bzhad pas gsungs so/ /403
404
gtor ma'i rnam bshad gzhung don rab gsal/da༅༅/ /gtor ma'i rnam bshad rgyal ba'i bde lam gzhung casan rab gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs 31/ /na mo gu ru mañdzu māṣā ya ts+tsha swa ra swa ste/lha mi'i bla ma shākya'i rgyal bo dang //bdud rtsi'i sgo 'byed btsun pa kun dga' bo//jo bo yab sras sku mched snar thang ba//dge 'dun rgya mtsho paṇa chen yab sras sogs//tshegs chung lam bzang ston rnams phyag bya'i yul//la la bu/mkhas kyang brgya rtsa'i khungs med skad//ril bu kho na 'dod de lung dang 'gal//jo bo mi 'drin zla rgyan 'drin sogs dri//dag byed bka' gdams snga phyi'i gang gā'i rgyun//rgyud dang rgya gzhung grangs med rba rlabs can//shub bstan ma spros mtsho las legs 'byung ba//bsten gang tshogs gnyis lha dbang rjes 'gro zhing //sangs rgyas bye ba gaṅgā'i klung dgyes 'dzum//de la 'dir chu gtor sgya rnam bzhag la/ gang la brten pa'i gzhung ngos bzung ba/ lo rgyus brgyud tshul dang bcas pa/cho ga'i rnam bzhag bshad pa dang gsum las/dang po ni/rgyud bdud tsi'grang ba dang /'jam dpal khri drug stong bzhi pa'i rtog pa dang /kha 'bar ma'i gzungs gnyis dang /405
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngachu gtor gyi cho ga dza ya sa nas mdzad pa dang / de'i 'grel ba shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa dang /jo bo lha cig gis mdzad pa'i chu gtor dang / bdud rtsi'agrang ba'i rnam bshad jo bos mdzad pa dang / rgyal ba'i sde'i gtor chog gi rnam bshad slob dpon mi bskyod pas mdzad pa dang /a bya'i k+ṣiṃ ༵ gañdza ༵ ༵ ༵ sa/ gā shā ༵ spya mi (rdzu 51 dang /klu sgrub kyi gtor ma sna tshogs rnams la gnyis pa lo rgyus brgyud tshul la gnyis las/ lo rgyus ni/ bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i gzungs zhes bya ba chab gtor gyi rgyud de/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na bzhugs pa'i me+e khyim bdag bzang skyong gis spos chu la sman dang me tog sna tshogs btab pa gcig khyer nas bcom ldan 'das la/ sangs rgyas byang sems dang rigs drug la phul bas phan yon chen po 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes zhus pas/ bdud ji 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas sngags drug ting nge 'dzin drug gsungs te/ rgyal ba'i sde'i chu gtor las/ spyir gtor ma'i las bgyi'o/ /'tshal ma brtags pa rnam pa drug ste sbyangs pa la 〈snags pa'o/ /zhes ṭ+wāṃ /da/sna /dzipa hūṃ k+ṣiṃ pa k+ṣiṃ ni//daX gh+nā ༵ shāng dru/shā r+shasdu ḍā nge/ ṅgi dh+ri pañdza ra ( /shā /drur+shab r+sha don brtags pa ste sems par byed pa yin pa'i pyir/ dza ya se na'i chu gtor las/ sbyor gtor ma'i las bgyi'o/ /'tshal ma brtags pa drug ste sbyangs pa la sogs pa'o/ /de la sbyangs pa ni chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /spel ba ni nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas so/ /mos pas bsgyur ba bdud rtsi'abyung ba'i sngags dang phyag rgyas so/ /spyod par dbang ba ni rgya chen shugs ldan 'od kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas so/ /thob par byed ba ye shes skar mda'i sngags dang phyag rgyas so/ /dbang du bya ba ni lha mgon spyi'i sngags dang phyag rgyas 406
gtor ma'i rnam bshad gzhung don rab gsal/te dbang phyug 'khor lo'i sngags dang phyag rgyas dreg/ /zhes dang / mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyud sde spyi rnam las kyang / bdud rtsi'abyung ba'i gzungs zhes bya ba chab gtor gyi rgyud de/zhes dang / chu gtor rnam bshad shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa las/ thams cad mnyam par thob pa mi mthun pa med pa ste/ de nyid kyi phyir sngags dang phyag rgyas don thams cad 'grub par byed pa yin no/ /de yang ji skad so gsang sngags rnams ni brjod pa dang / /rdo rje phyag rgya rab ldan pas/ /dngos bo gang la btab na ni/ /dag pa la sogs rim bzhin 'grub/ /ces gsungs pa sogs yod pas/chu gtor thams cad kha 'bar ma'i gzungs la brten snyam pa dang /jo bos mdzad pa'i chu gtor med snyam pa ni blun rtags yin la/bdud mi'argyung ba'i rnam bshad jo bos mdzad pa las/ bha ga la ru skyes pa dge slong mtshan/ zhes pa nas/ bdud rtsi'i 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i gtor ma'i cho ga'i 'grel ba rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po dī baṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na lha mo slol ma'i zhal mngon sum du gzigs pa des mdzad pa ljags so//zhes dang /jo bo'i chu gtor las/slob dpon de nyid la zhu ba po dkar ston legs pa'i shes rab kyis tshogs la sogs pa'i yan lag tu zhus nas/mang yul gyi grong du gzhung bris so//paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang /lo ts+tsha ba tshul khrims rgyal sdung lhaji bzlo/ shā/ (sna /sna lhasbyog/ ni/ / yi dwags kha nas me 'bar ma la skyabs mdzad pa'i gzungs las/ bcom ldan 'das ser skya'i zong khyer gyi shing n+ya zo lha'i kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ kun dga' bos bas mtha' bsten pa na/ nam smad cig yi dwags kha nas me 'bar ba zhig byung nas khyod zhag bdun nas 'chi'o/ /shi nas yi dwags su skye'o 3ra ro/ /de la ci phan dris pas/ sang gi nyi ma la yi dwags thams cad la gtor ma byin te/ bram ze'i drang srong brgya stong la zhal zas byin/ dkon mtshog gsum la mchod na phan zer/ kun dga' bo 'jigs 407
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum nganas ston par zhus pas/ cho ga dang gzungs sngags dang de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod pa sogs phan yon dang bcas pa gsungs/ kha 'bar ma dbugs dbyung ba'i cho ga las de gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan ma byung / gzhan sngags dang cho ga sogs 'dra bar gsungs/ bu dang mkhas grub rje gnyis spu'i rgyud sde sgyi rnam las kun dga' bo la gsungs par bshad pa gzungs dang mthun/sngon byung gi gleng gzhi gzhan yang / sngon sangs rgyas rgyal byed kyi tshal du bzhugs pa la ma ga har khyim bdag phyug po dge zhes pas/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la tshos ston phul nas/ phyi de lo'i dus na khyim bdag dbul por gyur te sangs rgyas la zhus pas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la zhus gsungs nas/ khyim bdag gis spyan ras gzigs la zhus pas/khyod kyis sngar mchod pa'i yi dwags dang 'byung bo'i skal ba bcad pas nyes pas/ da mchod cig gsungs pa ltar/ yi dwags dang 'byung gtor gyi cho ga gnang zhing mchod pas/ khyim bdag gi 'byor ba sngon bzhin legs par gyur nyo/ /slob dpon ye shes rdo rje'i lam rim las/ de yang sangs rgyas rgyal byed kyi tshal na bzhugs pa la/ ma ga har khyim bdag phyug po dge zhes bya bas/ sangs rgyas gabor bcas spyan drangs nas chos ston drangs te slar gshegs so/ /phyi de lo'i dus na khyim bdag de stogs par gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar phyin nas dris pa la/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la zhus zhes bstan nas/ khyim bdag gis spyan ras gzigs la zhus pas/ khyod kyis sngar mchod pa'i yi dwags dang 'byung po'i skal ba bcad pas nyes te/ da 'di bzhin du yi dwags sgo drung na yod pa dang gzhan dag la'ang gtor ma 'di ltar byin zhes gong gi de bstan nas/de ltar byas pas sngon bzhin 'gyor pa dang ldan par gyur to/ /zhes gsungs pa sogs mang /408
gtor ma'i rnam bshad gzhung don rab gsaggnyis pa brgyud tshul la mang du yod kyang / kun dga' bo/ gcung dga' bo/ des dge slong ma dga' ma la gnang / des dgra bcom pa la gnang / des rnal 'gror pa anan+ta badz+ra la/des rdo rje gdan pa la/ des gser gling ba la/ des jo bo la/ des bshes gnyen ston pa la/des sku mched gsum la/ po rto pas ram sding pa'am sha ra ba la dar yul ko tur gnang / des dpal ldan grags pa la/ des chu nag pa rin chen seng ge la/ des ras pa dar ma rgyal mtshan la/ bla ma de gnyis las gro ston bdud rtsigrags/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/ rgyang ro paṇa chen/ mchims blo bzang grags pa/ slo ston kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ dbang ston grub pa shes rab/ zhu ston bsod nams mtshog grub/ dpal 'bar chos rje dpal ldan grub/ las chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ zel brag lcogs pa/ thon pa blo zos rgyal mtshan/ dge 'phel phyogs las rnam rgyal/thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ brag dgon spyan snga chos dpal bzang po/lubon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ rgyal dbang ngag dbang slo bzang rgya mtsho/ de las khyab bdag pha bong kha ba 'jam grags dang /khyab bdag dge slong 'jam grags pa dang /mer rgan ngag dbang blo gros gsum spus gsan/ gsum spur bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas lan mang du thob/yang phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rje sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa/ bla ma drung pa balcargo 'grus rgyal mtshan/ de las grub chen shwa 'o ba dang / mer rgan rnam gnyis kyis thob/ de gnyis las grub chen la/ bdag gis yer bar lan gsum zhus/ yang 'brug lha'i dpon slob slo bzang dpal 'byor las snar thang brgya rtsa'i yig rnying dang / de'i lhan thabs skyid shod zhabs drung gis mdzad pa rjes gnang dang bcas pa lan bzhir thob/ paṇa chen bka' 'gyur ba las brgya rtsadage 'dun rgya mtsho dang / paṇa chen gyi de gnyis dang rgyal ba gong mas mdzad pa'i gtor ma sna tshogs lan du mar thob/ bla ma drung 409
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngaba las khong gis dngos su zhus/ yang jo bo lha cig nas/ nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba/ lag sor ba/ zhu ldan pa/ ra sa pa/ snar thang ba/ dpa/la ldan gro/ mchims man chad 'dra/ spyan snga nas brgyud pa zur du mi snang yang / po rto ba'i brgyud pa dang gcig par snang / gdams pa tshan gnyis yod/ grub chen snying stobs rgya mtsho na re/ mgron rgyas par byed na bcu gcig tu spyan snga bas mdzad nas ril bu yang brgya tshar du bshams pa'i gtor ma la brgya rtsa'i tha snyad du byas pa de nas byung / zhes gsungs pa/ sprul sku ngag dbang dge legs rgyal mtshan gsungs/ brgya rtsa'i tha snyad de nas byung gsungs pa bden te/ mchims yang de ltar gsungs/ 'di la rnam mkhyen bde lam du brgya gabatang thabs kha 'bar ma'i gzungs rnam pa gnyis la brten nas mdzad cing / gzungs ni dkon gsum la lha bshos 'bul ba la gzungs nyi shu rtsagacig /drang slong la gtor ma 'bul ba dang / yi dwags la gzungs bdun bdun dang / de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod de gtor ma sgyin par gsungs pa ma gartogs pa brgya ②stong rtsa'i grangs nges pa/ margyon gyi rim pa'i gsal kha gsungs pa med gsungs so/ /de la cung zad dbyad na mi 'thad de/ brten sa de ltar bshad pa yang mi 'thad/ mgron gyi grangs ma brtan pa'ang mi 'thad/ brgya rtsami 'thad na bde lam gyi chu gtor brgya ②yang mi 'thad pa sogs snang ba'i phyir/dang po brten sa kha 'bar ma'i gzungs kho nar gsungs pa mi 'thad bar thal/ de brten sa'i gzhung du ma rang cag rnams la mthun grub yin pa'i phyir te/ 'jam dpal khri drug stong pa'i zhi ba'i rgyud dang / gtor ma chen po'i las rim dang / de'i 'grel ba slob dpon mi bskyod pas mdzad pa dang / chu gtor 'jam dpal ma'i rtsab dza ya se nas mdzad pa dang / de'i 'grel ba phyag chen 'jug pa'i man ngag slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa dang / 'gro bzang snying po'i chu gtor dang / chu gtor 'jam dpal ma'i 'grel ba n+da dhā dzñā nas mdzad pa dang /410
gtor ma'i rnam bshad gzhung don rab gsatshibdud rtsi'argyung ba'i gzungs dang / de'i 'grel ba jo bo rjes mdzad pa dang / chab gtor dri med jo bo rjes mdzad pa dang / a bya'i byang chub gzhung lam gyi gtor tshog dang ye shes rdo rje'i lam rim de nyid mthong ba'i gtor chog dang bcas pa yod pa'i phyir/ de dag gis mdzad tshul rim gyis ston par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa gtor mgron sgya grangs ston pa'i rgya gzhung med par 'dod pa'ang mi 'thad de/ gtor chen las rim las rigs drug sogs thams cad bshad/ de'i 'grel par sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang dang khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad bshad pa'i phyir/ dang po yin te/ las rim las/ 'gro ba ma lus casan du ni/ /gtor ma chen po'i rim pa 'di/ /zhi pa/ /spya snro 〉( bsdi( mil/ ba/zhe ༵༵ nga tha/n+dha hūm̐ slo /sbyipa m+b+ya thama~X ṭ+wāṃ dh+ri shāshā pa/ ni/ lha dang / lha ma yin dang / mi dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dwags dang / dmyal ba ste sgyi la gtor bas ma lus pa'i don no/ /chen po zhes bya ba ni snga ma bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yang yin te/ de'i 'grel ba slob dpon mi bskyod pas mdzad pa las/ spyan drangs snyam pa la/ bder gshegs sras bcas 'khor bcas kun/ /zhes gsungs/ sangs rgyas rnams bde bas bde bar gshegs pa/ sras ni byang chub sems dpa'o/ /'khor ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams so/ /yang thams cad kyang bde bar gshegs pa'i 'khor te/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad dang bcas pa zhes kha cig 'dod do/ /zhes dang /rgyal ba'i sde'i chu gtor las kyang / de yang dmigs kyis bsngo ba ni/ sri zhu'i mgron sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la semags pa'o/ /yon tan gyi mgron tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi dang / phyogs skyong ba bcu gcig dang / srung 411
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngama dam tshig can rnams dang / snying rje'i mgron 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad dang / khyad par du'ang bdag gi lha mgon dang / yul gang na gnas pa'i sa bdag lha klu dang /lan chags kyi mgron me+e rabs bgrang ba'i rkyen bgegs dang phan gnod byed pa'i lha 'dre kun la'ang mnyam 41mas su bsnyed bar byacad/ /zhes gsungs pas ma11na grangs gsal bar bshad cing / lha klu dang zhes pas/ lha dang klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / sto 'phye ste sde brgyad bstan te/ 'grel ba las/ de'i 'og tu spra dh+ri mi ༵༵ sa~X /sra du 〉sdu hālta spya ka/ /shā ( shā gli3 pa'i par+shamapa zlo shra shā n+takar pa paswā (zu/ sna ṭā 〈klu/ mi/ r+sha ji/kyidri spyashā k+ta shu/ spras la pasu (sna pa (shā / /lhang pazlo gig lhagā ༷gapa da( ra/ ga ru ṭa/ zhin ra/ ma ho ra ga /zhes pa serdzogs dang mthun pas legs/ gzungs gnyis kyi don lhag ma 'chad par 'gyur la/ gzungs 'dis kyang de ltar ma bstan par bshad mi thub ste/dkon mchog gsum la don dam pa dang kun rob pa gnyis phye bas sku gsung shugs kyi rten la mchod pa yang sangs rgyas la mchod par 'dod cing 'di gtso bor nyams su len dgos pa'i pyir/ thub dgongs las kyang / sangs rgyas rnam pa gnyis te/ don dam pa ni sku gsum gyis rnyi( )pa zlo shāXdī (sbyo/ r+yaṃ/ /nā rnyi sdi sdi (55 spra paX/ spyan shādri sa/ spya tshoXpa (( dītā mchod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / byang sems sangs rgyas dkon ma〈snag gi nang du gtogs par mdo dang bstan bcos du ma nas bshad de/ dkon brtsegs las/ 'od srung zla ba tshes pa la phyag byed pa ltar nya ba la ni ma yin no/ /de bzhin du gang dag nga la dad pa 412
gtor ma'i rnam bshad gzhung don rab gsagde dag gis kyang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag bya yi/ de bzhin gshegs pa la ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa sogs mchod yul sgya sangs rgyas la brdar btags pa gtso bor byed dgos pa'i phyir te/ so skyes mang mas don dam pa'i dkon mchog gsum la dmigs mi nus pa'i phyir dang / brdar btags pa la dmigs pas 'bras bu cha mthun 'byung bar theg spru gong 'og dang grub mtha' bzhi ka mthun pa'i phyir/ yang zub dgongs las/ chos kyang rnam pa gnyis te/ don dam pa ni mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /tha snyad pa ni lam dang sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab glegs bam rnams te/ 'di rnams la mchod na chos la mchod par zhal gyis 'ches pa'i phyir/zhes tha snyad pa'i dkon mchog la gsung rab kyi glegs bam yan chad bshad pa lta bu mang /mchod yul gyi dge 'dun la'ang don dam pa'i de dang tha snyad pa'i dge 'dun gnyis bshad de/shub dgongs las/ dge 'dun yang rnam pa gnyis te/ don dam pa ni byang chub sems dpa' sa la rab tu zhugs pa rnams dang / tha snyad pa ni so so skye bo rnams kyang ste sde pa bzhi la sogs pa dang dge slong dang dge slong ma rnams so/ /zhes dang / 'dul ba lung las kyang / phyag gi 'os ni gnyis te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang dge slong rgan pa'o/ /zhes dang / mya ngan 'das chen las/ bsod snyoms gang yongs su gsol nas/ zhes pa nas/ bsod stoms de gnyis da'ang 'bras bu mnyam pa med pa'o/ /zhes dang / de'i don ni/ thub dgongs las/ 'dis ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / sangs rgyas rnams yon gnas mchog tu khyad par med par bstan rto/ /zhes gsungs/ der ma zad/drang srong la bshad tshul mang ngo / /des na bod dag gis/ gtor chog gi mazon tshan bcu gcig lta bu'i bshad pa de dag sri zhu'i mgron/ yon tan gyi mgron/ snying rje'i mgron/ lan chags kyi mgron dang bzhir bsdus nas bstan pa'i phyir/ dang po yin te/ rgyal ba'i sde'i chu 413
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngagtor las/ de yang dmigs kyi bsngo ba ni sri zhu'i mthon sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la sogs pa dang / zhes dang / de'i 'grel ba shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa las/ khyad par du yongs su bsngo ba bstan pa'i phyir/ de yang dmigs kyi bsngo ba ni/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos te/ de ni 'dir rnam pa gnyis te/ gang zhe na/ sri zhu'i mgron sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos dang rang rgyal ba la sogs pa ji snyed brjod pas ldogs pa dag go zhes so/ /de dag ljags pa ni ma lus pa'i don no/ /des ni yi dam rgyud lde'i lha tshogs yang bstan pas so/ /gnyis pa yang yin te/ yon tan gyi mgron stong gsum gyi bdag bo tshangs pa dang / sa gsum gyi bdag po brgya byin/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi dang / phyogs skyong bcu gcig sngon sangs rgyas kyis rgyud sde bzhi'i chos bsrung bar bka' bsgos dam bcas pa'i srung ma dam tshig can rnams yin pa'i phyir te/ dza ya'i chu gtor las/ yon tan gyi mgron tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi dang / phyogs skyong bcu gcig dang / srung ma dam tshig can rnams dang / zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa yang yin te/ rang gi pha dang mar lan grangs brgya sogs byed ma myong ba'i 'gro ba rigs drug gang yang med pas nye du lta bur bsam nas snying rje'i yul 'tho ba lha dang lha min/ mi dang yi dwags dang / dud 'gro dang dmyal ba'i 'gro ba ste rigs drug gi sems can dang / khyad par du yang bdag gi mgon dang skyabs byed pa'i lha dang / yul gang na gnas pa'i lha dang klu rnams mthon yin pa'i phyir te/ gtor chog las/ snying rje'i mgron 'gro ba rigs drug gis sems can dang / khyad par du yang bdag gi lha mgon dang / yul gang na gnas pa'i sa bdag lha klu dang zhes dang / mkhas grub chen po ngag dbang grags pa'i gtor chog 414
gtor ma'i rnam bshad gzhung don rab gsal/las kyang / 'bru gsum sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs/ /lhag pa'i lha dang bla ma dang / /dkon mchog gsum dang chos skyong rnams/ /lce yis rdo rje bdud milen/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa yang yin te/ tshe rabs snga mar kho la phar 'phrog brdung sogs kyi gnod pa byas pa'i las lan chags pa'i lan chags kyi mgon/ rgyal bar byed pa dang / sbrang rtsir byed pa dang / tra na ya ka dang / lha klu btsan rgyal 'gong ma mo sogs phan gnod gnyis ka byed pa'i gdon dang 'byung po lha 'dre sna tshogs pa gnas tshul ni/ dpung bzang gi rgyud las/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang / /dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yul kun gnas dang / /shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang / /grong khyer kun tu gang dag gnas pa dang / /chu bo kun dang chu bo'i mdo rnams dang / /rin chen gnas na lhag par gang gnas dang / /thing dang mtshe dang lu ma lteng ka dang / /khron pa dang ni ngam grog chu mig dang / /spong dang phyugs dag dang ni nags tshal dang / /khang stong dang ni lha yi khang pa dang / /gang dag gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas/ /so nam khyim dang glang po'i khang rnams dang / /gang dag rgyal po'i dkor khang gnas pa dang / /srang dang khyams dang grong gi mdun sa dang / /gang dag shing gcig drung dang lam chen gnas/ /dur khrod dang ni nags tshal che gnas dang / /seng ge gcan gzan dred kyi gnas rnams dang / /'jigs su rung ba'i dgon pa che gnas dang / /chu gling mchog dag tu ni gnas pa dang / /gang dag lhun po dur khrod gnas na gnas/ /zhes gnas kyi sgos bshad pa lta bu mang ba'i pyir/ rgyal ba'i sde'i gtor tshog las/ lan chags kyi mgron me+e rabs bgrangs pa'i rkyen bgegs dang phan gnod byed pa'i lha 'dre kun la'ang mnyam snyoms su bsngo bar bya'o/ /zhes dang / kun snying gi sbyong rgyud 'grel ba las kyang / bgegs dang bi na ya ka zhes pa ni bar du gcod pa ste tshangs pa dang srin po'i gdon dang / brjed byed kyi gdon dang / gnon po 415
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngadang skem byed dang / grib gnon dang ma mo'i gdon dang / mi na ya ka btsun mo dang bcas pa brgyad ces dang / sbyong rgyud las/ 'dzam bu'i gling du tshangs pa bri/ /zhes pa nas/ de bzhin sring mo rnal 'gyor ma/ /'grang ba bzhi yi lha chen po/ /khyim dang ri la gnas pa rnams/ /shing dang kun dga' nags tshal 〈snags/ /zhes dang / kun dga' snying po'i 'grel pa las sems can kun la phan sems ba'i/ /drang srong bskal pa chen po rnams/ /zhes pa ni drang 〈snang brgyad de/ mes byin rin chen 'bar ba bsnams pa'o/ /nag po gabor lo'o/ /yang dag shes rdo rje 'khor lo'o/ /mdun dbang rtse gsum/ gya gyu rin po che bsnams pa/ khur mid dgra sta/ a 'gur me dpung / g.yog 'dor 'khor lo bsnams pa zhes dang / 'grel ba de nyid las/ 'byung ba bzhi yi lha chen po/ /zhes bya ba ni/ me lha dang / chu lha dang / rlung lha dang / sa'i lha rnams so/ /khyim dang ri la gnas pa dang / /zhes pa ni/ khyim gyi lha kun tu bsrung ba dang / ri'i lha rab tu brtan pa'i slo gros so/ /shing dang kun dga' la gnas sogs/ /zhes pa ni/ shing gi lha kun nas 'od zer dang / kun dga' ra ba'i lha kun tu snang ba'i blo gros dang / gnas kyi lha sna tshogs sgom/ /dur khrod skya lha 'byung po dge ba dang / grong khyer gyi lha dge ba'i blo zos so/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams kyang mgron tshan bzhi ci rigs su byed dgos te/ drang srong mchog brgyad po dge 'dun dkon mchog gi char gtogs te/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar rgyud du ma thos shing bzung bas dge 'dun gnyis gang rung du 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ 'jam dpal rtsargyud las/ gang yang drang slong dang drang slong chen po de dag la 'di lta ste rgyun shes kyi bu dang / gnas 'jog dang / gau ta ma dang / bha gor tha dang / dza hū dang / aṅgi ra ba dang / am ri dang / su ma sti dang /ri byi dang / rgyas pa dang / nag po dang / gau ta ma nag po dang / me dang me'i rgyud dang / dza ma tāt+na dang / yod pa ba dang /thub pa mchog dang / gos can dang / bai shā pā yā na dang / rtsib log skyes 416
gtor ma'i rnam bshad gzhung don rab gsagdang / ma mtshan gnyis skyes dang / dgra sta dang / rnal 'byor dbang rgyug dang / shang n+da pa la gnas pa dang / shing n+da pa la za ba dang / grog mkhar skyes dang / nyi ma'i rigs te/ de dag dang gzhan yang chen po brgya stong phrag du ma'i lubor dang ldan pa de dag kyang lubor gyi dkyil gdor de dang nye bar phyin te/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal nas sngags spyod pa'i don dang byang chub chen pho sems dpa'i sde snod mnyan pa'i phyir dang / rjes su yi rangs pa'i don du 'khod par gyur rto/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / gzhan rnams phal cher yon tan kyi mgron du snang ngo / /yang 'dir mgron spyan ma drangs na gtor ma mi rung bar bsam ste/ mgron la spyan 'dren rung ba dang mi rung ba sogs kyi rnam bzhag lung rigs med pa mang du smra ba mi 'thad de/gtor ma la mchod sbyin lugs dang / 'byung gtor gnyis yod pas snga ma la spyan 'dren mi dgos pa jo bo yab sras dang / 'phags yul sgyi paṇa grub chen po dza ya se na dang / mkhas grub dbang phyug shākya bshes gnyen sogs kyis bzhed pa'i phyir dang / jo bo yab sras de ltar bzhed pa po rto pas gsungs pa'i phyir te/ kro ston gsung las/ spyir gtor ma la gnyis te/mchod sgyin gyi gtor ma dang / 'byung gtor ro/ /'byung gtor gyi lugs kyi mgron spyan 'dren pa las/ 'di mtshog sbyin gyi lugs so zhes dang / jo bo lha cig gi bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i ṭīk+ka las kyang / mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma nar ma byed par 'dod pas/ zhes pa nas/ gtor ma zhes pa thabs dang shes rab tu ldan ba thams cad la khyab pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / chu gtor sgya sdod che chung ci 'byor pa'i nang tu phye rtsal te de la chu zhes bya ba dang zhi bar byed pa'i phyir/ dngos su byams pa dang snying rje'i bdag nyid de/ zhes pa nas/ yongs su btags pa'i pye blugs te/sems can thams cad kyi nye bar 'tsho ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du/ shin tu mdzes pa'i snod nang pu /dri med chu gtsang la sogs la/ /gsang sngags rnams ni rab sbyangs te/ /yongs 417
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngasu bsngo bya don chen phyir/ /zhes gsungs sheng / dza ya se na ltar spyan 'dren ma mdzad do/ /de bzhin du po rto ba dang / nag tsho dang / spyan snga gsum spu'i gtor chog las spyan 'dren med par mchod sbyin lugs kyi gtor ma phul snang khyad par gnyis pa dza ya se nas kyang spyan mi 'dren par mchod sbyin gyi tshul du 'jig rten ma lus par khyab cing dus 'khor ba ma stongs par du mgron bzhi la 'khor ba ma stongs par du 'bul bar bsngo ba yin te/ dza ya se na'i chu gtor las/ dbang po lnga yi longs spyod mkho dgu ldan/ /nam mkha' mtha' klas gter chen gyur pa 'di/ /mchod gnas bla ma khyed kyi pho brang du/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyis rgyas shing 'phel bar bsngo / /zhes dang / de'i 'grel pa las kyang / de yang rim pa kha cig las/ mchod pa la sogs pa'i gnas skabs ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa'i gnas skabs su spyan drangs te/ mnyes pa'i lag gi mnyes par bya ba 'byung na/ 'dir ni de ltar ma yin te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ phar mgron gang yin gyi gnas sam pho brang sogs su 'byung bar bsngo ba yin te/ rtsabar/ khyod kyi pho brang du gsungs pa'i gtan tshigs kyis grub ba'i phyir te/ 'grel pa las/ mchod gnas bla ma khyod kyi pho brang du zhes bya ba'i gtan tshigs kyis/ rang gi gzhan yas khang la sogs pa nyid du 'byung bar grub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs shing / der ma zad spyan 'dren mi dgos pa'i 'dod tshul du ma yod de/ sngon gyi smon lam dbang gis sems can re re'i mdun na rtag tu bzhugs par 'dod pa dang / sku bzhin du gsung dang shugs kyang sems can re re'i mdun na dus kun tu bzhugs par 'dod pa dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis sems can gyi khams gar yod du sangs rgyas kyang yod par 'dod pa de'i phyir/dang po yod de/ shākya mi tra'i 'grel ba las/ sngags kyi tshul kha cig las kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa ni sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis sems can re re'i mdun na'ang rtag tu 418
wa wawa gtorama'irnam bzhad gzhung don rab gsal/bzhugs te/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyir/ khyad par gnyis pa yod de/ shākya mi tra'i 'grel ba las/sku ji lta ba bzhin du gsung dang zugs kyang ste rtag tu 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyad par gsum pa yod de/ shākya mi tra'i 'grel ba las/ gzhan 'di skad du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni sngon gyi smon lam sgya dbang gis sems can yongs su smin par mdzad pa'i phyir byung bas/ sems can gyi khams ci tsam na 'tshad pa de thams cad na bzhugs pa yin te/ rnam pa thams cad du sems can gyi don mdzad par kun tu snang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang bod kha cig /gtor ma'i rdzas la ril bu kho na dang bcu tshan re dgos par 'dod cing / bshad dgos pa'i sngags dang mtshan bzhi'i dmigs pa sogs gang yang ma bshad pa mi 'thad de/ 'di'i rtsab gzungs gsum dang 'gal/ rgyal ba'i sde sogs kyi gtor zlos dī ༵ /pa// (pa ṭ+wāṃ pa/tsho (tshom che snang rdospri lha( hūm̐ pakli paX pa ༷ji hā/ k+ta du sna ༵༵ snod gtsang mar chan nam/ phye'am khur ba la sogs pa'i bza' ba cung zad kyis chog par bshad cing / khyod kyis ril bu kho na bshad pa'i phyir/ kha 'bar ma skyabs mdzad pa'i gzungs las/ 〈snad gtsang ma'i nang du chu gtsang ma zlug la/ gan nam/ phye'am/ khur ba la zugags pa cung zad cig btab ste/ zhes dang / kha 'bar ma dbugs dbyung ba'i gzungs las/ me tog gam/bdug pa'am/ spos sam/ zas dang skom gyi yo byad la lan nyi shu rtsagacig bzlas brjod byas la/ sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun la 'bul bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / bdud ni 'byung ba'i gzungs las/ sngar gling gzhi ltar bshad pa'i phyir/ 'di ltar du mas bshad do/ /khyad par du rgyal lde sogs kyi gtor chog dang 'gal bas tha chad yin par thal/ rgyal ba'i sde sogs kyis kyang rab 'byor na sman lnga dang / dri lnga dang / rin po che lnga dang / 'bru lnga 419
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngadang / snying po lnga dang / spos dang / me rtog dang / dkar gsum mngar gsum dang 'bras sogs kyi chan dang / khur ba sogs dang / ma 'phyor na chu la zan nam phye gang rung lta bu ci tsam 'byor pa bshams pas chog par gsungs pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/ gtor ma'i las rim las rin chen snod mtshes chu gtsang dang / /rin chen lnga dang sman lnga dang / /'bru sna dang ni snying po lnga/ /spos dang me rtog mdzis pa lnga/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum phye'am zan/ /'bras la sogs pa'i chan khrol dang / /khur ba la sogs gtsang ma'i zas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/khyad par gnyis pa yang yin te/ gtor ma'i las rim las/ ji tsam 'byor tsam bshams par bya/ /zhes dang / de'i 'grel bar slob dpon mi bskyod pas/ phye dang zan ni gnyis ka dgos pa ma yin gyi/ yang na zhes pa'i don no/ /de yang rnam pa thams cad du dgos pa ma yin gyi/ nus chung du 'gror tshad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyed cag 'byor mi 'byor gang yin kyang rtsam pa kho na'i ril bu bcu re byed pa yang mi 'thad par thal/ gtsang zhing ma sbags pa'i sman sogs rgya chen 'byor na gtong bar bshad pa'i phyir/ slob dpon mi bskyod pa'i gtor ma'i las rim 'grel ba las/ bla ma mnyes par byas shing rgyud thos nas las kyi rim pa shes nas rin po che'i sdod la sogs pa'i rdzas 'byor ba yo byad bsags te/ snod rin po che las byas pa bzo legs pa'i nang du ma sbags pa/ mi gtsang ba la sogs pas sme bar ma gyur pa dang / gser dang / byu ru dang / dngul dang / mu tig dang / shel la sogs pa'i rin po che sna tshogs pa dang /daṇ+ḍa ka ri dang / ha sa de ba dang / bri ha nyi dang / tan tong pa la dang / she ta/ a pa ra tsit+ta la sogs pa sman thams cad dang / 'bras dang / nas dang / zo dang / ma sha dang / sran ma la sogs pa 'bru thams cad dang / tshwa dang mar dang sbrang midang / bu ram dang / gser la sogs pa snying po thams cad dang / ga bur dang / tsan dan dang / kur gum dang / a ka ru dang / du ru 420
gtor ma'i rnam bshad gzhung don rab gsagka la sogs pa spos thams cad dang / ut+pal dang / pad+ma dang / man+da ra dang / tsam ba ka dang /a sho ka la sogs pa me rtog thams cad dang / mar dang / 'o ma dang / zho dang / ka ra dang / bu ram dang / sbrang rtsi dang / 'bras dang / nas la sogs pa 'bru rnams skya chan dang / khur ba dang /la du dang / hwags dang / thud sna tshogs pa dang / gzhan yang dri zhim zhing gtsang ba'i zas sna tshogs dang / zhes dang / rgyal ba'i sde'i gtor chog las kyang / rin po che'i snod mdzes pa'i nang du chu blugs la/ phye dang me tog la sogs pa ci 'byor pa dang / gser la sogs pa rin po che rnam lnga brdar ba dang / kha zas ma sbrags pa ma sme ba sna tshogs dang / zhes dang / de'i 'grel bar shākya bshes gnyen gyis/ gzhan yang gser la sogs pa rin po che lnga bdar ba dang / zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni 'di yang ci rigs pas te/ 'gror ba dam par gyur pa la zugags pa rnams te/ rang gis ji ltar 'byor pa bzhin kha zas ma sbags ma sme ba sna tshogs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyir/ gzhan yang gtor ma de bza' btung gi bdud mikho nar bskyed cing bsngo ba de yang mi 'thad par thal/ de ni sngags drug phyag rgya drug gi don sgyi cilang ma shar ba'i blun skyon dang / paṇa grub chen po rnams kyis gzhal yas khang sogs gnas khang gos longs spyod mkho dgu la sogs pa 'byung bar dmigs dgos par bshad pa'i phyir te/ sngags drug gi rgya chen shugs ldan gyi skabs kyi rgyal ba'i sde'i chu gtor cho ga las/ bzhi pa ni 'phags pa rnams kyi spyan lam du'ang gzhal yas khang brtsegs ma la 〈snags pa mchod pa'i sprin phung mang por sprul nas mchod pa dang / sems can rnams kyi dbang po'i spyod yul du ji ltar 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga char bzhin du 'byung bar bsam zhing / khyad par du yi dwags rnam pa mang po dang / sems can kun gyi bsam pa yongs su skong bar byin gyis brlabs so/ /zhes dang / de'i 'grel bar shākya bshes gnyen gyis/ nam mkha' mdzod la sogs pa ting nge 'dzin 421
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngagyi dbang gis de dang rjes su mthun pa'i mchod pa'i sprin gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su bkang nas dus gsum gyi 'phags pa thams cad mnyes shing / khams gsum pa'i 'gro ba lnga po'i dbang po lnga'i longs spyod mkho dgur ldan pa de yid du 'ong ba'i rdzas phun sum tshogs par snang bar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i don de thugs la bzhag nas jo bo lha cig gis kyang de ltar gsungs te/ jo bo'i chu gtor las/ mdun gyi snod kyi thad dar paṃ ljang gu re re bsam la/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po ste sna tshogs las grub pa'i snod re re bsam pa ni/ snod byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /bcud ni snod rin po che'i nang du bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin dang / sman sna tshogs las grub pa'i gron shang dang / rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gter gyi bum pa dang / dar la sogs pa gos sna tshogs bsam mo/ /zhes gsungs so/ /shin tu legs/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i ngos 'dzin la sna tshogs smra zhing / 'ga' zhig rin chen mang kha dog yid du 'ong ba dang / 'byams klas gangs can mtshor 'dod zer/sngon dang phyis kyi gtor ma'i rnam bshad byed mkhan la la na re/ jo bo yab sras kyi lugs la/rin chen mang shākya thub pa/ gzugs mdzes spyan ras gzigs/ sku 'byams klas 'jam dbyangs/ 'jigs bral phyag rdor du ngos 'dzin zer ba yang ma brtags pa'i blun gtam yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang ni mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag sum cu na 'jig rten gyi khams mthu bo che dang ldan pa'i sa na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba yin pa'i phyir lte/ me rtog gi tshogs bkod pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag su/ma cu na 'jig rten gyi khams mthu bo che dang ldan pa'i sa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par 〈ges pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen mang zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ ci'i phyir rin chen mang zhes bya zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na byang chub sems dpa' shin tu mang ste/422
gtor ma'i rnam bshad gzhung don rab gsal/nyan thos kyi theg pa can mang ba ma yin la/ nyin re zhing de'i bstan pa tshad med pa 'byung ste/de'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'di zhing gi gdul bya'i sgo nas btags pa'i mtshan yin/ mdo 'di dang kha 'bar ma'i mtshan brjod pa'i phan yon yang 'dra bar snang ste/ mdo 'dis de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang gi mtshan brjod na phar phyin bcu'i nang gi smon lam sgya phar phyin spyod pa rdzogs par 'gyur bar bshad pa'i phyir te/ me rtog bkod pa'i mdo las/ shā ri'i bu rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang bus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te thal mo sbyar nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes ched du brjod pa lan gsum brjod par byed na/ de dag ni de bas sngon gyi smon lam gyi spyod pa yongs su ldogs par 'gyur te/ de ni g.yog rin po che dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / gzungs las/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang gi mtshan nas brjod pa'i byin rlabs kyis yi dwags thams cad skye ba mang po'i ser sna byas pa mi dge ba'i las bcom zhing bsod nams yongs su ldogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/shin tu mthun/ gser 'od las kyang / sangs rgyas rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / de nyid las/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mthu chen thob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs dam pa yang spyan ras gzigs ma yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ spyar ras gzigs kyi mtshan brjod pa thams cad la byang chub sems dpa' mang ba'i phyir/ byas pa la kho na re/ nged kyi dam bca' 'thad par thal/ gser 'od las/ sangs rgyas spyan ras gzigs rgyal thabs brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs snyam na/ de yang 423
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngasangs rgyas gzhan zhig tu mngon te/ de nyid las/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'jigs byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa lta bu/ des na de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs dam pa ni/ gser 'od las/sangs rgyas gzugs dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dir mngon te/ gzungs las/ de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sduXdī snapa pa~X /shā /byi sna/sna dzā ñtsha k+ṣiṃ rdzu m+p+raṃ spragyu ༷ snasazhe ༵ ṭ+wā tshogasna lcu /spri gi sgo nas mtshan du mngon te/ me rtog bkod pa'i mdo las kyang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing stobs bcu na 'jig rten gyi khams gzugs snang ba dang ldan pa zhes bya ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par rgyal ba'i dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ ci'i phyir/ 'dzig rten gyi khams de gzugs snang ba dang ldan pa zhes bya zhe na/ 'jig rten gyi khams der gang su dag skyes pa dang skye ba dang skye bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad mi'i kha dog las 'das par gyur pa yin/ sems can de dag thams cad gzugs bzang zhing mdzes par gyur pa yin no/ /shā ri'i bu gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par rgyal ba'i mtshan nyan pa de dag bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi gzugs bzang por 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/ des mtshon nas gzhan gnyis kyang shes par bya dgos kyi rang bzo sogs kyi tsho ga la yid brtan ma byed cig /de la 'dir gtor ma'i rnam bzhag la/ gtor ma'i phan yon dang / ngo bo dang / sgra bshad dang / dbye ba dang / phye ba so so'i ngos 'dzin dang / cho ga'i khyad par dang / chu gtor bye brag tu bshad ba dang bdun las/dang po ni/ lha liṃ ā tsar+ya'i chos skyong thams cad kyi gtor chog las/ bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa dang / gtor mas bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / gtor mas 'phrin las 424
gtor ma'i rnam bshad gzhung don rab gsagrnam bzhi 'grub pa dang / gtor ma ni lha bsgom pa dang / rab gnas dang / sbyin sreg dang / las tshogs kun la sngon du 'gro ba dang / gtor mas sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dgongs shing /lha rnams kyis bsrungs shing skyobs pa dang / sbyin pa'i phar phyin yongs su ljags par 'gyur ba dang / gtor mas tshe ring zhing bsod nams tshad med pa bskyed cing 'phel ba dang / sbyin pa'i phar phyin myur du rdzogs par byed cing / gtor mas bsod nams dang che'i tshad kyang 'phel zhing skye bar byed pa dang / gtor mas sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mchod pa'i bsod nams thob pas/ tshe ring ba dang / bsod nams dang / mdangs dang / stobs skye zhing 'phel ba dang / dge ba'i rtsab yongs su rdzogs pa dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa dang / gnod sbyin dang /srin po dang / yi dwags ma rungs pa thams cad kyis gca zhing gnod pa byed mi nus pa dang /de dag sogs gzhan la gzi brjed tshad med pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba sogs mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ khyad par dang bo yin te/ dper na grub dbang lha liṃ ā tsar+ya lta bu yin pa'i phyir te/ rgyal sde'i gtor chog las/ phan yon che la sla ba chu gtor yin pas 'di la brtsone par bya'o/ /zhes dang / shākya'i 'grel ba las kyang / de la sla ba ni sla ba ste nyams su blangs pa la tshegs chung dus don thams cad yongs su rogs par 'gyur ro/ /nas/ yo byad cung zad tsam gyi rgyus 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i don mtha' dag ma lus par yongs su ljags par ༷༷shā pa/ paspri /shā /pa( |kau paX twā raṃ /(lha (( ñdza da/lha raṃ na pas /pa ༵ 〉〉 sdi pa/ ༵ med pa yongs su rjogs par 'gyur ba'i don gyis zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dis rgyu tshogs gnyis 'grub pa dang gnas skabs dang mthar zug gi don thams cad 'grub tshul rgyas bar bshad pas/ bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog par yang bshad do/ /khyad par gnyis pa yin te/425
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngan+da bhu ti'i kye rdor 'grel ba las/ 'dod pa'i don 'grub pa'i phyir dang / bar chad zhi ba'i phyir dang / dge ba'i phyir yang gtor ma gsungs pa/ zhes dang / 'dod don 'grub phyir bar chad ni/ /zhi ba'i phyir dang dge ba'i phyir/ /'chad par 'gyur ba'i cho ga yis/ /g.yel med pas ni gtor ma sgyin/ /zhes dang / skal bzang rdo rje'i lam rim las/ bdag dang gzhan gyi bar chad nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i phyir gtor ma'i cho ga dang / zhes gsungs so/ /khyad par gsum pa grub ste/ rgyud brtag gnyis las/ gal te 'dis 'byung po'i tshogs pyir rtag tu gtor ma sbyin na dbang dang / mngon spyod dang / dgra lde lajegs pa dang / bskrad pa dang / gsad pa dang /dgug pa dang / zhi ba dang / rgyas par yang 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / bzhi pa yang yin te/ rnam bshad mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las/ de las kyang lha bsgom pa dang / mchod pa dang / rab gnas dang / dkyil 'khor dang las tshogs kun la gtor ma rdzon du 'gro bas/ zhes so/ /lnga ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dgongs pa sogs yin te/ kha 'bar ma la skyabs mdzad pa'i gzungs las/ rtag tu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis bsngags shing dgongs par 'gyur ro/ /lha mang pos rtag tu bsrung zhing / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su ljags par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ drug pa gtor mas me+e ring ba dang bsod nams tshad med pa yongs su ljags par 'gyur te/ dper na grub chen lce sgom lta bu/ lce sgom pa lo brgyad cu rtsagrangs bzhugs pa gtor ma'i byin rlabs yin gsungs pa dang / yang lce sgom gyi zhal nas/ nga la dang po rgyags su zho gcig las med de/ da lta longs spyod che ba gtor ma'i don yin par 'dug gsungs/ chos pa sto gos kyis phongs pa mthong tsa na/ gtor ma ma thong ba yin/ zhes gsungs/ skabs shig tu bla ma'i rgyags chad nas pye phad sprugs pas rtsam pa n+d+ra bzhi byung ba gtor ma btang bas/ nyin phyed nas yon bdag 'gas nas mang bo dang chos ston bzang po 426
gtor ma'i rnam bshad gzhung don rab gsal/khyer nas byung bas/ bla mas nye gnas la zhing gi ston thog las mi maphyog gam gsungs pa tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba'i dpe gcig ste/ gzungs las kyang / rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig tshe ring bar 'dod dam bsod nams ches 'phel ba dang sgyin pa'i pha rol ñtsā ༈ r+nghi pa yo pa /shā ༵ sna dri /shā r+sha dwo rtag /de dwo dzo ③ ṭ+wāṃ lham 'a/hāX ga/ dzī/ lhag/ ñtsha smra/ byed gtor ma ni/ /de ni gzhan yang rab bshad bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bdun pa yang yin te/ gtor mas bsod nams sangs rgyas bye ba phrag 'bum gyi bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan pas rtag tu mi ma yin pa'i 'byung po rnams kyis mi mthong zhing / stobs dang brtson 'grus gzugs dang gzi bajid dran pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gzungs las/ de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba phrag 'bum gyi bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu mi ma yin pa rgyu ba 'byung po dang sha za la sogs pa dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / gdon dang yi dwags rnams kyis mi mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs dang brtson 'grus kyang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /gzugs dang ldan pa dang / gzi bajid dang ldan pa dang / dran ba dang ldan par yang 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / brtag gnyis las/ gal te 'dis gtor mas 'byung po thams cad la mchod par byed na rnal 'byor ba rnams legs par 'gyur ro/ /de rnams la bde ba dri ma med pa dang lha mo rnams dang / 'gro ba rab tu 'gror ba rnams dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / 'jam dpal grags pa'i snying po rgyan las/ 'byung po che dang dman pa yis/ /gtor ma'i las la brtson byas na/ /tshe dang bsod nams 'phel 'gyur bas/ /byang chub skya ni rgyu nyid phyir/ /'bad de de yi las bya'o/ /zhes dang / ye shes rdo rje'i lam rim las/ phyi rabs kyi gang zag chos la dad pa rnams kyis 'byung po'i gtor ma la brtson pas/ yi dwags la phan pa dang 427
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngabdag gi 'byor pa mi nyams pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa gtor ma'i ngo bo yod de/ ting nge 'dzin dang sngags dang phyag rgya dang tshigs bcad dang rdzas kyi nus pa'i sgo nas mgron gyi lha tshogs tshim par byed pa'i dngos grub kyi rten gzhi'i rdzas de gtor ma'i ngo bo yin lte/ phyag rdor sgya las rim las/ las rigs thams cad gang byed kyang / /gtor ma las kyi grogs su 'gyur/ /des na gtor ma sngon la bshad/ /gtor ma las dang kun la yang / /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya dang / /tshigs bcad rdzas kyi nus pa'i mthu/ /de lnga tshogs las ma lus 'grub/ /ces gsungs/ de lnga'i dang po'am rab ni ting 'dzin dang / de rjes sngags gtso/ de rjes phyag rgya yin/ de rjes tshigs bcad dang / de thams cad kyi gzhi'am rten ni rdzas la byed dgos te/ ting 'dzin rgyal po bzhin du kun la dbang par byed/ sngags ni bram ze nus ldan lta bur nus pa 'byin pa sogs yin pa'i phyir/ phyag na rdo rje'i las rim las/ de yang ting 'dzin rgyal po'i tshul/ /bram ze sngags kyi nus pa mthun/ /rje'u rigs phyag rgya nyid dang mthun/ /tshigs bcad tha mal spyod pa 'dri/ /rdzas ni kun gyi gzhi rten 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ba la k+taspya druṃ sgro/ zlo/ rnyi gh+nā /pa sdi ༈ ༵ gh+nā ṭ+wāṃ rnyi ༷༷ nā dī ār+sha/ /snyeX /ma/ shu (lha pa two ༵ ༵/ 'os i byin pas/ ba li/ gnyis pa'i am byin/ asgyu sogs las a dbyi bar byas pas/ ba liṃ/ dngos po la tā tā dag gso/ da phan sgya rkyen tā byin pas/ ba liṃ tā grub nye gtor ma zhes pa'o/ /sgra bshad ni/ rdzas mang po 'dzin chags med par gtong bas na gtor ma zhes bya/ nges tshig gis bshad na/ rdzas mang po la'ang 'dzin chags med par gtong pas na gtor ma zhes bya ste/ slob dpon mi bskyod pa'i 'grel ba las/ rdzas mang po bstab pa la mi 'dzin pas gtor 428
gtor ma'i rnam bshad gzhung don rab gsal/ma nye/ mi 'dzin gtor bas gtor ma'o/ /zhes dang / skal bzang rdo rje'i lam rim las ma chags par gtor bas na gtor ma'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gtor ma la thabs shes gnyis ka tshang ste/ gtor ma ni/ zang zing dang mi 'jigs pa dang chos dang byams pa'i sbyin pa bzhi tshang bar phar phyin drug ldan du spyod pas na thabs shes gnyis ka tshang ba'i phyir te/ jo bo'i bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i ṭīk+ka las/ gtor ma zhes bya ba ni thabs dang shes rab tu ldan pa thabs cad la khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /gtor ma'i byed las ni/ mdo las/ rgyal po sbyin bdag nyid dang ni/ /gang yang sems can tshogs gzhan rnams/ /tshe ring nad med phun sum tshogs/ /rtag tu bde dang ldan gyur cig /spyin pas 'byung po dbang du 'gyur/ /sbyin pas dgra rnams med par 'gyur/ /pha rol nyid yang sbyin pa nyid/ /de phyir sbyin pa gtso bor brjod/ /sgyin pa 'jig rten rgyan yin te/ /sbyin pas ro 'phro bzlog par byed/ /sgyin pa mtho ris them skas yin/ /sbyin pa zhi byed dge ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i longs spyod rnams/ /mi zad nam mkha' lta bu gang / /longs spyod de ni thob bya'i phyir/ /sbyin ba de ni yang dag srel/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dis gtor ma'i byed las legs par ston pas go bar bya/bzhi pa gtor ma'i dbye ba ni/ gtor ma la pyi'i gtor ma dang / nang gi gtor ma dang /gsang pa'i gtor ma dang /bla na med pa'i gtor ma dang bzhir yod de/phyag rdor gos sngon can gyi gtor chog las/ gsang ba bla med mchog tu 'dod/ /phyi nang thun mong shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa dbye ba so so'i ngos 'dzin las/ phyi'i gtor ma ni pyi'i rtsab lnga/ 'bru lnga/ sman lnga/chan thug khur ba sogs ci rigs las grub pa'i gtor ma yin lte/ gos sngon gtor chog las/rtsab lnga dang yan lag lnga/ /'bru dang shing rtog sman rnams dang / /chan zug khur ba la sogs pa/ /zhes pa nas/ de dag thams cad phyi'i yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'di la las 429
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngathams cad yod de/ ngag dbang grags pa'i gtor bshad las/ dkyil gabor dang ni sbyin sreg dang //gzhan yang lha rnams mnyam par bskang //nas/rtag tu gtor ma'i las rnams bya/ /zhes so/ /nang gi snying ma'i lha la 'bul rgyu'i zas sam rdzas de nang gi gtor ma yin lte/ gos sngon gyi gtor chog las/nang gi snying ga'i lha rnams la//gtor ma zas rnams yin pas na//bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas ni/ /lha la ting nge 'dzin gyis dbul/ /zhes so/ /'di la las bzhi yod par bshad/gsang ba'i gtor ma ni lte ba'i nges don gyi mkha' 'gro ma dang snying spu'i nges don gyi dpa' bo tshim byed kyi byang sems dkar dmar gnyis gsang ba'i gtor ma yin te/ gos sngon gtor tshog las/ gsang ba'i gtor ma'i sbyor ka ni/ /lte ba pad+ma gtor ma'i snod/ /de snying zla ba'i steng du ni/ /byang chub sems ni kun+da la/ /bdud rtsil sogs yon tan sogs/ /gtor ma rjes su bstan pa yin/ /zhes 〈sna/ /bzhi pa bla na med pa'i gtor ma yang yod de/ lhan skyes kyi bde stong dbyer med du sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin de de yin pa'i phyir/ gtor tshog las/ gsang ba'i gtor ma sbyor ka ni/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'am/ /thams cad rogs pa'i man ngag tshang / /bla med man ngag sbyor ka yi/ /gtor ma'i man ngag sbyor ka rnams/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/drug pa cho ga'i khyad par la rten gyi gang zag gi khyad par dang / mkhas pa so so'i chu gtor gyi cho ga 'god pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sngags kyi gang zag la lnga yod de/ bsgom bas ༷/ spri shaṃ snye | s+t+ri ñtsha/ |khro ༷/ ༷ ṭ+wāṃ /༷༷ ༷ ṇ+ṭhī ༷ ṭ+wāṃ shā ༷ ༷༷༷ 430
gtor ma'i rnam bshad gzhung don rab gsaglas byung dngos grub kyi/ /mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/grub chen gyis/ ting 'dzin grub par ma gyur bas/ /tshogs 'khor tshogs mchod dngos grub bo/ /zhes 〈sna/ gsum pa ni/ grub chen gyis/ de ma grub na sbyin sreg gis/ /dngos grub thob par gsungs pa yin/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ grub chen gyis/ de ma byung na bzlas brjod do/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa ni/ grub chen gyas/ de ni ma byung gtor ma byas/ /zhes gsungs ba'i gnad 'di /( /shā rnashā lha dṛ tshos sta hā/ ṭā dhipa sbyishā rnyipar 〉pa shir+sha// shā ṣ+ṭṛ (dī gi ༷pa pa(pa phyag na rdo rje la/ /rna bar brgyud pa'i gdams ngag des/ /zhes so/ /brgyud tshul/ rdo rje 'chang gis phyag rdor la/ des ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la/ des ni ro langs ma la/ des gnod sgyin phyag na rdo rje la/ des slob dpon phyag na rdo rje la brgyud pa sogs shes te/ grub chen gyis/ston pa phyag na rdo rje yis/ /sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la/ /rna bar brgyud pa'i gdams ngag des/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la bstan/ /des ni ro langs ma la bstan/ /gnod sbyin phyag na rdo rje dang / /slob dpon phyag na rdo rje yi/ /brgyud pa'i gdams ngag rim pa rnams/ /nan tan gyis ni btsal bar bya/ /zhes so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang phyag na rdo rje ni dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsang sngags rig sngags kyi bdag por dbang bskur/ lag tu rdo rje gtad/rin po che'i dbu rgyan bskon te mnga' gsol mdzad nas gsang sngags kyi 'khor lo mtha' dag snoshā lha gh+nā smaṃ dī pa tshoX dzño shā hāX/ ba/( sprispri sbyispri kyi snapahā /spyipa rgyapa pyo (dzoji ( rdzu( stobs can/ /dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /rig sngags gsang sngags bdag po ru/ /dbang bskur mnga' gsol mdzad nas ni/ /gsang sngags lusar lo mtha'adag ni/ /khyod 431
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngami( pa/sna r+yaṃ n+dha ngakyis bhe+e snror+sha/ra/traṃ snye shā/ two /mas snapa ba~X pahā (rdzu /da/shā raX/ 〉pa na las rnams 'grub pa dang / /de la gus pa mnga' gyur bas/ /de yi dus su bstan par bya/ /rgyal ba nyid kyis de skad gsungs/ /zhes so/ /des na gsang sngags nyams su len pa'i dam tshig ma nyams na thams cad kyi rtsemor sangs rgya/ nyams na rdo rje dmyal bar skye ba'i phyir te/ bi bhu tis/ ma bsgoms gyur kyang lhung med na/ /skye ba bcu drug dag na 'grub/ /ces dang /grub chen kyis/ gsang sngags la la bzhed kyi ni/ /dper na sprul gyi bshu nur zhugs/ /rtse bar 'phro ba co rtor 'gro/ /de bzhin rnam pa sngags la yang / /rig 'dzin sa dang rdo rje dmyal/ /zhes so/ /sngags kyi dngos grub thob tshul bdun yod de/ me+e 'dir sangs ma rgyas kyang la la bar do na 'grub/ la la skye ba phyi ma la/ la la skye ba gnyis pa la/ la la gsum pa la/ la la bzhi pa la/ la la lnga pa la/ la la skye ba bdun pa la dam tshig dang ldan na phyag rgya chen po malngastog gi dngos grub thob pa'i phyir/ grub chen gyis/ la la rang gi gzhung gis ni/ /bar ma do nas 'gro ba'o/ /la la skye ba sgyi ma la/ /la la dag gis bzhed kyis ni/ /gnyis dang gsum pa dag la dang / /bzhi'am lnga ba dag la'ang yod/ /la la skye ba bdun pa la/ /phyag rgya dngos grub thob par 'dod/ /ces so/ /rig ladzin gyi sar song ba'ang yod de/ grub chen gyis/ dur khod rin chen sa dang ni/ /bar snang lha gnas la brten pa/ /mkha' sbyod 'og min stug po yi/ /gnas ni de gsum yin par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rten gyi gang zag ni dge slong dge tshul pha ma dge bsnyen pha ma sogs sdom ldan rab yin/ de min kyang dkon mchog la dang pa'i dad pa dang mngon par 'dod pa'i dad pa dang / las 'bras la yid ches pa'i dad pa dang / gtsang sbra dang ldan pa'i bsam pa bsod nams dang thar pa 'dod pa gang rung dgos te/ dang po ni/ gzungs 432
gtor ma'i rnam bshad gzhung don rab gsaglas/ dga' bo gal te dge slong pha dang dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen pha dang / dge bsnyen ma gang zhig rtag tu gzungs 'dis kha zas la bsngags te yi dwags la sbyin pa byin na bsod nams tshad med pa snyed yongs su ljags par 'gyur zhing / zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ dza ya sa na'i chu gtor las/ dad pa can gang zhig gis las su bya ba la phan yon che la sla ba chu gtor yin pas 'di la brtson bar bya'o/ /zhes dang / 'jam dpal chu gtor rtsab las/ 'gro ba ma lus don du ni/ /gtor ma chen po'i rim pa 'di/ /zhes dang /kār+sha spra sbri yang shāg bahā /sna r+yaṃ dzño ma/ tsha/gh+nā snye/ snang snaX k+ham̐ donab sdir+sha (da ga/zha/hūm̐ rnyi dzā dī ༵ can gyi don byar 'dod pas bla ma dam pa bsten par bya zhing rgyud kyi don gsal bar bya ba yin pas dang por mkhas la bslab par bya/ /zhes dang / bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i ṭīk+kar jo bo'i zhal nas/ de la mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma nar ma byed 'dod pas zhes bya ba ni rnal 'byor ba khyad par can bstan te/ zhes dang / shākya mi tra'i 'grel ba las/ de'i 'og tu rnal 'byor ba brjod pas de bshad par bya ste/ de'i phyir/ dad pa can gang zhig gis las su bya ba la zhes bya ba smos te/ de yang rnal 'gyor ba ni 'dod pas 'bras bu yon tan dang bcas pa ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de la 'di zhes bya bas lam dang de'i 'bras bu 'byung tshul dang bden bzhi'i 'dor len dang / dkon mchog la yid ches kyi dad pa thams cad bstan te/ shākya mi tra'i 'grel ba las/'di'i sgra 'jug pa'i rgyu mtshan ni bstan bcos las lam dang las dang 'bras bu dang / bden pa dang dkon mtshog la yid ches pa dngos dang zhes gsungs so/ /dang ba skye tshul yang sngar bshad pa ltar yin te/ shākya'i 'grel ba las/ de yang las dang 'bras bu dang bden pa gnyis la yang yid ches pa'i dad pa skye la/ bden pa dkon mtshog la ni 'dod pa dang sems dang ba'i 433
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngadad pa skyes te/ zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa paṇa grub rnams kyi lugs la/ snod la rung ba dang mi rung ba spangs pa gnyis las/ gser sogs rin po che'i snod bzo dbyibs legs pa phra rgyan gyis sbras pa sogs sam/ gas chag bug rdol med pa'i snod gser dang / dngul dang / zangs dang / ra gan dang /gabar ba dang / dung dang / shing dang ṭarnams kyi snod brgyad po gang rung bzo legs pa la yang rung nye/ ye shes rdo rje'i gtor chog dpag bsam sdong po las/ gtor ma'i las byed par 'dod pas/ rin bo che'i snod rgya che la gting zab pa dag cing dri ma med pa chag pa dang gas pa zhom pa la sogs pa med pa/ zhes gsungs pa dang / gtor chog klag pa'i don grub mchan las gser dngul zangs ra gan nakhar ba dung shing rdzarnams kyi snod/ ces dang / tshabar mthun pa'i bhaṇ+ḍa brgyad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar legs lte/ slob dpon mi bskyod pa'i 'grel ba las/nad rin po che las byas pa bzo legs pa'i zhes dang / rdzo bo lha cig gi bdud ji 'byung ba'i 'grel ba las/ de nas yang de'i rgyu mtshan nye bar bstan pa'i phyir/ chu gtor gyi snod che chung ci 'gror pa'i nang sma zhes dang / snod che chung zhes bya ba ni yangs pa'am/ chung ba de las zlog pa lte/ rin po che'i snod do/ /ci 'phyor pa zhes bya ba ni nges par bzung pa yod pa ma yin te/ tshad ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir rin po che'i snod la gsum yod de/ rin po che las grub pa'am/ dbyibs sogs rin po che lta bur byas pa'am/ rin po che za rgyan byas pa'i snod gsum gsungs pa'i phyir/ rgyal lde'i gtor chog las/ de la rin po che'i snod mdzes pa'i nang du zhes dang / de'i 'grel ba shākya mi tras mdzad pa las/ de'i 'og tu de nyid nyams su blangs pa'i thabs bstan nas de bshad par bya ste/ de'i phyir de la rin po che'i snod mtshes par zhes bya ba smos te/ zhes pa nas/ rin po che'i snod ni rin po che'i snod 434
gtor ma'i rnam bshad gzhung don rab gsal/de/ rin po che las byas pa'am/ rin po che lta bur byas pa'am/ rin po ches sbras pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rin po che las byas pa sogs bzhi'i don yod de/ rgyu gser sogs rin po che las grub pa ni rin po che las byas pa'i don dang / rin po che'i dbyibs su byas pa ni rin po che 'dra bar byas pa'i don dang / rin po ches brgyan pa ni rin po ches spras pa'i don dang / de dag gang yin pa yid du 'ong bar byas pa ni rin po che'i snod mtshes pa zhes pa'i mtshes pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ khyad par dang po yin te/ shākya'i 'grel ba las/ de la rin po che las byas pa ni rin po che'i rgyu las byas pa'i gser la sogs pa b.ro'i khyad par du mas mdzes par byas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyad par gnyis pa yang yin te/ 'grel ba de nyid las/ rin po che lta bur byas pa ni rin po che'i dpyibs su byas pa ste rin po che 'dra ba zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyad par gsum pa yang yin te/ 'grel ba de las/ rin po ches spros pa ni rin po ches brgyan pa ste mdzes par byas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyad par bzhi pa mdzes pa'i don yang de ltar yin te/ 'grel ba de las/ mdzes pa ni yid du 'ong ba'i khyad par dang ldan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ chu gtor 'dis 'byor ba rab 'bring tha gsum la ci rigs dang ci 'os su bstan te/ rtsabar/ phan yon che la sla bas/ zhes dang / 'grel ba de las/ tshul 'dis 'phyor ba rab 'bring tha gsum pa ci rigs su bstan pa yin te/ sngar sla ba zhes bshad pas de dang 'gal ba'i nyes pas mi brdzibar bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa mi rung ba dor ba ni/ klag pa'i don grub mchan las/ chag grum can/ shin tu chung ba/ bse lcags phor ba bzhi mi rung bar bshad de/ de nyid las/ de yang 'tshe ba'i snod bzhi po pyi dor zhes dang / sprul sku ngag dbang dge legs rgyal mtshan gyi gsung las/ snod 435
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngami rung ba ni/ rus pa dang / lcags las byas pa dang / dug gzer can/ kha chag zhabs rdol can/ chung ba/ ma dag pa rnams mi rung ste/ rus pa dang pags pa las byas pa ni yi dwags skrag cing / gtsang sbra can mi 'khor/ lcags ni mtshon cha'i rgyu yin pas go mtshon sogs su mthong nas skrag par 'gyur/ kha chag zhabs rdol ni mi shis pa'i snod yin pas 'ga' zhig gis byin rlabs mi chags zhes smra zhes gsungs pa ni/ paṇa chen gyi gsung grub chen snying stobs rgya mtsho las thos pa'i gsung dag red la/ 'jim lo'i gsung las/ ka pā liṃ la yi dwags phra mo 'jigs pa dang / ting ni lha ma yin gyis thod par mthong ba'o/ /lcags ni drag po'i rdzas mtshon ga'i rgyu yin pas yi dwags thams cad 'jigs pa'o/ /'phags pa'i de nyid las/ ting la lha ma yin 'jigs gsungs snang la/ lce sgom sogs kyang de ltar 'dod pa mthong / rgyud dang rgya gzhung nas gsal kha de 'dra ma rnyed kyang zhi drag las sbyor gyis dpags na ci rigs su 'grub cing / 'gro ba'i mthong tshul yang phal cher 'dod khams na rang gis par nges shing rigs mthun pa'i bag chags sad tshul gcig na snang ba yin te/ rnam 'grel las/rigs mthun bag chags sad pa can/ /zhes dang / kun btus las kyang / gang du 'byung zhing skye bar gyur pa de'i sa ba nyid kyi mig gis de'i sa ba'i gzugs rnams mthong ngam zhe na zhes dris lan du/ kun btus las/ de'i sa ba'i mig gis/ de'i sa pa'i gzugs rnams mthong ba'ang yod/ gzhan gyi sa ba'i mig gis mthong ba'ang yod de/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de'i mtshan gzhir yang 'dod pa'i mig gis 'dod pa'i gzugs kyi skye mched mthong ba tsam las ma gsungs pa'i phyir/ mdzod las/ mig gis gong ma'i gzugs ma yin/ /zhes dang / kun btus las/ 'dod pa'i khams su skyes par gyur pa 'dod pa na spyod pa'i mig gis 'dod pa na spyod pa'i gzugs rnams mthong ba dang gzugs na spyod pa'i gong ma bas/ sa 'og ma rnams 436
gtor ma'i rnam bshad gzhung don rab gsagmthong ngo / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kun btus kyi 'grel ba las/ rnam pa bzhis dmigs pa yongs su ma grub par rigs par byas te/ rnam par shes pa mi mthun pa'i rgyu dang / dmigs pa med pa'i rnam par shes pa dmigs pa dang / sgrim pa med par yang phyin ci log med par 'gyur ba dang / shes pa gsum gyi rjes su mthun par 'gyur bas zhes gsungs pa'i shes pa bzhi bo legs par shes nas don de dag go bar byed dgos pa'i phyir/ dmigs bya gcig la 'gro ba rigs so so'i rnam shes mi mthun pa du ma 'byung ba ni shes pa bzhi'i nang gi rnam shes mi mthun pa'i don yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam shes mi mthun pa bzhi'i dper brjod pa ston par/kun btus 'grel ba las/ de la rnam pa bzhi'i dper brjod pa ni/ yi dwags dud 'gro mi rnams dang / /zhes pa nas/ de med pas na rnam rig med/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ de bzhi'i dang bo ni/ dngos po gcig la 'gro ba rigs so so'i rnam shes mi mthun pa du ma 'byung ba de sbyo/ teku/ shā r+yaṃ du ༵༷ ༵༵༵ dzi~X /shā // snatshopa rmodzor+sha spra rnyis sbre /lha ༵ // pashā mi rnams dang / /lha rnams ji ltar rigs rigs su/ /dngos gcig yid ni tha dad phyir/ /zhes /lha (sdidī ṭ+wāṃ r+yaṃ dra ༵ pa ༵/ /lhaX rnyi the raṃ pasna hūm̐ ༵ kā kau /spra dh+ri /nā rnyishān ༵ k+ham̐ n+d+ra gis yi dwags kyis rnag la sogs pas gang bar mthong pa dang / de nyid la dud 'gro la sogs pas gnas kyi blos gnas par byed pa dang / mi rnams kyis mngar ba dang dwangs pa dang bsil ba'i chur rtogs shing khras byed do/ /der 'jug go/nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la sogs par zhugs pa'i lha rnams kyis ni nam mkhar mthong ste/ gzugs kyi 'du shes rnam par bshig pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/437
kunamakhyenagasunga'abum nga wa wawagnyis pa dmigs pa med pa'i rnam par shes pa yod de/ sngon nas 'das shing zhig pa'i dngos po dran pa dang / rmi lam gyi shes pa dang gzugs brtan snang ba'i dbang shes rnams kyis ṭ+wāṃ snan ñtsā ༵ de snang dze+e /pa/sna /dī ṭ+wāṃ r+sha rnyiX k+to ya/ tram̐ ga ༷sdi rnyi pa lhami/ r+shadīpa ༷/ pa spya pyir/ /zhes dang / kun btus 'grel ba las kyang / dmigs pa med pa'i rnam par shes pa med pa dmigs pa dang / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gsum pa sgrims mi dgos par grol bar 'gyur ba ni/ rigs drug gis ma bsgoms kyang grol ba thob zin par thal/ de dag la snang ba rnams ji ltar snang ba ltar grub pa'i phyir/pa/shā dzño m+p+raṃ gh+nā te/mi/ ltaras r+shadī shārnyi skyi pa'i shāX teso//pa (spra saskyo pa/tuX na' panywa hāshā ñtsha kyang / sgrims pa med par yang phyin ci log med par 'gyur ba dang / zhes so/ /bzhi pa shes pa gsum yod de/ ji ltar mos pa ltar ston thub pa'i dbang gi shes pa dang /'das sogs chos kun gyi gnas lugs daphyod pa'i lhag mthong gi shes pa dang / mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang gsum skyesad pa'i phyir/ kun btus 'grel ba las/ shes pa rnam pa gsum ni/dbang gi shes pa dang / lhag mthong gi shes pa dang / rnam par mi rtog pa'i shes pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ skabs 'di'i gtor ma sogs kyang dbang gi shes pa dngos dang rjes mthun pa ci rigs kyis byed dgos te/ byang sems rnal 'byor ba stoms 'jug thob pas mos pa'i dbang gis sa dang / dpag bsam ljon shing bdud rtsi sogs snang ba'i phyir/ 'dir yang de hādī sdur+sha paji dritho m+p+raṃ ji ༵ na (1 ༵༵ paX tā r+nghi/ra zesnang chen rdzu/ pa dh+ri pyaX/ giXng shā ༵ 438
gtor ma'i rnam bshad gzhung don rab gsal/sogs/ /dngos po de ltar dmigs par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / bdud ji 'byung ba'i ṭīk+ka las kyang / snang zhing 'byung bar bsam zhes pa ni/ de dag gi dbang po'i spyod yul du de ltar bsgom pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar mdzad tshul mang yang / 'dir snod skyon bral brgyad po gang rung bya ste/ 'gro bzang snying po'i chu gtor gyi cho ga las/ chu gtor byed par 'dod pas/dang po gtor ma'i snod ci 'byor pa'i nang du zhes dang / chu gtor rnam bshad spya shākya mi tras sngar sla ba zhes bshad pa'i/ zhes pa nas/ kha na ma tho ba med pa'i snod de'i nang du zhes gsungs skyi hūm̐ dā/pa/ dā rto ༷ pa ③༵ ༵ ༷/ ṭ+wāṃ ༈ rdo phyoX ṣā // tram̐ spyaX ༷ ༷༷ | ṭ+wāṃ/ che la sogs pa'i snod de dngos su na byang chub kyi sems so/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid las kyang / 'di skad ston te/ snod ni ltan yin pa'i pyir/ byang chub kyi sems de thabs yin la zhes dang / chu gtor 'jam dpal rtsab las/ rin chen snod mjes chu gtsang dang / /zhes dang / de'i 'grel bar mi bskyod pas/ snod rin po che las byas pa bzo legs pa'i nang du zhes sogs sngar rgyas par bshad zin te/ rgyu che chung gis phan yon che chung mdo sngags phal cher na shin tu mang ngo / /snod kyi rdzas cung zad bshad zin to/ /gtor ma ni/ snod de dag chu gtsang ma srog chags med pas khengs par 'gengs shing / ya yo med pa dang gtor ma'i rdzas kyang shin tu gtsang ba dang nyams pas ma 'bags pa dgos te/ mthon de dag phal cher gtsang sbra la dga' ba dang / phal cher dmigs pas tshim pa dang / la la bshams pas tshim pa dang / 'ga' zhig bsngos pas tshim pa dang / kha cig reg pas tshim pa dang / gzhan dag rdzas kyi tshim pa dang /gzhan dag bshal bas tshim pa sogs yod pa'i phyir/ 'gro bzang snying po'i gtor chog las/439
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngagtor ma'i snod kyi nang du chu gtsang ma srog chags med pas khegs par 'gengs/ de'i nang du phye dang / rin po che lnga dang / sman dang / me tog la sogs pa ci 'byor btab la zhes dang /rgyal pa'i sde'i chu gtor las kyang / rin po che'i snod mjes pa'i nang du chu blugs la/ phye dang /me rtog la sogs pa ci 'byor ba dang / gser la sogs pa'i rin po che lnga brdar ba dang / kha zas ma smas pa dang / ma sbags pa sna tshogs dang / sman dang 'bru dang dri la sogs pa sbyar na lhag par bzang zhes gsungs pa sogs mang la/ phal cher sngar bshad zin to/ /rgyal ba'i sdes/ sman dang 'bru dang dri la sogs pa lhag par bzang gsungs pa ltar 'byor na 'di dag sbyar na dgos pa shin tu chen po phul du phyin pa khyad 'phags yod de/ sman lngas nad sogs mi 'byung zhing nad med pa'i bde ba skye/ dri lngas tshul khrims rnam dag thob cing ngan 'gror mi ltang /rin po che lngas dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhing mtshon 'khugs sogs zhi bar byed/ 'bru sna lngas yul der longs spyod 'phel zhing mu ge sogs zhi bar byed/ snying po lngas 'khor 'das kun gyi bcud 'phel zhing dgos 'dod re ba ltar 'grub par byed pas/ nyer lnga po thams cad dam lnga tshan lnga sga'i re re byung na'ang phan yon che ba rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir te/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung las/ sman lngas gnas der nad nyung / 'bru lnga rin po che gser dngul pu tig mu min byu ru lngas zas dang longs spyod 'phel zhing zhes dang / kri ya dbung bzang gi rgyud las kyang / nad kyi bskal ba bsal ba'i phyir/ /sman sna lnga ni bum par blugs/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag bya'i phyir/ /dri sna lnga yang bum par blugs/ /dgos 'dod re ba bskang ba dang / /tshon gyi bskal ba bsal pa'i pyir/ /rin chen lnga yang bum par blugs/ /kun tram̐ ṇā posna ñtsha sna ༵ ༵ so/ /tā/ ji /sno duX dwo swā ༵ ༵ ṭ+wāṃ snro rgya/ sa/ kau ༵ nāṃ pang shāshā shāshā 440
gtor ma'i rnam bshad gzhung don rab gsagpa'i dngos po byin gyis brlabs pa yin pas bum gter dang dbang bum dag la 'jug pa ltar gtor ma la'ang shin tu legs par sngar bshad pa ltar yin te/ gser dngul mu tig byu ru mu min te rin po che lnga lha mo nor rgyun mas phul bas bkra shis pa'i dngos por mdzad/ bya kri stag gis phul ba'i stag tsher ba'am ming gzhan daṇ+ḍa ka ri dang / seng kri seng gis phul ba'i seng tsher ba nye ming gzhan sle tres dang / nags kyi lha mos phul ba'i a ba ra tsi ta'am gzhan gyis mi shub pa ste shu dag dkar po dang / chu srin gyis phul ba'i chu srin sder mor grags pa ste/ ha sa de ba zhes pa lha dang bcas pa dang / brgya byin gyis phul ba'i in+d+ra ha ri'am dbang bo lag pa ste sman lnga yin la/ grangs 'dren tshul tha dad yod cing de dag phul dus bkra shis pa'i dngos por byin gyis brlabs pa yin te/ klu byang gi dkyil chog nyi shu pa las/ byu ru dngul dang gser dang ni/ /pad+ma rā ga mu tig ste/ /rin chen shis pa lnga po rnams/ /nas dang sgo dang mon sran tri'u/ /til dang de bzhin mon sran tri'u/ /'bru ni shis pa lnga po rnams/ /chen po tsher ma'i dgra dang ni/ /lhar bcas gzhan gyis mi thub dang / /daṇ+ḍa ut+pal rtsab ste/ /sman lnga po ni gzhug par bya/ /zhes dang / zung 'jug gsal ba las kyang / byu ru dang ni dngul dang gser/ /pad+ma rā ga nya phyis skyes/ /bsngags pa'i rin chen rnam pa lnga/ /nas gro ma sha'i sran ma dang / /de bzhin til dang mud ga rnams/ /so ba lnga por bsngags pa ste/ /bri ha sti dang tsher mar byed/ /gzhan gyis mi thub lhar bcas pa/ /ut+pal sdong bu rtsab yi/ /sman lnga rab tu gzhug par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ste bsngags pa dang bkra shis par gsungs/ de bzhin du dri lnga yang / sprin gyi rgyal mo 'od 'chang lha mos ga bur phul/ rgya gar skyong byed lha mos tsan dan phul/ kha che'i dri bzang btsun mos gur gum phul/ gser rtog lha mos a ka ru phul/ srin mos dza ti phul te bkra shis pa'i dngos por mdzad de dri lnga'i lo rgyus so/ /441
