gzhin rje gshed dmar po'i de kho na nyid la mchan 'god/dang lte ba sring zas 'phen 'dud dang gtso po dbang po gnyis sprod/ mgrin pa spyi bo ru/ /mdud bzhi gnas pa ga na rje ste/ / mthar byed bzhi rtsa'akhor de bzhir dbus dang rtsa'adab la yi ge dang thig le lha sgom pas bdud bzhi mthar byed dga' bzhi dang thob gzhin rje gshed sogs/ni gshed yin no/ /gsang ba'i/ ya bya lte bar ma snying gar ya mgrin bar me sbyi bor ṭhi/ sogs pa'i yi ge ni/ /ma dag las kyi gshin rje ni/ /mi bzad srid pa'i las kyis gzir/ /dag pas dpal ldan dus kyi dgra/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol zhing / /dngos grub bde chen mchog gter yin/ /ya ma gnyis su 'dzin pa ste/ /spros med 'od gsal an tar brjod/ /ka yig bla mas bstan pa nyid/ /gshin rje mthar byed ces byar grags/ /'tsho ba zhes byar phrog tu brjod/ /'tsho ba'i dbye ba zhes bya ba/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i srog /'od gsal rnam par mi rtog pa/ /srog gi gsang 'di gang gis shes/ /thams cad 'grub cing rang dbang 'gyur/ /gzhan yang srid dang zhi ba las/ /srog gi de bzhin gnyis sbya dh+ri /shās/ / /lha ༵ (( ni spragasprad rnyi /nārnyi/ gu/dī pa /shā tharmi ༵ dzo pa'i ba k+ṣiṃ dī/ku/m+p+raṃ bya/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /mi 'gyur ba ni srog gi mchog /de las gzhan pa'i bskyed pa yi/ /yig 'bru rnams dang phyag mtshan dang / /phyag rgya snying po la zugags pa/ /rgyal ba sras bcas srog yin te/ /dad pas zugs dam bskul bar bya/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /rnal 'byor lam pa rnams kyi srog /dngos grub chen po 'dod rnams kyi/ /srog ni dam tshig sdom pa hūm̐ 〉/ga/ k+ṣiṃ ñtsā ba //rdzu dzoñdzadī ༈ lcu /ku/hūm̐ gh+nā ñdza1 lha da~X n+dha /sna dīhā lha/ rna/tshin+dha dzño sbyishā rlabs srog ni mi phyed pa'i/ /gus pas brtan po med na min/ /de las gzhan pa 'jig rten pa'i/ /'byung bo phal cher srog gi gnad/ /phrog dang 'tsho ba dang ni me+e/ /'di rnams dbye bas 461
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngashes par bya/ /rtsaba'i srog ni sngon bzhin no/ /sa steng 'byung bo kha cig gi /dbugs rlung srog tu nges pa yin/ /'byung bo rnams kyi rang rang gi /bod pa'i sngags dang sa bon dang / /ma ṇi rnams ni srog yin no/ /sde tshan bzhi ba'i dang po la/ /mes brgyan dbyangs kyi gsum pas brgyan/ /'byung bo rnams kyi srog la gnas/ /de las gzhan pa 'byung bo'i srog /kha cig gnas la gnas pa 〈snad/ /zhugs sha la zugags gnas pa ni/ /kha cig rdzas la brten te gnas/ /kha cig rang gi grib mar gnas/ /kha cig phyi yi 'byung bar gnas/ /nor bu ri rab gos la sogs/ /kha cig sman dang kha cig dug /kha cig 'gro ba gzhan gyi gzugs/ /sa steng 'byung po rnams kyi srog /bdag gi rtsal gnas pa yin/ /de la sogs pa du ma yis/ /srog gi dbye ba sna tshogs pa/ /'di ru brjod par mi nus so/ /mi rnams kyi ni srog gyur pa/ /ming dang ming yig dang po dang / /rnam par shes pa tshe gzugs yin/ /gza'adang rgyu skar la sogs pa/ /mdor na brtan g.yo la sogs pa'i/ /srog ni phyi dang nang dang gnas/ /rnam rtog ma rig chen pos te/ /gangor bar gnas pa rnams kyi srog /stong nyid snying rje mi 'gyur bde/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i srog /srid pa dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /rtsayi bdag nyid lus la gnas/ /sa'i rlung lte ba me rlung mgrin chu rlung snying rlung spyi bo la/ /lte ba sa'i rlung mgrin me ga snying chu rlung sgyi bo ga la/ /rlung me chu sa zhes bya ba'i ga mas/lte bar sa ga gis phrag dog snying gar chu ga gi zhe snang mgrin bar mes chags dang sbyi bor rlung gis slongs/ /sgyi bor ༷lus mgrin bar ngag lte bar yid gsum snying gar de gsum mi phyed gnas/ /bdud bzhi po ni rnam par gnas/ tshul sgyi bor /dri hāgo/ pan//ji /dri mo /sna/ ṭ+wāṃ smra ṭ+wāṃ r+sha bad/ shā shā shā pad+mo /shāX ṭ+wāṃ/ da/hūṃ k+ṣiṃ /rdzu rluX tsho nga ༵ ༵ rtsagajor bzhi ni/ rgyu mthun rnam smin skyes bu can/ /dri ma med pa'i 'bras bu bzhi/ /srid pa'i skye 462
gshin rje gshed dmar po'i de kho na nyid la mchan 'god/gnas bzhi 〈sna dang / /e waṃ ma ya yi ge bzhi/ /de bzhi dga' bzhi ni/ gshed bzhi'i sa bon/ ya ma ra tsa bzhi/ /shes rab bzhi ni/ spyan dang ma ma gos dkar slol/ /yum bzhi po yi rnam pa ste/ /ga bzhi ni/ gshin rje shes rab pad+ma dang / /bgegs zhes grags pa mthar byed bzhi/ /tshad med bzhi dang mthar bas rmya phyogs bzhi'i gti pug gzhin rje gshed sogs byed bzhi/ /dga' ba bzhi dang skad cig bzhi/ /dam tshig phyag rgya las kyi phyag rgya chos kyi byag rgya/ phyag rgya che/ / na tswa dang /phyagargya bzhi yi rang bzhin no/ /rigs bzhi ye shes bzhi yi dngos/ /sku sgyi bor ngo bo nyid sku/ mgrin par longs sku/ snying gar chos sku/ lte bar sprul sku ste/ bzhi sbyi bor me long / mgrin par sor rtogs/ snying gar chos dgyings/ lte bar bya grub ye shes n+ta/ ye shes bzhi dang ldan/ /khams gsum la sogs thams cad rmya/ /bdag nyid chen po rdo rje 'dzin/ /bdud kyi bar chad bsrung pa'i phyir/ /de nyid gsang ba bshad par bya/ /ā yi kā li sbyor ba yis/ /lus ngag yid gsum bsrung bar bya/ /pyi srung ba/ bdag nyid lhag pa'i lhar gsal pa'i/ /ā liṃ kā li rab brjod pas/ /sbyi gtsug nas ni rkang mthil bar/ /shes rab thabs kyis skor phyogs su/ /mi phyed par ni bcing bar bya/ /nang srung ba/ ā li kā li rtsaganyis po/ /thabs dang shes rab yi ges bsrung / /gnyis med rtsani rdo rjes bsrung / /pyi dang lus kyi bsrung ba'o nang gi bdag nyid do/ /ngag gi srung ba rang gi gsang sngags rgyal po la/ /shes rab thabs kyi ye shes mchog /thog ma nas ni mtha' ru sbyar/ /e a hūṃ phaṭa sbyor ba yis/ /hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje yis/ /rang gi gsang sngags brtan par 'gyur/ /rang ming rigs kyi yi ge dag /yang dang pha ma'i nang bcug ste/ /ā li kā li gnyis med pa'i/ /za ma tog gi nang 〈snan pa'i/ /lte ba'i chu skyes 'og tu sbra/ /brgya pyin gyis kyang mi tshugs na/ /sha za phra mo smos ci dgos/ /yid kyi srung ba/ thabs dang shes rab ro gcig pa/ /rnam par mi rtog bde ba che/ /'od gsal ting 'dzin mchog gi ni/ /lhag pa'i bsrung ba gzhan med de/ /sa bcu pas 463
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngakyang mi phyed do/ /a ā/ i ī/ u lū/ ṛ hā/ dzo ṇ+ḍa/ e n+t+wa/ o au/ o aḥtsha aḥ.a ra pa tsa na khu hūṃ phaṭa/ ka kha ga lha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭhaḍa lha ṇa/ ta tha da ha na/ pa pha ba lha ma/ ya ra la ṭ+wāṃ /shaṃ khri k+ṣiṃ hūm̐ / ༷ ༷/ bhe+e ༷rnyi spyaX ༷/ ༷༷ / ③/༷ ṭ+wāṃ ༷/ ḍi/ /r+sha ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ ṭī ṭ+wāṃ/ba/nywaX ba'i phyir/ /me long ltar gsal byas pa la/ /bla ma lhar bcas bzod par rigs/ /dge ba gang des 'phro ba kun/ /bdud bzhi'i dgra las rgyal gyur cig /dpal gzhin rje gshed kyi 4tsho ba'i de kho na nyid ces bya ba/ rgya gad gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dbaṇa ā tsar+ya'i zhabs kyis mdzad ba rogs rtso/ /rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍita dngos grub brnyes pa/ darbaṇa ā tsar+ya de nyid dang / slo bo lo rtso ba dge slong shes rab rin chen gyis/ chos kyi rgyal po'i sku mkhar nyi gzugs su bsgyur cing zhus nye gtan la phab ba'o/ /'dir ma dab gzhan ma rnyed cing /rjenyid kyi byag bris ha cang 'tshub drag pa'i ltabs chis zhib mor bcos ma slobs/464

kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngabrdzun pa nyid du bostol/ /gsum pa zad byed pa la gsum/ spyod pa dang / lta ba bstan/ de dgag ba gsum las/ dang bo ni/ e ra'i thal bas lus la byugs nas su/ /mgo la ral pa'i khur bu 'khur bar byed/ /khyim du mar me btang nas gnas/ /mtshams su 'dug nas dril bu gathol/ /sgyil krung bcas nas mig btsums te/ /rna bar shub shub skye bo slu bar byed/ /khyo med skra med 'di 'dra gzhan la 〉〉/ga/ṭ+wāṃ/balha ༵ lha ngaban+dha /ji shā sna ༷spyan spya sprad lenag/nyi/ts+tsha k+ham̐ spya /nga /shā :pa'il r+sha pa/ gnod byed lam gyi gzugs/ /thar pa'i ched du bdag nyid 'gro byed slu/ /gsum pa de dgag pa ni/ gcer bus gal te grol 'gyur na/ /khyi dang wa semags cis mi grol/ /spu btogs pas ni grol 'gyur na/ /bud med spu brtogs grol bar 'gyur/ /mjug spu bslang bas rol 'gyur na/ /rma bya g.yag sogs grol bar 'gyur/ /langs te za bas grol 'gyur na/ /rta dang glang po ci phyir min/ /mda' bsnun na re nam mkha'i yid can la/ /thar pa nam yang 〈snad pa ma yin zer/ /gnyis ba rang lugs rdo rje'i glu la zhar byung shun mong gi lta ba'i dogs pa gcod ba/ khyad bar bla med lhan skyes kyi rnam bzhag gnyis/dang po la 'dod ba brjod/de dgag ba gnyis/ dang bo la rgyu phar phyin theg pa'i dogs gcod dang / 'bras bu sngags kyi zeg pa la dogs gcod gnyis/ dang po la lhan thos sne pa rnams kyis 'dul ba tsam gyi dka' spyad dang /mdo rje tshad mar byed ba'i mdo lde ba dang / sems tsam pa'i lta ba dang / dbu ma ba kha cig gi lta ba la dbyad pa bzhi/ dang po ni/ bde ba'i de nyid dang ni bral 'gyur zhing / /lus kyi dka' shub 'ba' zhig tsam ldan pas/ /dge tshul dge slong gnas brtan zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa mdo sne pa'i/ brje rnams ni de ltar rab byung nas/ /kha cig mdo sde 'chad par byed cing 'jug /gsum pa sems tsam ba'i/ la la ro gcig sems kyi tshul 'dzin mthong / /ba'i pa skya ma ba'i/ kha cig theg chen de la rgyug byed cing / /de ni gzhung lugs tshad ma'i bstan bathetshos yin/ /gnyis pa de dgag pa la rtog sgom dang stong dman pa'i rgyu dang /lhan skyes sgom gzhan nyis mi 'grub 466
do ha mdzod kyi mchan 'grel/pa dang /blun po'i mos gus gol sar bstan ba dang / khras dang gtsang sbra don chung gi lam du bstan pa dang /thun mong yin min kyi thabs snying rje dang bral ba'i stong lta mchog min tshul dang / tsan mong yin min gyi snying rje tsam gyis maco ris dang srid mtha'i lam bshad ba drug las/ dang bo ni/ gzhan yang dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ma lus bsgom/ /kha cig bzhi pa'i don 'chad pa la zhugs/ /la la nam mkha'i khams la rtog par snang / /gzhan yang stong nyid ldan par byed pa de/ /phal cher mi mthun phyogs la zhugs pa yin/ /gnyis pa lhan skyes dang sprul ba'i sgom gzhan gyis sems kyi don dam lhan skyes mi 'grub bar bshad ba/ lhan cig sprertos bral gzhan gang gis/ /mya ngan 'das gang sgom byed pa/ /de dag 'gas kyang don dam ni/ /cig shos 'grub bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gsum ba can mos gol sa ri/ gang zhig gang la mos par gyur pa des/ /bsam gtan gnas pas thar pa thob bam ci/ /bzhi ba khrus sogs don chung ba ni/ mar me ci dgos lha bzugs de ci dgos/ /de la ci bya gsang sngags bstan pa ci zhig dgos/ /'bab stegs 'gro dang dka' thub mi dgos te/ /chu la zhugs pas thar pa 〈snab bam ci/ /lnga ba snying rje dang bral ba'i stong pa zhi mtha'i lam snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid zhugs gang / /des ni lam mchog rnyed pa ma yin no/ /drug ba stong bral snying rje srid mtha'i lam/ 'on te snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgoms na yang / /gabor ba 'dir gnas thar pa 〈snab mi 'gyur/ /gnyis ba bla med lhan skyes kyi rnam bzhag la/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas bar bshad ba gnyis/ dang bo la krol lam lhan skyes dngos dang / rol ba'i 'bras bu dang / mtshon dka' tshul dang / 'dzag bde'i lam zangs ba bzhi las/dang bo la bde stong dbyer med kyis mtha' gnyis slong tshul dang /de la lam kun 'dus tshul dang / lam mchog yin cing bla ma'i zhal la stos tshul gsum gyi dang bo ni/ gang yang gnyis po sbyor bar nus pa des/ /'khor bar mi gnas mya ngan 'das mi gnas/ /gnyis pa thams cad 'dus tshul ni/ kye spros ba bal tshul/ lags gang smras brdzun zhing long pa de bor la/ /gang la zhen pa yod pa de yang thong / /rtogs par gyur na thams cad de yin te/ /de la gzhan pa sus kyang shes mi 'gyur/ /lam mchog yin tshul/ klog pa de yin 467
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum nga'dzin dang sgom pa de yin te/ /bstan bcos snying la 'chad pa'ang de yin no/ /gsum pa lam mchog yin cing bla ma'i zhal la stos tshul ni/ de mi gnyis pa zol ba'i 'bras bu/ mtshon pa'i lta ba tse(da min te/ /'on kyang gcig pu bla ma'i zhal la stos pa yin/ /bla ma'i smras pa gang gi snying zhugs pa/ /lag pa'i mthil du gnas pa'i gter mthong 'dra/ /gsum pa mtshon dka' tshul/ gnyug ma'i rang bzhin byis pas ma mthong bar/ /'khral bas byis pa bslus zhes mda' bsnun smra/ /bzhi pa 'dzag bde'i lam srangs par bstan pa ni/ bsam gtan med cing rab tu 'byung ba med/ /khyim na gnas shing chung ma dag dang lhan cig tu/ /gang zhig yul gyi dga' bas bcings las mi grol na/ /mda' bsnun nga ni de nyid shes pa yin zhes smra/ /gnyis pa rgyas bshad la chos nyid de bzhin nyid kyi de nyid dang / rang bzhin gzhug ma'i de nyid rang / sems nyid 'od gsal de nyid gsum/ dang bo la rtog med lhan skyes sgom pa'i rnal 'phyor dang /lhan skyes kyi rgyu srog rtsol rnam 'byor gnyis/ dang po la lhan skyes kyis rang bzhin brgya rtsabargyad sogs 'gag tshul gyi stobs dang /lhan skyes kyi rnal 'gyor dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ gal te mngon du gyur na bsam gtan ci/ /gal te lkog tu gyur na mun pa 'jal/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin de nyid ni/ /dngos dang dngos po ༷shā ༵ sdu ༷spya trā/rgyu/ lha)'a shāspyu dā /( stasna spri /ṭā paX n+dha/ //khri shā /nashā (spra k+ṣiṃ rnyi( rnyi gnas gyur pa/ /de nyid blangs nas bde chen mchog grub ces/ /skad gsang mthon pos mda' bsnun smra shes kyang / /byol serdzong 'jig rten mi go ji ltar bya/ /gnyis pa lhan skyes ji ltar bsgom pa la zlos bral gyi bsam gtan dang /rang bzhin gzhug ma'i phyag rgya dang / kun rtog med ba'i lhan skyes sgom pa gsum/dang po ni/ bsam gtan bral bas ci zhig bsam byar sku(da/ /brjod du med gang ji ltar bshad du 〈snad/ /gnyis pa rang bzhin gnyug ma ni/ srid pa'i phyag rgyas 'phro ba ma lus bslus/ /rang bzhin gnyug ma sus kyang blangs pa med/ /gsum pa kun rtog med ba'i lhan skyes sgom tshul ni/ rgyud med sngags 468

do ha mdzod kyi mchan 'grel/'dug cig /e ma'o ma yin lhan cig skyes pa mtshog chags byos/ /srid pa'i sna rtser 'ching ba yang dag spang / /gsum pa srog rtsol sgom ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'di ni yid 'dus bstan srung rnams kyi gsol mchod/brgyud bla ma 'khor dang bcas/ /spyan 'dren zlo gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs sogs/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ /spyan 'dren zlo nyu dpal ldan ye shes mgon po phyag drug sogs/ /phyogs skyong dpal mgon bdun cu'i tshogs dang bcas/ /spyan 'dren 5 skye 'gro'i srog bdag chos rgyal yab yum dang / /gshin rje pho brgyad mo brgyad lubor dang bcas/ /spyan 'dren tshidapal ldan ma cig rgyal mo re ma ti/ /mo brgyud bsrung ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /spyan 'dren rngo 'dod dgu'i char 'phebs rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ /gnod sbyin nor lha 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /spyan 'dren 5khrag mdog dregs pa lcam sring yab yum dang / /srog gcod bshan pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa sogs/ /spyan 'dren 5 ba har rgyal po sku lnga lubor dang bcas/ /skyes bu rdor legs gza' mchog rgyu skar dang / /dregs pa'i sde brgyad lha klu gshor dang bcas/ /spyan 'dren phyutshe ring mched lnga bstan ma'i tshogs dang bcas/ /sa yi lha mo lubor dang bcas pa rnams/ /spyan 'dren 5 snang srid sde dpon rma chen slom ra yang rma rigs sum brgya drug cu'i 'khor dang bcas/ /spyan 'dren zlo gur lha bcu gsum srid pa'i lha dgu sogs/ /'dzam gling gzhi bdag lubor dang bcas pa rnams/ /spyan 'dren 5'jigs pa'i sgra sgrogs gnyan rje gong sngon yang / /gnyan 'khor sum brgya drug bcu'i lta'or dang bcas/ /spyan 'dren tshirab 'jigs lha chen thog lha 〉rgod sogs/ /yul 'di'i gzhi bdag lha klu lurgar dang bcas/ /spyan 'dren dzi byes 'gro'i lam lha skyes pa'i yul lha dang / /dgra lha 'go ba'i lha srung lnga'or dang bcas/ /spyan 'dren mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /hūṃ ye shes rang snang las grub 'od gsal mer/ /dngos bshams yid sprul phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /dam rdzas sman sna bsang rdzas brgya phrag dag /khan pa sur dkar rgya shug dud sprin bcas/ /dri mchog mchod yon bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'bul/ /dag byed zhabs bsil lha rdzas me rtog 'bul/ /tsan 637
kun mkhyen gsung 'bum ngadan spos dang snang gsal 'od mchog 'bul/ /ga bur dri dang ro brgya'i zas mtshog 'bul/ /rkang gling rnga dang rol po'i sgro mchog 'bul/ /mdzis pa'i rtag mchog ma he lug nag tshogs/ /'phur lding khyung dang khyi nag dom ltar 'phyo/ /g.yul las rgyal ba'i rdo rje'i go khrab dang / /dgra 'joms 'bar ba'i rno ngar mtshon cha sogs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rnams ma lus 'bul/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs ma lus tshar gcod mdzod/ /sha khrag dmar chen gtor mas sa gzhi gang / /phun tshogs 'dod yon sna lngas bar snang gang / /rin chen rgyal srid sna bdun nam mkha' gang / /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla'i gdan dang bcas/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul/ /bdag cag 'dod dgu'i longs spyod rgyas gyur cig /hūṃ rtsabargyud bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs rnams dgongs su gsol/ /mdor na rnal 'byor bdag cag gabor bcas kyis/ /rang k+ṣiṃ rnyishā spri ((pa ༵ /sna papa so/ k+ṣiṃ/ / lja/ )rtswa shā snazlo (spra/ rnyipa lha sra nga /khye/hūm̐ pa~X so so'i spyan sngar mthol lo bshags/ /gang byas bya ba spyod pa mi mkhas pa'i/ /ma dad log lta la sogs bgyis pa dang / /zugs dang 'gal ba thams cad ci mchis pa/ /dam rdzas bsang mchod 'di yis dag gyur cig /hūṃ gser zhun 'bar 'dra'i ye shes me nang du/ /rmad byung spos sna bsang rdzas brgya phrag dag /bsregs pa'i dud sprin 'chi med lam gang bas/ /bka' drin gsum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma bsangs/ /dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams thams cad bsangs/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad bsangs/ /phyogs bcu'i yi dam bstan srung thams cad bsangs/ /rdo rje 'chang dang sa ra ha la sogs/ /〈'phrul chen po grub chen brgyad cu yang / /rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas bsangs/ /rgyal sras klu 638
